Description

Amazon MGM Studios is one of the largest and most ambitious content studios in the world. The Prime Video Finance Analytics organization supports this business with a centralized team of 40+ technical specialists spanning data engineering, business intelligence, data science, and product development, powering the data platforms and reporting that inform how content is planned, evaluated, and optimized across the entire Prime Video portfolio.

We are looking for a Data Engineer to join a dedicated, LA-based Studios Analytics team embedded alongside Amazon MGM Studios leadership. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Studios Analytics, you will build and own the data pipelines and models that power content performance reporting and the products Studios leaders rely on daily. You will own foundational content performance datasets end-to-end — turning a historically fragmented, dependency-heavy data landscape into trusted, single-threaded, well-governed data products.

This is a hands-on data engineering role at the heart of a deliberate structural change: bringing the content performance data and the products that surface it under one team, removing cross-team dependencies, and enabling faster iteration for Studios stakeholders.

Key job responsibilities

  • Build, optimize, and own data pipelines (ETL/ELT) and logical/physical data models for content performance datasets that serve as the source of truth for title-level launch KPIs.
  • Own ongoing data quality, monitoring, and SLAs for your datasets, ensuring reporting surfaced in applications is accurate, timely, and trusted by Studios leadership.
  • Take single-threaded ownership of the data behind the content performance products enabling the team to prioritize and deliver data changes independently.
  • Partner with BIEs, product development, and the financial reporting team to deliver integrated title-level and portfolio-level data (including feeds into web applications and downstream reporting).
  • Consume upstream governed data (e.g., P&L from the Economics team) correctly and consistently, upholding metric governance so definitions remain consistent across Prime Video.
  • Automate manual and ad-hoc data processes, build tooling for data lineage, quality, and discoverability, and reduce operational toil.
  • Contribute to design reviews, data modeling decisions, and technical trade-offs, leaving data solutions better and easier to maintain than you found them.
  • Enable self-service access to underlying content data for analysts and BIEs, minimizing bottlenecks.

About The Team

This role sits on a newly-expanded LA Studios Analytics team embedded with Studios but part of the broader 40+ person central Prime Video Finance Analytics organization. This structure is deliberate: you'll have the proximity of a small, focused team partnering directly with Studios VPs and Strategy, with the leverage of shared central infrastructure, governed data, and a dedicated AI enablement function behind you.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related field
  • 3+ years of data engineering experience
  • 3+ years of developing and operating large-scale data structures for business intelligence analytics using ETL/ELT processes experience
  • Experience in scripting for automation (e.g. Python) and advanced SQL skills.
  • Experience in building analytic or scientific data products or solutions
  • Experience building data pipelines or automated ETL processes
  • Knowledge of distributed systems as it pertains to data storage and computing
  • Experience working with data warehousing, data quality

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related field
  • Experience using Cloud Storage and Computing technologies such as AWS Redshift, S3, Hadoop, etc.
  • Experience with big data technologies such as: Hadoop, Hive, Spark, EMR
  • 6+ years of business intelligence and analytics experience
  • Experience in digital media or marketing strategy, data analysis, analytics & visualization
  • Familiarity with data governance, lineage, and metadata management practices.

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Air is the leader in Enterprise Readiness. Our mission is to establish readiness as a real-time condition that is continuously achieved. Today, a dangerous Readiness Gap exists between what the front line needs and what is delivered. Our AI-native platform, Air Enterprise Readiness, aligns development, production, delivery, and sustainment into one coordinated execution system for government agencies and industrial suppliers. By revealing true capacity, exposing real constraints, coordinating resources, and executing at the speed of operational demands, the front line gets what it needs to succeed.

Job Description

We are seeking an exceptional and experienced Data Engineer team member, a role for someone who shares our passion and obsession with shipping insightful and accurate data. You will be a core member of our team dedicated to helping drive our growth by building and maintaining data pipelines that deliver key business insights. The ideal candidate is an analytically minded engineer with large dataset experience. You must also possess strong interpersonal skills to work cross-functionally across internal teams and with Air platform Subject Matter Experts (SMEs).

You will support the proliferation of our enterprise data by sourcing data from business systems and our core application, and transforming that into a scalable data model delivering key insights. This role involves collaborating with technical and business stakeholders, maintaining high-confidence accuracy across every stage of our medallion architecture, and ensuring our tooling and data model scales to meet growth. You will own the execution, delivery, and validation of key data pipelines driving GTM, Operations, Product, and Engineering decisions.

This role is a full-time position located out of our office in Pittsburgh, PA.

This role may require up to 10% travel

Scope of Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with other software engineers, product managers, and client-facing teams to understand client requirements and translate them into technical solutions
  • Lead the deployment and integration of our software and data solutions in client environments, ensuring smooth implementation and adherence to project timelines
  • Actively participate in designing, building and testing scalable data architecture
  • Craft clean, testable, and maintainable code
  • Participate in the end-to-end software development of new feature functionality and design capabilities
  • Optimize processes for maximum speed and accuracy
  • Regularly seek out innovation and continuous improvement, finding efficiency in all assigned tasks

Qualifications

  • U.S. Citizenship is required

Required Skills

  • 3+ years of writing, maintaining, and optimizing Production grade SQL to support business functions and/or applications. Knows how to efficiently write CTE’s, correlated and non-correlated subqueries, and window functions.
  • 3+ years of data modeling. Knows star and snowflake schemas and the difference between a dimension and a fact.
  • 3+ years writing ETL pipelines. Has used Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or similar orchestration tools.
  • 1-3+ years of Python for pipelines, data science, or applications
  • Has hands-on experience in at least one startup/tech data domain: Finance, Pipeline/Funnel, Product Analytics, Operations
  • Ability to quickly understand how end user engagement with an application ties to conversion and revenue.
  • Demonstrated track record of working collaboratively and delivering independently
  • Strong judgment and attention to detail when validating complex relationships and resolving ambiguous cases
  • Excellent written communication — able to document decisions with clear reasoning and auditable source support
  • Ability to prioritize, triage, and execute quickly while maintaining consistent quality
  • Strong stakeholder communication skills and the ability to coordinate across multiple workstreams
  • Close attention to detail and validating data accuracy

Desired Skills

  • Current possession of a U.S. security clearance, or the ability to obtain one with our sponsorship

descriptionHtml:
About The Company

Rain is the global stablecoin payments platform for enterprises, neobanks, platforms, developers, and AI agents. Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world.

You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company backed by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS. In January 2026, we closed a $250M Series C led by ICONIQ, valuing Rain at $1.95B, with Sapphire Ventures, Norwest, Galaxy Ventures, Dragonfly, Bessemer Venture Partners, FirstMark, Lightspeed, and Endeavor Catalyst also participating. If you're curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we'd love to talk.

Our Ethos

We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.

About The Role

Rain is building payments and stablecoin infrastructure. Every transaction generates data across our system.

We’re looking for an Analytics Engineer, Finance to own the data layer Finance runs on: model it, reconcile it against source systems, test it, automate it, and make it self-serve. You’ll partner with Finance and Accounting and the data team to make sure every number we report ties back to its source.

We’re looking for someone with high agency and urgency who owns problems end to end, digs into discrepancies until the numbers tie out, and communicates clearly when something is uncertain. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built.

At Rain, we’re builders who use AI to automate repetitive work. That changes what data roles look like: where a data scientist used to only analyze and an analyst used to only build dashboards, here everyone models data, writes production-quality code, and automates their own workflows. You own the result, including checking what the AI produces. For this role, that means building trusted models and automating the reconciliations and reporting Finance depends on.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and own models for Finance: ledger, settlements, card transactions, invoicing, fees, and collateral, with clear grain and consistent definitions.
  • Build and run reconciliations between internal systems and external sources (card networks, processors, banks, partners); investigate breaks and fix the root cause.
  • Support month-end close and audit readiness with validated, documented outputs Finance can trust.
  • Automate recurring Finance reporting and deliveries (scheduled reports, exports, and alerts) so close and partner reporting run without manual work.
  • Add data quality tests and alerts so issues are caught before Finance sees them.
  • Partner with Finance to define metrics such as revenue, costs, volume, and contribution profit, and make them reusable across teams.
  • Build self-serve reporting so Finance can answer recurring questions independently.
  • Work with data and platform engineers on ingestion and source changes, following Rain’s data standards and access policies.

What You’ll Need

  • At least 3 years of experience in analytics engineering, software engineering, or analytics with a strong data modeling focus.
  • Proficiency using AI tools to learn new skills, navigate unfamiliar domains, and accelerate your work, while taking responsibility for checking the output.
  • Strong SQL in a modern data warehouse such as BigQuery, Snowflake, or Redshift, including complex joins, window functions, and incremental logic.
  • Hands-on dbt experience: data modeling, testing, documentation, version control, and code review.
  • Experience reconciling data across systems and explaining differences down to the row.
  • Familiarity with financial metrics and processes, such as revenue and costs, financial statements, reconciliation, or monthly close.
  • Strong attention to detail: you validate results against source systems and explain assumptions, tradeoffs, and uncertainty.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-moving startup, communicating clearly with technical and nontechnical partners.

Nice to have

  • Experience in payments, card issuing, fintech, or stablecoins, such as settlement files, ledgers, or interchange.
  • Experience with BI as code, such as Lightdash, Looker, or Omni.
  • Python or another scripting language for automation and data checks.
  • Experience working directly with Finance or Accounting teams.
  • Experience with orchestration and ingestion tools such as Dagster, Airflow, Meltano, Fivetran, or Datastream.

Things that enable a fulfilling, healthy and happy experience at Rain:

Flexible time off 🌴 Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves.

Flexible working ☕ We support a flexible workplace – work from home, come into an office, or both. We want everyone to work in an environment where they're their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers receive a stipend to set up a comfortable home workspace.

Easy to access benefits 🧠 For US Rainmakers, we cover 95% of your health, dental, and vision plan costs and 90% for your dependents, plus a 100% company-subsidized life insurance plan.

Retirement goals💡 Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.

Equity plan 📦 Every Rainmaker gets an equity option plan so we all benefit from our success.

Health and Wellness 📚 High performance begins from within. Rainmakers receive a monthly stipend to be used for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture - whatever recharges you!

In-office meals 🍜 Rainmakers working from the office enjoy lunch and dinner on us, covered with a DoorDash credit.

Team summits ✨ Summits play an important role at Rain. Time together helps us build relationships and a common destiny. Expect team and company offsites, both domestic and international.

Compensation Range: $128,393 - $167,498

descriptionHtml:
About Mesh

At Mesh, our mission is to enable consumers to pay and be paid with any asset. Today, trillions of dollars in tokenized assets exist but remain largely unusable for everyday commerce. Mesh is bridging this gap by making crypto payments reliable, useful, and ubiquitous. We combine a powerful orchestration engine with a seamless consumer app to unlock liquidity for the world. Backed by leading investors like SBI, Money Forward, Paradigm, Dragonfly, Galaxy, and PayPal Ventures, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of the global economy. Join us!

Overview

Mesh moves money across hundreds of exchanges, wallets and chains. The data that flow generates is now a product in its own right: clients want to see their conversion, volume and settlement data, Finance needs reporting they can sign, and our own teams answer most questions by asking an AI agent instead of filing a ticket. You'll own how we define, instrument, validate and ship that data, working hands-on in SQL and Python and building the guardrails that let AI agents query our data safely.

What You'll Do

  • Own product and client analytics. Define core metrics (conversion rates, transaction success rates) and maintain the central Amplitude data with reusable, templated charts. Build internal and external dashboards for clients.
  • Run experiment readouts. Baseline and read out A/B tests on the flow (UI variants, algorithms) and turn results into product decisions.
  • Prove migrations with data. Build apples-to-apples comparisons between platforms so decisions move on evidence, not gut feel.
  • Guard data integrity. Run and automate daily reconciliation triage and the verification engine.
  • Shape instrumentation. Define backend event schemas and the tracking plan, and normalize fields so the data is clean enough for analytics.
  • Build finance-grade reporting. Deliver settlement and billing reporting on Microsoft Fabric / Power BI with parity validation, alerting and self-serve access for Finance.

About Us

The Honest Company (NASDAQ: HNST) is a personal care company dedicated to creating cleanly-formulated and sustainably-designed products spanning categories across diapers, wipes, baby personal care, beauty, apparel, household care and wellness. Launched in 2012, the Company is on a mission to challenge ingredients, ideals, and industries through the power of the Honest brand, the Honest team, and the Honest Standard. For more information about the Honest Standard and the Company, please visit www.honest.com.

Our Mission

We're on a mission to empower people to live happy, healthy lives. We're a wellness brand with values rooted in consciousness, community, transparency, and design. Every day and in every way, we hold ourselves to an Honest standard. We believe that it is our responsibility to do our part to help create a healthy and sustainable future for all.

The Role

The Honest Company is seeking a Senior Analytics Engineer. Our centralized data function runs on Redshift, Airflow, dbt, Metabase, and Hex, and the curated layer is now the expected foundation for analytics. As a Senior Analytics Engineer, you own a full domain of that layer, such as supply chain or syndicated consumption data, from source contract to certified mart.

You are the person stakeholders in that domain go to when a number is disputed. You frame ambiguous requests before anyone writes SQL, decide how the domain should be modeled, and raise the craft of the analysts and engineers working around you.

What you'll do

  • Own one or more domains end to end: ERP orders, shipments, inventory, and cost, or Circana syndicated data, including the cross-domain joins behind SIOP and forecast-accuracy reporting.
  • Write design docs for domain-scale changes, such as a new conformed dimension or an incremental rebuild strategy, and get them reviewed before building.
  • Run definition sessions with supply chain planners and finance analysts; document the agreed definition and bring unresolved conflicts to the Data Council with a recommendation.
  • Define dataset tiers and SLAs for your domain, and lead incident response and post-incident review when those datasets break.
  • Own runtime and Redshift cost for your domain's models; find and fix the expensive ones.
  • Agree schema and quality expectations with Data Engineering for your domain's sources, and hold the line when upstream changes would break them.
  • Shape your domain's backlog with the Sr Manager; say no to work with clear reasons and an alternative.
  • Mentor analytics engineers and analysts; use code review to teach the reasoning behind standards, not only the standards.
  • Lead the migration of your domain's reporting off spreadsheets and raw tables onto curated models.
  • Run interview rounds and help calibrate candidates.

What we're looking for

Required

  • 6+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a heavily technical analyst role, including at least 2 years owning models that other teams depended on in production.
  • Everything in the Analytics Engineer profile, at a level where others copy your patterns: expert SQL on a columnar warehouse, production dbt (tests, macros, snapshots, exposures, CI), and dimensional modeling across multiple sources.
  • A track record of designing, not just implementing: you can show a modeling decision you made, the alternatives you rejected, and why.
  • Experience resolving a metric definition that two teams disagreed on, and making the resolution stick.
  • Experience owning reliability for datasets with real consumers: tests, freshness, alerting, and incident follow-through.
  • Clear technical writing: design docs, PR descriptions, and documentation a business user can read.
  • Evidence of making others better: mentorship, review culture, or standards adoption you drove.

Preferred

  • CPG, retail, or consumer goods experience, especially syndicated measurement data (Circana/IRI, NIQ, SPINS) or retailer vendor portals.
  • Working knowledge of the SIOP/S&OP cycle or the finance close calendar, and how data timing affects them.
  • Experience with a semantic layer, metric store, or data observability platform (Monte Carlo, Datafold).
  • Python; exposure to Airflow, Fivetran, or dlt.

What success looks like at 12 months

  • Your domain's reporting runs on curated models, and its spreadsheets of record are retired.
  • Your domain's critical datasets meet their SLAs, and incidents end with a fix to the cause.
  • Stakeholders in your domain bring definition questions to you before they build their own version.
  • At least one other engineer or analyst ships work in your domain to standard without your review.

Compensation

The pay range for this role is $130,000 - $150,000. Actual compensation is based on many factors including but not limited to depth of experience, skill level, ability, knowledge, education, certifications, and specific work location. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor.

The total rewards package for this position may also include base, annual incentive plan, benefits, retirement plan, equity, and Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

Benefits & Perks

At Honest, we're all about investing in our people. We're dedicated to providing a benefits package that supports your well-being, growth, and balance. Check out our benefits and perks we offer to help you thrive both in and out of the office:

  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness 🏥: We've got you covered with top-tier health, dental, and vision plans to keep you and your family feeling great.
  • 401k with Company Match 💰: Your future matters to us. We match your 401k contributions to help you secure a strong financial future.
  • Wellness & Fitness 💪: Stay healthy with a monthly fitness reimbursement and, for those in our Playa Vista office, an onsite gym to keep you active and energized.
  • Work-Life Balance ⚖️: We value your time. We provide a generous and flexible vacation policy to relax, recharge, and spend time on what matters most.
  • Family-Friendly Leave 👶: Growing your family? We offer generous maternity and paternity leave to support you during this exciting journey.
  • Ownership & Equity 💼: Ownership isn't just a mindset here—it's real. Every full time employee is granted equity, giving you a direct stake in our future. When we win, you win.
  • Education Reimbursement 🎓: We're committed to your growth—whether it's for professional development or a new passion, we offer education reimbursement to help you learn and level up.
  • Pet Insurance 🐾: We love your furry family members too! Our pet insurance ensures your pets are taken care of, because they're part of the family.

Please note: Benefits offerings may vary based on the position and geographic location.

  • Processing evaluating your application to determine your qualifications for the role to which you've applied, and communicating with you about your application, including to check references or your background, and communicate with you about other jobs that may interest you.

Founded in 2017 with the mission to eliminate food waste and make fresh food accessible to all, Afresh today supports more than 12,500 departments across 40 states, partnering with Albertsons Companies, Stater Bros., Meijer, Wakefern, and more. companySlogan: The only AI for all of Grocery
descriptionHtml:
Afresh, the AI platform for grocery, began by tackling the most complex problem in the industry: fresh, and has evolved into the core AI platform for grocers.

By leveraging proprietary AI designed for high-volatility environments, we empower partners like Albertsons, Meijer, and Wakefern to drive smarter decisions across their entire enterprise.

Following record-breaking 70% revenue growth in 2025, we have scaled to 6 enterprise-grade solutions, with solutions live in over 10% of the U.S. grocery market. Our platform now orchestrates billions of decisions from the store floor to the distribution center and prevented over 200 million pounds of food waste last year alone.

If you're looking for a role where your work directly translates into massive scale and social good, and you want to be part of the team that defines how the world eats, there is no better time to join us.

About the role:

At Afresh, we’re building data products to define the future of retail grocery analytics. The nerve center of those products is our analytics platform, and as a Staff Data Engineer on the Data Science and Analytics team, you’ll be the technical leader of that platform.

Our growing suite of data products range from standardized reports to AI-driven insight engines and agentic analytics tools. They let our customers understand what’s happening in their stores and empower them to reduce food waste. All of these products require a reliable platform of well-modeled data, clearly-defined metrics, and extensive metadata and context.

This platform is also used by teams across the company to ensure customer success and improve our core products. The Data Science and Analytics team collaborates closely with every team in the company, helping them build products and make decisions with data. You will regularly interact with data engineers, product engineers, product managers, data scientists, and operations specialists.

What You'll Do:

As a Staff Data Engineer on the Data Science team, you will own the development of our analytics platform. You’ll evolve our data models, solidify our pipelines, and establish data governance patterns to serve our internal- and customer-facing analytics needs. Some of your responsibilities will include:


  • Improving, extending, and optimizing our data analytics architecture to provide reliable and accessible data for our suite of data products;
  • Collaborating with stakeholders across the company to understand their data needs, and then build extensible dimensional models, semantic layer metrics, and agentic context and tooling that will allow for consistent and reliable AI-assisted insights;
  • Evolving our existing data quality and data governance processes; and
  • Mentoring and up-skilling other engineers


This is a high-impact role with ownership of highly visible projects and a lot of room to grow in your scope.

Skills and experience:


  • 6+ years of experience as a data engineer, analytics engineer, or similar role.
  • Exceptional communication and leadership skills, with a proven ability to facilitate cross-team and cross-functional collaboration and information-sharing.
  • A drive to learn new skills and dive into unfamiliar domains.
  • A strong sense of ownership and agency — taking initiative to spot problems and solve them without waiting to be told.
  • Fluency in advanced concepts in SQL, dimensional modeling, and data warehouse design; experience with Cloud Data Warehouse platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, etc.)
  • Proficiency in dbt
  • Experience with orchestration tools (Airflow/Astronomer, Dagster, or similar)
  • Experience with modern semantic layers: LookML, Cube.dev, Databricks Metrics Views, dbt MetricFlow, etc.).
  • Experience designing and optimizing pipelines of billion+ row datasets
  • Experience working with and extending AI models to produce high quality code and reliable analytics


This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.

Salary Range in US: $168k - $250k + meaningful early-stage equity + benefits

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.

Why You’ll Love Working at Afresh

At Afresh, our mission to eliminate food waste starts with investing in our people. We provide a comprehensive support system designed to help you do your best work while maintaining a healthy, balanced life.


  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family, with the majority of premiums covered by Afresh. We also provide dedicated mental health support and counseling services.

Quality, CI/CD & Operational Excellence

  • Own CI/CD deployment pipelines and release management processes.
  • Drive engineering best practices include testing, observability, modular modeling, and documentation.
  • Optimize Snowflake warehouse performance, cost efficiency, RBAC, and semantic layer design.
  • Lead root-cause analysis and long-term fixes for complex data issues.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Mentor junior engineers and uplift engineering maturity across squads.
  • Facilitate stakeholder sessions to translate business requirements into scalable data products.
  • Influence architectural decisions and emerging-technology adoption.

  • Working knowledge of automation tools (e.g., Elementum).

  • Generative AI applies responsibly to accelerate development and improve quality.
  • Experience with AI Coding Assistants (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, Cortex Code).
  • Skilled at bridging the gap between technical depth and business clarity through impactful communication.

  • Work Schedule: Fully Remote

About Us

The Honest Company (NASDAQ: HNST) is a personal care company dedicated to creating cleanly-formulated and sustainably-designed products spanning categories across diapers, wipes, baby personal care, beauty, apparel, household care and wellness. Launched in 2012, the Company is on a mission to challenge ingredients, ideals, and industries through the power of the Honest brand, the Honest team, and the Honest Standard. For more information about the Honest Standard and the Company, please visit www.honest.com.

Our Mission

We're on a mission to empower people to live happy, healthy lives. We're a wellness brand with values rooted in consciousness, community, transparency, and design. Every day and in every way, we hold ourselves to an Honest standard. We believe that it is our responsibility to do our part to help create a healthy and sustainable future for all.

The Role

The Honest Company is seeking a Senior Analytics Engineer. Our centralized data function runs on Redshift, Airflow, dbt, Metabase, and Hex, and the curated layer is now the expected foundation for analytics. As a Senior Analytics Engineer, you own a full domain of that layer, such as supply chain or syndicated consumption data, from source contract to certified mart.

You are the person stakeholders in that domain go to when a number is disputed. You frame ambiguous requests before anyone writes SQL, decide how the domain should be modeled, and raise the craft of the analysts and engineers working around you.

What you'll do

  • Own one or more domains end to end: ERP orders, shipments, inventory, and cost, or Circana syndicated data, including the cross-domain joins behind SIOP and forecast-accuracy reporting.
  • Write design docs for domain-scale changes, such as a new conformed dimension or an incremental rebuild strategy, and get them reviewed before building.
  • Run definition sessions with supply chain planners and finance analysts; document the agreed definition and bring unresolved conflicts to the Data Council with a recommendation.
  • Define dataset tiers and SLAs for your domain, and lead incident response and post-incident review when those datasets break.
  • Own runtime and Redshift cost for your domain's models; find and fix the expensive ones.
  • Agree schema and quality expectations with Data Engineering for your domain's sources, and hold the line when upstream changes would break them.
  • Shape your domain's backlog with the Sr Manager; say no to work with clear reasons and an alternative.
  • Mentor analytics engineers and analysts; use code review to teach the reasoning behind standards, not only the standards.
  • Lead the migration of your domain's reporting off spreadsheets and raw tables onto curated models.
  • Run interview rounds and help calibrate candidates.

What we're looking for

Required

  • 6+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a heavily technical analyst role, including at least 2 years owning models that other teams depended on in production.
  • Everything in the Analytics Engineer profile, at a level where others copy your patterns: expert SQL on a columnar warehouse, production dbt (tests, macros, snapshots, exposures, CI), and dimensional modeling across multiple sources.
  • A track record of designing, not just implementing: you can show a modeling decision you made, the alternatives you rejected, and why.
  • Experience resolving a metric definition that two teams disagreed on, and making the resolution stick.
  • Experience owning reliability for datasets with real consumers: tests, freshness, alerting, and incident follow-through.
  • Clear technical writing: design docs, PR descriptions, and documentation a business user can read.
  • Evidence of making others better: mentorship, review culture, or standards adoption you drove.

Preferred

  • CPG, retail, or consumer goods experience, especially syndicated measurement data (Circana/IRI, NIQ, SPINS) or retailer vendor portals.
  • Working knowledge of the SIOP/S&OP cycle or the finance close calendar, and how data timing affects them.
  • Experience with a semantic layer, metric store, or data observability platform (Monte Carlo, Datafold).
  • Python; exposure to Airflow, Fivetran, or dlt.

What success looks like at 12 months

  • Your domain's reporting runs on curated models, and its spreadsheets of record are retired.
  • Your domain's critical datasets meet their SLAs, and incidents end with a fix to the cause.
  • Stakeholders in your domain bring definition questions to you before they build their own version.
  • At least one other engineer or analyst ships work in your domain to standard without your review.

Compensation

The pay range for this role is $135,000 - $154,000. Actual compensation is based on many factors including but not limited to depth of experience, skill level, ability, knowledge, education, certifications, and specific work location. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor.

The total rewards package for this position may also include base, annual incentive plan, benefits, retirement plan, equity, and Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

Benefits & Perks

At Honest, we're all about investing in our people. We're dedicated to providing a benefits package that supports your well-being, growth, and balance. Check out our benefits and perks we offer to help you thrive both in and out of the office:

  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness 🏥: We've got you covered with top-tier health, dental, and vision plans to keep you and your family feeling great.
  • 401k with Company Match 💰: Your future matters to us. We match your 401k contributions to help you secure a strong financial future.
  • Wellness & Fitness 💪: Stay healthy with a monthly fitness reimbursement and, for those in our Playa Vista office, an onsite gym to keep you active and energized.
  • Work-Life Balance ⚖️: We value your time. We provide a generous and flexible vacation policy to relax, recharge, and spend time on what matters most.
  • Family-Friendly Leave 👶: Growing your family? We offer generous maternity and paternity leave to support you during this exciting journey.
  • Ownership & Equity 💼: Ownership isn't just a mindset here—it's real. Every full time employee is granted equity, giving you a direct stake in our future. When we win, you win.
  • Education Reimbursement 🎓: We're committed to your growth—whether it's for professional development or a new passion, we offer education reimbursement to help you learn and level up.
  • Pet Insurance 🐾: We love your furry family members too! Our pet insurance ensures your pets are taken care of, because they're part of the family.

Please note: Benefits offerings may vary based on the position and geographic location.

The Role

The Honest Company is seeking a Senior Analytics Engineer. Our centralized data function runs on Redshift, Airflow, dbt, Metabase, and Hex, and the curated layer is now the expected foundation for analytics. As a Senior Analytics Engineer, you own a full domain of that layer, such as supply chain or syndicated consumption data, from source contract to certified mart.

You are the person stakeholders in that domain go to when a number is disputed. You frame ambiguous requests before anyone writes SQL, decide how the domain should be modeled, and raise the craft of the analysts and engineers working around you.

What you'll do



- Own one or more domains end to end: ERP orders, shipments, inventory, and cost, or Circana syndicated data, including the cross-domain joins behind SIOP and forecast-accuracy reporting.
- Write design docs for domain-scale changes, such as a new conformed dimension or an incremental rebuild strategy, and get them reviewed before building.
- Run definition sessions with supply chain planners and finance analysts; document the agreed definition and bring unresolved conflicts to the Data Council with a recommendation.
- Define dataset tiers and SLAs for your domain, and lead incident response and post-incident review when those datasets break.
- Own runtime and Redshift cost for your domain's models; find and fix the expensive ones.
- Agree schema and quality expectations with Data Engineering for your domain's sources, and hold the line when upstream changes would break them.
- Shape your domain's backlog with the Sr Manager; say no to work with clear reasons and an alternative.
- Mentor analytics engineers and analysts; use code review to teach the reasoning behind standards, not only the standards.
- Lead the migration of your domain's reporting off spreadsheets and raw tables onto curated models.
- Run interview rounds and help calibrate candidates.

What we're looking for

Required



- 6+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a heavily technical analyst role, including at least 2 years owning models that other teams depended on in production.
- Everything in the Analytics Engineer profile, at a level where others copy your patterns: expert SQL on a columnar warehouse, production dbt (tests, macros, snapshots, exposures, CI), and dimensional modeling across multiple sources.
- A track record of designing, not just implementing: you can show a modeling decision you made, the alternatives you rejected, and why.
- Experience resolving a metric definition that two teams disagreed on, and making the resolution stick.
- Experience owning reliability for datasets with real consumers: tests, freshness, alerting, and incident follow-through.
- Clear technical writing: design docs, PR descriptions, and documentation a business user can read.
- Evidence of making others better: mentorship, review culture, or standards adoption you drove.

Preferred



- CPG, retail, or consumer goods experience, especially syndicated measurement data (Circana/IRI, NIQ, SPINS) or retailer vendor portals.
- Working knowledge of the SIOP/S&OP cycle or the finance close calendar, and how data timing affects them.
- Experience with a semantic layer, metric store, or data observability platform (Monte Carlo, Datafold).
- Python; exposure to Airflow, Fivetran, or dlt.

What success looks like at 12 months



- Your domain's reporting runs on curated models, and its spreadsheets of record are retired.
- Your domain's critical datasets meet their SLAs, and incidents end with a fix to the cause.
- Stakeholders in your domain bring definition questions to you before they build their own version.
- At least one other engineer or analyst ships work in your domain to standard without your review.

Compensation

The pay range for this role is $135,000 - $154,000. Actual compensation is based on many factors including but not limited to depth of experience, skill level, ability, knowledge, education, certifications, and specific work location. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor.

The total rewards package for this position may also include base, annual incentive plan, benefits, retirement plan, equity, and Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

- Comprehensive Health & Wellness 🏥: We've got you covered with top-tier health, dental, and vision plans to keep you and your family feeling great.
- 401k with Company Match 💰: Your future matters to us. We match your 401k contributions to help you secure a strong financial future.
- Wellness & Fitness 💪: Stay healthy with a monthly fitness reimbursement and, for those in our Playa Vista office, an onsite gym to keep you active and energized.

- Ownership & Equity 💼: Ownership isn't just a mindset here—it's real. Every full time employee is granted equity, giving you a direct stake in our future. When we win, you win.

descriptionHtml:
About The Team

The Data team at Zillow turns complex data into insights, models, and data products that help power smarter decisions across the business. As part of our broader Data Analytics and Insights organization, this team partners closely with product, engineering, and business leaders to solve meaningful problems, improve the quality and usability of our data, and build scalable solutions that create impact for customers and employees alike. Together, we foster a collaborative, inclusive environment where curiosity, analytical rigor, and a passion for impact help shape how Zillow works and grows.

About The Role

As an Analytics Engineer, you are responsible for building the trusted, governed, and scalable data models and metrics that underpin how the company measures its business and makes decisions. You translate raw data into well-structured analytical assets that serve dashboards, self-service tools, data science workflows, and increasingly, AI-powered analytics interfaces.

You will get to

  • Lead the design, development, and maintenance of trusted, scalable analytical data products, including reusable data models, standardized metrics, and semantic layer components that support business intelligence, self-service analytics, data science, and AI-powered interfaces.
  • Translate complex business requirements into well-structured data models and precise metric definitions, ensuring business logic is implemented in the appropriate layer and applied consistently across teams and analytical surfaces.
  • Partner with Data Engineering, Data Science, Business Intelligence, Product Management, and business stakeholders to prioritize analytics engineering initiatives, define technical requirements and data contracts, and manage cross-team dependencies.
  • Drive improvements in data quality, governance, discoverability, and documentation through automated validation, clear metadata, consistent metric definitions, and proactive resolution of data issues.
  • Build, optimize, and operate reliable last-mile data transformation pipelines using version control, code review, CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, and alerting to reduce manual effort and improve maintainability.
  • Mentor and coach teammates on data modeling and engineering best practices, contribute to analytics engineering standards and roadmap decisions, and enable stakeholders to confidently use governed data products.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.

In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $151,700.00 - $242,300.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations. In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $144,100.00 - $230,300.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Business, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence, or a closely related field, working with large datasets to develop reliable analytical data models and data products.
  • Demonstrated experience owning analytical data products across multiple data domains end-to-end and independently solving complex data modeling and metric definition challenges.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional workstreams, translate business needs into technical specifications, prioritize competing requests, and manage multiple projects and upstream dependencies in alignment with team and business goals.
  • Deep proficiency in SQL, data transformation frameworks such as dbt or equivalent, and analytical modeling approaches, including dimensional, denormalized, and entity-relationship models, with sound judgment about granularity, aggregation, reuse, and business logic placement.
  • Experience working in online data lakehouses like Databricks or Snowflake and proficiency in Git
  • Strong experience applying software engineering and operational practices to analytics workflows, including version control, CI/CD, code review, automated testing, data quality checks, monitoring, and root-cause analysis, with the ability to improve team standards and reliability.
  • Experience designing and maintaining semantic layer components, metrics-as-code, and metadata for multiple consumers, with an understanding of data governance and how BI tools, data science workflows, and AI-powered interfaces interpret metric definitions.
  • Ability to communicate technical trade-offs clearly, align stakeholders on shared metric definitions, write concise self-service documentation, and mentor teammates on modeling and engineering best practices.
  • Experience using AI-assisted coding tools with the judgment to validate generated SQL, transformation logic, and documentation, prevent duplicated or inconsistent business logic, and independently explain and defend your design decisions.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Tebra only initiates contact with candidates via email from an official Tebra email address (@tebra.com, @patientpop.com, or @kareo.com) or through our applicant tracking system, Greenhouse. We will only ask you to provide sensitive personal information through our official application portal — not via social media or text message. We do not conduct interviews via instant messaging.

About The Role

Tebra helps private practices bring modernized care to patients everywhere. To run our own business well, every team needs numbers it can trust.

We're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help build Tebra's new internal analytics platform. You'll turn data from Salesforce, NetSuite, Stripe, our product, and other systems into one shared, tested set of business data and metrics that Finance, Customer Success, Growth, and Payments all use. You'll lead projects end to end, set the standards others build on, and partner with business leaders to define the metrics that matter most.

Your Area of Focus

  • Data Modeling & Shared Datasets: Design, build, and maintain enterprise-wide business data that teams across Finance, Customer Success, Growth, and Payments build on. Apply dimensional modeling and layered design (staging, intermediate, and marts) so business logic lives in one place and isn't rebuilt by each team.
  • Metric Definition & Semantic Layer: Partner with metric owners in Finance and the business to define each key metric once, with a named owner and documented logic. Publish governed metrics in a semantic layer that Tableau, AI assistants, and other tools query, and reconcile them to current reporting and the general ledger before teams switch over.
  • Self-Service Enablement: Build easy-to-use datasets that let non-technical teammates and analysts answer their own questions without writing complex joins.
  • Platform Migration: Lead projects end to end on the new internal analytics platform, from source data to dashboards. Move each team's reporting over one domain at a time, with clear cutover and rollback plans, and onboard the analysts who contribute to new conventions, review processes, and tools.
  • Data Quality & Testing: Build automated tests and pull-request checks so data issues are caught before they reach reports. Monitor scheduled jobs, fix failures, and recover runs as part of shared production support.
  • Performance & Efficiency: Tune SQL, models, and pipeline schedules so data refreshes on time and dashboards load in seconds. Monitor compute usage and cost, and choose how each model is built and refreshed to keep both in check.
  • Forecasting & Machine Learning: Partner with analysts and data scientists to prepare clean, documented datasets for forecasting and machine learning models, such as retention and revenue projections.
  • Code Review & Mentorship: Review code from analysts and engineers across teams, and coach them on modeling, SQL, and testing standards.
  • Governance & Documentation: Follow data-sharing and privacy rules that keep protected health information (PHI) and personal data out of internal analytics. Maintain model documentation, lineage, and metric definitions via dbt, GitHub, Confluence, and Jira.

Your Professional Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a similar role, with 2+ years hands-on in dbt in production.
  • SQL Fluency: Expert SQL, including window functions, CTEs, and performance tuning for queries and pipelines on large datasets.
  • Data Modeling: Deep proficiency in dimensional modeling (Kimball), including shared datasets that serve many teams.
  • Tech Stack: Proven experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse, and with dbt.
  • Business Partnership: Experience defining business metrics with Finance or business stakeholders, and reconciling data to financial systems.
  • Software Mindset: Experience with GitHub for version control and code review, automated builds (GitHub Actions or similar), and Jira and Confluence for work tracking and documentation.
  • Communication: Strong communication with people who aren't data specialists, and ability to execute under minimal supervision.
  • Growth Mindset: Motivated to learn new technologies and develop new skills.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, statistics, economics, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Semantic Layer: Experience with a semantic layer, such as Snowflake semantic views or the dbt Semantic Layer, preferred.
  • Domain Knowledge: Experience with Salesforce, NetSuite, or Stripe data, and with subscription revenue, retention, or payments metrics, preferred.
  • Forecasting & ML: Experience preparing data for forecasting or machine learning models preferred.
  • Healthcare: Healthcare or HIPAA experience preferred.
  • Additional Tools: Familiarity with Tableau, Terraform, or Okta a plus.
  • Certifications: dbt Analytics Engineering or SnowPro certifications preferred.

We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with competitive and fair compensation. For this position, this range reflects our Zone 1 (National Average) pay band. Your specific compensation is thoughtfully determined by your experience, qualifications, the specific requirements of the role, and your Geo Zone. Our geo-zone system ensures your pay is competitive for your location, recognizing varying costs of labor across regions.Our four geo zones are designed to reflect this:Zone 1: National AverageZone 2: Moderately Higher Cost RegionsZone 3: High-Cost RegionsZone 4: Lower-Cost RegionsBeyond base compensation, Tebra offers eligible employees the opportunity for variable pay and a robust benefits package, reflecting our commitment to your overall well-being. Zone 1 (National Average): $127,000 USD - $145,000 USD

About Tebra

Tebra is the only all-in-one EHR+ platform built exclusively for independent healthcare practices. Designed to replace the clunky, fragmented tools built for corporate systems, Tebra connects EHR software, billing, automation, telehealth solution, and marketing — so providers can spend less time on admin and more time with patients. More than 42,000 private practices trust Tebra to streamline operations, increase revenue, and reduce burnout — helping clinicians leave work on time and rediscover their purpose. Learn more at www.tebra.com.

Our ValuesStart with the Customer

We get to know our customers - and their patients - and look at the world through their lens.

Keep It Simple

Healthcare is too complex. We aim to simplify it for everyone.

Stay Entrepreneurial

We reject the status quo and solve problems with creativity, perseverance, and a bias to action.

Better Together

We are diverse, humble, and collaborative. We put the team first and win together.

Celebrate Success

Life is short and joy is underrated. We take time to have fun and celebrate success.

Perks & Benefits

United States: In addition to our healthcare benefits, we also offer amazing perks! Need work from home basics? We offer a discount through Dell! We also offer a number of resources to help you keep your mind and body healthy. Check out Gympass for a great workout, or TelusEmployee Assistance Program to find mental health resources, along with other resources for everyday occurrences.

Check out Gympass for access to health and fitness apps, or Telus Employee Assistance Program to find mental health resources, along with other resources for everyday occurrences.

California residents who apply or are recruited for a job with us: please carefully review our California-specific Privacy Notice under the California Consumer Protection Act here: https://www.tebra.com/privacy-policy/california-supplemental-notice/

descriptionHtml:
About The Company

Rain is the global stablecoin payments platform for enterprises, neobanks, platforms, developers, and AI agents. Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world.

You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company backed by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS. In January 2026, we closed a $250M Series C led by ICONIQ, valuing Rain at $1.95B, with Sapphire Ventures, Norwest, Galaxy Ventures, Dragonfly, Bessemer Venture Partners, FirstMark, Lightspeed, and Endeavor Catalyst also participating. If you're curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we'd love to talk.

Our Ethos

We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.

About The Role

Rain is building payments and stablecoin infrastructure. Every transaction generates data across our system.

We’re looking for an Analytics Engineer, Finance to own the data layer Finance runs on: model it, reconcile it against source systems, test it, automate it, and make it self-serve. You’ll partner with Finance and Accounting and the data team to make sure every number we report ties back to its source.

We’re looking for someone with high agency and urgency who owns problems end to end, digs into discrepancies until the numbers tie out, and communicates clearly when something is uncertain. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built.

At Rain, we’re builders who use AI to automate repetitive work. That changes what data roles look like: where a data scientist used to only analyze and an analyst used to only build dashboards, here everyone models data, writes production-quality code, and automates their own workflows. You own the result, including checking what the AI produces. For this role, that means building trusted models and automating the reconciliations and reporting Finance depends on.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and own models for Finance: ledger, settlements, card transactions, invoicing, fees, and collateral, with clear grain and consistent definitions.
  • Build and run reconciliations between internal systems and external sources (card networks, processors, banks, partners); investigate breaks and fix the root cause.
  • Support month-end close and audit readiness with validated, documented outputs Finance can trust.
  • Automate recurring Finance reporting and deliveries (scheduled reports, exports, and alerts) so close and partner reporting run without manual work.
  • Add data quality tests and alerts so issues are caught before Finance sees them.
  • Partner with Finance to define metrics such as revenue, costs, volume, and contribution profit, and make them reusable across teams.
  • Build self-serve reporting so Finance can answer recurring questions independently.
  • Work with data and platform engineers on ingestion and source changes, following Rain’s data standards and access policies.

What You’ll Need

  • At least 3 years of experience in analytics engineering, software engineering, or analytics with a strong data modeling focus.
  • Proficiency using AI tools to learn new skills, navigate unfamiliar domains, and accelerate your work, while taking responsibility for checking the output.
  • Strong SQL in a modern data warehouse such as BigQuery, Snowflake, or Redshift, including complex joins, window functions, and incremental logic.
  • Hands-on dbt experience: data modeling, testing, documentation, version control, and code review.
  • Experience reconciling data across systems and explaining differences down to the row.
  • Familiarity with financial metrics and processes, such as revenue and costs, financial statements, reconciliation, or monthly close.
  • Strong attention to detail: you validate results against source systems and explain assumptions, tradeoffs, and uncertainty.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-moving startup, communicating clearly with technical and nontechnical partners.

Nice to have

  • Experience in payments, card issuing, fintech, or stablecoins, such as settlement files, ledgers, or interchange.
  • Experience with BI as code, such as Lightdash, Looker, or Omni.
  • Python or another scripting language for automation and data checks.
  • Experience working directly with Finance or Accounting teams.
  • Experience with orchestration and ingestion tools such as Dagster, Airflow, Meltano, Fivetran, or Datastream.

Things that enable a fulfilling, healthy and happy experience at Rain:

Flexible time off 🌴 Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves.

Flexible working ☕ We support a flexible workplace – work from home, come into an office, or both. We want everyone to work in an environment where they're their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers receive a stipend to set up a comfortable home workspace.

Easy to access benefits 🧠 For US Rainmakers, we cover 95% of your health, dental, and vision plan costs and 90% for your dependents, plus a 100% company-subsidized life insurance plan.

Retirement goals💡 Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.

Equity plan 📦 Every Rainmaker gets an equity option plan so we all benefit from our success.

Health and Wellness 📚 High performance begins from within. Rainmakers receive a monthly stipend to be used for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture - whatever recharges you!

In-office meals 🍜 Rainmakers working from the office enjoy lunch and dinner on us, covered with a DoorDash credit.

Team summits ✨ Summits play an important role at Rain. Time together helps us build relationships and a common destiny. Expect team and company offsites, both domestic and international.

Compensation Range: $128,393 - $167,498

Let’s face it, a company whose mission is human transformation better have some fresh thinking about the employer/employee relationship.

We do. We can’t cram it all in here, but you’ll start noticing it from the first interview.

Even our candidate experience is different. And when you get an offer from us (and accept it), you get way more than a paycheck. You get a personal BetterUp Coach, a development plan, a trained and coached manager, the most amazing team you’ve ever met (yes, each with their own personal BetterUp Coach), and most importantly, work that matters.

This makes for a remarkably focused and fulfilling work experience. Frankly, it’s not for everyone. But for people with fire in their belly, it’s a game-changing, career-defining, soul-lifting move.

Join us and we promise you the most intense and fulfilling years of your career, doing life-changing work in a fun, inventive, soulful culture.

If that sounds exciting—and the job description below feels like a fit—we really should start talking.

We are a hybrid company with a focus on in-person collaboration when necessary. Employees are expected to be available to work from one of our office hubs at least two days per week, or eight days per month. Our US hub locations include: Austin, TX; New York City, NY; San Francisco, CA; and the Washington, DC metro area. Please ensure you can realistically commit to this structure before applying.

The Opportunity

BetterUp is looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer with experience building data modeling systems within a modern data stack, supported by intelligent data warehousing and adaptable business intelligence systems, to join our team. At BetterUp we believe data is critical to our success and this role on the Analytics Engineering team will be crucial to this strategy of delivering exceptional data products that will drive key business decisions. If you are passionate about helping people reach their potential, thrive in a fast-paced startup environment where you get to build the future, and love data then this is the role for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Architect, build and maintain efficient and reliable data products (dbt models, pipelines, Looker explores, visualizations, etc.) that enable data driven decision making.
  • Build and maintain ELT pipelines from source systems to data warehouses.
  • Influence strategy and drive execution of our analytical roadmap delivering self-service business intelligence at scale.
  • Provide leadership and mentorship to other engineers fostering collaboration, knowledge sharing and a high bar for quality.
  • Improve end users trust and confidence by driving best practices with regards to data discoverability, observability, lineage and stewardship.
  • Contribute towards a robust data security strategy protecting sensitive information and content.
  • Solve critical business problems through the application of programming, optimization, automation, and analytical skills.

If you have some or all of the following, please apply:

  • Minimum 5+ years of relevant experience in data engineering and/or analytics engineering
  • Advanced SQL skills with 5+ years of deep experience with Snowflake or similar DB
  • Expertise with data modeling and ETL/ELT (dbt preferred, pipeline development a plus)
  • Seasoned developer (5+ years) within a modern business intelligence tool (Looker preferred)
  • Experience applying software engineering principles (testing, version control, code reviews, CI/CD, etc.) in your working process, to scale analytical development
  • Proven track record of working with data teams in a fast-paced, startup environment
  • Proven track record of successfully working cross-functionally with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Solutions-driven and thrives when given ambiguous, open-ended problems
  • Proven success driving projects through implementation to completion, including stakeholder education and onboarding
  • Obsessed with data protections and privacy (i.e. PII, GDPR, FedRAMP, FIPS, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools in your development workflow (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, AI-assisted dbt and SQL development)

AI at BetterUp

Our team thrives at the intersection of human expertise and AI capability. As an AI-forward company, adaptation and continuous learning are part of our daily work. We're looking for teammates who are excited to evolve alongside technology – people who experiment boldly, share their discoveries openly, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work. These professionals thoughtfully integrate AI into their work to deliver exceptional results while maintaining the human judgment and creativity that drives real innovation. During our interview process, you’ll have opportunities to showcase how you harness AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact.

As a Senior Analytics Engineer, You’ll

  • Architect domain-level AI reinvention: identify the highest-leverage AI opportunities in how we build and scale our data products, secure the resources to test them, and install repeatable mechanisms that lock in proven gains across several teams
  • Build scalable AI-powered systems, such as intelligent pipeline monitoring, automated data quality checks, and AI-assisted development, that change how analytical work gets done across multiple teams
  • Establish governance frameworks and best practices for responsible AI usage at scale within the analytics function

We encourage all candidates to share examples of how they’ve used AI tools in their work—whether it’s AI-assisted SQL generation, LLM-powered data documentation, automated anomaly detection, or other applications. We view AI fluency as a complement to craft, not a replacement for it.

Benefits

At BetterUp, we are committed to living out our mission every day and that starts with providing benefits that allow our employees to care for themselves, support their families, and give back to their community.

  • Access to BetterUp coaching; one for you and one for a friend or family member
  • A competitive compensation plan with opportunity for advancement
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Per year:
    • All federal/statutory holidays observed
    • 4 BetterUp Inner Workdays (https://www.betterup.co/inner-work)
    • 5 Volunteer Days to give back
    • Learning and Development stipend
    • Company wide Summer & Winter breaks
  • Year-round charitable contribution of your choice on behalf of BetterUp
  • 401(k) self contribution
We are dedicated to building diverse teams that fuel an authentic workplace and sense of belonging for each and every employee. We know applying for a job can be intimidating, please don’t hesitate to reach out — we encourage everyone interested in joining us to apply.

BetterUp Inc. provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, genetics, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status. In addition to federal law requirements, BetterUp Inc. complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

At BetterUp, we compensate our employees fairly for their work. Base salary is determined by job-related experience, education/training, residence location, as well as market indicators. The range below is representative of base salary only and does not include equity, sales bonus plans (when applicable) and benefits. This range may be modified in the future.

The base salary range for this role is as follows:

$175,000 – $220,000: New York City and San Francisco

$158,000 – $198,000: All other locations

During our interview process, you’ll have opportunities to showcase how you harness AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact.

  • Architect domain-level AI reinvention: identify the highest-leverage AI opportunities in how we build and scale our data products, secure the resources to test them, and install repeatable mechanisms that lock in proven gains across several teams
  • Build scalable AI-powered systems, such as intelligent pipeline monitoring, automated data quality checks, and AI-assisted development, that change how analytical work gets done across multiple teams
  • Establish governance frameworks and best practices for responsible AI usage at scale within the analytics function

descriptionHtml:
In 1989, Tim Berners-Lee wrote a proposal for CERN. CERN lost knowledge when people left, because its information was in many systems that did not connect. His solution was simple: link documents so that all people can find them and use them. That proposal became the World Wide Web.

Mercury has a similar challenge with data. Teams, models, and AI agents need data that they can find, understand, and trust. We are building an AI-native data platform that enables Mercury to have reliable analytics, accelerate product development, and enable the next generation of AI-powered products and internal tools.

We are hiring a Senior Analytics Engineer to help us accelerate. You’ll join a team of high-performing Data and Analytics Engineers building the shared foundations that power decisioning, automation, and measurement across the company, collaborating closely with Data Scientists and partners in Product, Engineering, and Operations. Your curiosity and bias toward action will drive meaningful impact as you build durable data products, unlock faster experimentation, and help teams ship propensity models, agentic workflows, and amazing data-driven experiences for our customers. Come grow with us.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and build scalable data pipelines and business-conformed dimensional data marts in collaboration with Data Science, Engineering, Product, and Operations departments
  • Support the development and adoption of agentic tooling. We have our own AI Data Analyst (Hermes) and dbt Agent (Ralph) that are built and managed by our Analytics Engineers
  • Support self-service analytics workflows, Analytics Engineering skills, and dimensional data principles through implementation, education, and peer support
  • Help us implement the data and analytics products we’ll need to effect our bank charter
  • Contribute to the evolution of our data quality, governance, and security strategies
  • Contribute to our definition of Analytics Engineering standards and best practices

You may be a good fit if you:

  • Have 4+ years of Analytics or Data Engineering experience
  • Have expertise working in a full modern data stack including Fivetran / Airflow / Snowflake / dbt / Omni / Hex or equivalents
  • Are proficient with SQL and have working experience with Python
  • Proficient using AI agents to accelerate your and your teammates’ work
  • Have experience with dimensional data modeling principles and building data for scale
  • Treat data products as a platform by prioritizing reusable, scalable deliverables
  • Deliver readable code, strong tests, and quality documentation
  • Experiment responsibly and share what you learn so everyone benefits
  • Practice relentless empathy by meeting your stakeholders in Data, Product, Engineering, and beyond where they’re at and helping them succeed
  • Discern what’s needed from what’s wanted to deliver maximum impact

Strong candidates may additionally have:

  • Banking* or financial services industry experience
  • Experience with agentic development and/or analytics workflows
  • Exposure to data governance, compliance, and security best practice
  • A full-stack mindset and willingness to solve problems end-to-end by flexing into Data Engineering and Data Analysis

If this role interests you, we invite you to explore our public demo at demo.mercury.com.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

Total Rewards

The total rewards package at Mercury includes base salary, equity (stock options/RSUs), and benefits.

Our salary and equity ranges are highly competitive within the SaaS and fintech industry and are updated regularly using the most reliable compensation survey data for our industry. New hire offers are made based on a candidate’s experience, expertise, geographic location, and internal pay equity relative to peers.

$166,600—$208,300 USD

$157,400—$196,800 CAD
