descriptionHtml:
Archer is collaborating with Zillow to connect them with exceptional professionals for this role.

About The Team

The Data team at Zillow turns complex data into insights, models, and data products that help power smarter decisions across the business. As part of our broader Data Analytics and Insights organization, this team partners closely with product, engineering, and business leaders to solve meaningful problems, improve the quality and usability of our data, and build scalable solutions that create impact for customers and employees alike. Together, we foster a collaborative, inclusive environment where curiosity, analytical rigor, and a passion for impact help shape how Zillow works and grows.

About The Role

As an Analytics Engineer, you are responsible for building the trusted, governed, and scalable data models and metrics that underpin how the company measures its business and makes decisions. You translate raw data into well-structured analytical assets that serve dashboards, self-service tools, data science workflows, and increasingly, AI-powered analytics interfaces.

You will get to

  • Lead the design, development, and maintenance of trusted, scalable analytical data products, including reusable data models, standardized metrics, and semantic layer components that support business intelligence, self-service analytics, data science, and AI-powered interfaces.
  • Translate complex business requirements into well-structured data models and precise metric definitions, ensuring business logic is implemented in the appropriate layer and applied consistently across teams and analytical surfaces.
  • Partner with Data Engineering, Data Science, Business Intelligence, Product Management, and business stakeholders to prioritize analytics engineering initiatives, define technical requirements and data contracts, and manage cross-team dependencies.
  • Drive improvements in data quality, governance, discoverability, and documentation through automated validation, clear metadata, consistent metric definitions, and proactive resolution of data issues.
  • Build, optimize, and operate reliable last-mile data transformation pipelines using version control, code review, CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, and alerting to reduce manual effort and improve maintainability.
  • Mentor and coach teammates on data modeling and engineering best practices, contribute to analytics engineering standards and roadmap decisions, and enable stakeholders to confidently use governed data products.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.

In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $151,700.00 - $242,300.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations. In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $144,100.00 - $230,300.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Business, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence, or a closely related field, working with large datasets to develop reliable analytical data models and data products.
  • Demonstrated experience owning analytical data products across multiple data domains end-to-end and independently solving complex data modeling and metric definition challenges.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional workstreams, translate business needs into technical specifications, prioritize competing requests, and manage multiple projects and upstream dependencies in alignment with team and business goals.
  • Deep proficiency in SQL, data transformation frameworks such as dbt or equivalent, and analytical modeling approaches, including dimensional, denormalized, and entity-relationship models, with sound judgment about granularity, aggregation, reuse, and business logic placement.
  • Experience working in online data lakehouses like Databricks or Snowflake and proficiency in Git
  • Strong experience applying software engineering and operational practices to analytics workflows, including version control, CI/CD, code review, automated testing, data quality checks, monitoring, and root-cause analysis, with the ability to improve team standards and reliability.
  • Experience designing and maintaining semantic layer components, metrics-as-code, and metadata for multiple consumers, with an understanding of data governance and how BI tools, data science workflows, and AI-powered interfaces interpret metric definitions.
  • Ability to communicate technical trade-offs clearly, align stakeholders on shared metric definitions, write concise self-service documentation, and mentor teammates on modeling and engineering best practices.
  • Experience using AI-assisted coding tools with the judgment to validate generated SQL, transformation logic, and documentation, prevent duplicated or inconsistent business logic, and independently explain and defend your design decisions.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

descriptionHtml:
Thirty Madison is now part of Remedy! You can read more about the acquisition here. We are excited to join forces and continue to revolutionize healthcare accessibility!

About the role

We're hiring a Senior Analytics Engineer within our centralized data team to own a core area of our data, such as financial performance, operations, or growth and retention, from raw sources through to the metrics leadership uses to make decisions. You'll build the dbt models and semantic layer behind those metrics. You'll also act as the analytical partner to the teams that rely on them.

This is a high-ownership role on a lean team that moves fast. Requirements often start ambiguous, and you'll be expected to find the highest-value problems before they reach anyone's roadmap.

Our stack: Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran and Hex

Comp | Perks | Benefits

  • The base pay range for this role is $160,000-$180,000
  • Potential to earn equity
  • Robust and affordable Medical, Dental, and Vision plan options
  • Flexible time off policy
  • Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

What you get to do every day

  • Own a functional data area. Be the lead analyst for a domain like finance or growth and retention, the first person stakeholders turn to for answers and insight. You'll own its models, metrics, analysis and roadmap.
  • Architect core data models. Design and maintain silver and gold layer models in dbt using Kimball dimensional modeling (facts and dimensions). These power segmentation, targeting, automation and analytics for your area.
  • Define and operationalize metrics. Turn company-wide metrics into governed, consistent definitions. Examples include retention, funnel conversion, LTV/CAC/ROAS and revenue.
  • Steward the semantic layer. Treat our BI tooling (Hex) as a product. Own semantic layer health, cross-team modeling standards and self-serve data products, beyond building dashboards on request.
  • Make the numbers trustworthy. Set standards for testing, documentation and freshness. Lead root-cause analysis on data discrepancies, then fix the underlying architecture so they don't recur.
  • Partner with the business. Turn ambiguous questions from Marketing, Growth, Finance and Product into clear requirements and scalable solutions. Work without dedicated PM support and use data to influence decisions.
  • Communicate clearly. Explain technical decisions, trade-offs and results to audiences from engineers to senior leadership. Set and manage expectations along the way.
  • Improve upstream data. Work with product and engineering on event taxonomy, instrumentation quality and consistency across app, web and backend.

What you bring to the role

  • 5+ years in analytics, analytics engineering, data engineering or a closely related role.
  • Deep SQL in a cloud data warehouse, ideally Snowflake. You use it to validate data quality, investigate anomalies and back your own analysis.
  • Production experience with dbt: modeling, testing, documentation and project structure.
  • Strong data modeling skills, including Kimball dimensional modeling (star schemas, slowly changing dimensions) and layered medallion architectures. You know when to break the rules.
  • Business and analytical judgment. You can tell which question matters and how to answer it, not just how to model it.
  • A track record of leading cross-team data initiatives, including gathering requirements yourself from technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Clear, confident communication with senior leadership, including pushing back and resetting expectations when needed.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a fast pace. You prioritize well and ship without waiting for perfect specs.
  • Hustle and a bias for action. You roll up your sleeves, do what the moment needs, whether that's a quick ad-hoc pull or a weekend fire drill on a broken pipeline, and follow through until it's done.

Bonus Points

  • Experience supporting Marketing, Growth, Sales or Product teams, such as attribution, paid media, funnels or retention.
  • Experience owning a BI platform or semantic layer (Hex, Looker, dbt Semantic Layer or similar) as a product.
  • Experience building semantic layers and documentation designed for AI and agentic workflows.
  • Familiarity with product analytics instrumentation and event tracking.
  • Background in consumer health, subscription or e-commerce businesses.

U.S. Applicants Only

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Remedy we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions. Contact us at recruiting@thirtymadison.com to request accommodation.

*This employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your I-9 Form information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.*

  • Please be aware that there are fraudulent entities who are falsely claiming to be or represent Remedy in order to solicit sensitive personal information or payment. Remedy is not in any way associated with these entities or practices. The safety and integrity of those seeking employment with us is of the utmost importance and we actively work with our legal and security teams to prevent future incidents.

Remedy will never ask for sensitive information or payment when engaging with job seekers. The entities use many methods to perpetuate these scams, including but not limited to: participating in a text-only interview, using Remedy's trademarks on their correspondence, or providing you with a seemingly legitimate offer letter. If you suspect you are a victim of this scamming, we encourage you to cease further contact and report the crime to The Federal Trade Commission.

descriptionHtml:
Make an Impact With Us

At Vallourec, we are seeking individuals whose passion and dedication match the strength and resilience of the steel we produce. The Data Analytics Engineer is part of the global Data & Analytics team and operates at the intersection of data engineering, business analytics and business intelligence. The role develops certified use-case datasets in the Gold layer, contributes domain metrics to the Semantic layer and builds reliable Power BI dashboards from validated business requirements. The position works closely with Data Engineers, Domain Specialists, the Semantic Layer & BI Lead, Data Governance, Data Product Owners and business stakeholders across regions and functions.

Your Role at a Glance

Analytics engineering and Gold-layer development

  • Develop and maintain certified use-case data models in dbt, including dimensional models, fact tables and reusable business metrics

Semantic layer and metric governance

  • Author domain metrics, dimensions, hierarchies and time-intelligence logic according to the approved framework, maintaining definitions and lineage

Business intelligence delivery

  • Build and optimize Power BI dashboards based on certified Gold data and governed semantic metrics

Quality, documentation and enablement

  • Implement automated data-quality tests, maintain technical documentation and support self-service adoption and training materials

Operational tasks

  • Develop and maintain the domain Use-case (Gold) layer in dbt, following approved modeling and naming standards
  • Build dimensional models, fact tables and business metrics from the Domain (Silver) layer
  • Implement and maintain dbt data-quality tests and achieve the agreed test-coverage targets
  • Document dbt models and publish the documentation and metadata in Unity Catalog
  • Coordinate data contracts between the Domain and Use-case layers with Data Engineers, including column types, refresh expectations and nullability
  • Escalate questions about Silver-layer business logic to the relevant Domain Specialist rather than independently redefining the logic
  • Create domain metrics in the semantic layer, including dimensions, hierarchies and time intelligence
  • Submit domain metrics and cross-domain definitions for review by the Semantic Layer & BI Lead before Gold certification
  • Maintain metric definitions, lineage and registry records
  • Build, test and optimize Power BI dashboards using certified Gold datasets and semantic metrics
  • Apply data-security requirements, including appropriate access controls and row-level security when required
  • Support business analysts and end users with self-service guidance and training materials. Management
  • No direct people management responsibility. Expected to coordinate technical work across business and technology stakeholders and contribute to peer reviews and knowledge sharing. Expected deliverables
  • Certified Gold-layer dbt models; tested and documented data products; governed semantic metrics; optimized Power BI dashboards; data contracts; lineage and metric documentation; user enablement materials

Tools

  • SQL, dbt, Databricks SQL, Unity Catalog, Power BI, DAX, Git, CI/CD pipelines and a semantic-layer framework such as MetricFlow or the approved platform equivalent

What Sets You Apart

We're looking for individuals who bring the right mix of experience, mindset, and motivation:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Analytics or a related field
  • Equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered
  • Training or certification in dbt, Power BI, Databricks, dimensional modeling or cloud data platforms is an advantage
  • Advanced SQL skills
  • Hands-on experience with dbt, including models, tests and documentation
  • Intermediate to advanced dimensional modeling, including fact tables, dimensions, grain and star schemas
  • Intermediate Power BI and DAX skills, including data modeling and report-performance optimization
  • Experience with Git-based version control and collaborative development practices
  • Working knowledge of data quality, metadata and lineage concepts
  • Experience with Databricks SQL and Unity Catalog
  • Experience with a semantic layer or metric framework such as dbt Semantic Layer / MetricFlow
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines for analytics engineering
  • Experience with data contracts and cross-domain metric governance
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric or cloud data platforms
  • Experience supporting self-service analytics and user enablement

What Powers Your Performance

Success in this role is driven by a strong mix of personal ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We value team members who possess:

  • 2+ years of experience in analytics engineering, business intelligence, data modeling or a closely related role
  • 2+ years of experience delivering analytics products in collaboration with data engineering and business stakeholders
  • 2+ years of experience working with governed datasets, reusable metrics and dashboard solutions in a corporate environment
  • Ownership and accountability for reliable, reusable data products
  • Strong collaboration between business and technology teams
  • Clear communication of technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Analytical thinking and structured problem solving
  • Attention to data quality, documentation and detail
  • Continuous-improvement mindset and willingness to challenge the status quo constructively
  • Ability to work in a global, cross-functional and multicultural environment

How We Support Your Success

We're committed to helping you thrive on the job and beyond. That's why we offer a collaborative culture where your ideas drive real change, and career mobility within a stable, essential industry. To support your growth and well-being, we also provide a comprehensive and competitive benefits program, including:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
  • Company-Paid Life Insurance & Short/Long-Term Disability
  • Profit Sharing: Up to 4%
  • 401(k): Company match 4.5% with no vesting period
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Paid Holidays: 10 days plus 1 floating holiday
  • Paid Vacation Time
  • Performance-Based Bonus Program
  • Tuition Reimbursement

Safety isn't negotiable, it's who we are. Every spark, every shift, and every decision is guided by a commitment that goes well beyond compliance. Protecting our people is more than a priority, it's a promise we make to every colleague, every day.

descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a strategic data professional to bridge the gap between complex infrastructure and actionable business intelligence for our Direct Sales leadership. This role is focused on resolving critical reporting delays by migrating legacy data pipelines into robust, real-time environments such as Databricks and SQL Server. By architecting advanced visualization tools and predictive models, the selected candidate will ensure stakeholders have the sub-minute accuracy needed to hit ambitious Starlink sales targets and modernize legacy processes through AI integration.

What Success Looks Like (Objectives)

  • Modernize and streamline the data lifecycle by migrating critical work order imports to Databricks and SQL Server to ensure 100% reporting reliability
  • Engineer high-performance SQL workflows that transform massive datasets into real-time operational insights with sub-minute precision
  • Deliver sophisticated Tableau visualizations that empower leadership to track KPIs and identify sales trends instantaneously
  • Design robust sales projection models for Starlink initiatives to proactively identify performance gaps and drive annual target attainment
  • Spearhead the integration of Generative AI tools into production, transforming call transcripts and coaching workflows into automated business intelligence
  • Champion data integrity by establishing rigorous cleansing strategies and auditing protocols across all Command Center functions

Core Skills, Competencies, and Key Experiences (What you’ll bring)

  • Advanced technical expertise in SQL performance tuning, CTEs, and complex data modeling within Tableau
  • Proficiency in architecting ETL automation and scripting via Python or PowerShell to eliminate manual bottlenecks
  • A detective-like aptitude for troubleshooting complex logic discrepancies and data delays in high-velocity environments
  • AI literacy with the capacity to apply modern Generative AI frameworks to solve legacy business problems
  • Strong collaborative skills required to translate high-level business requirements into scalable technical solutions for senior leadership
  • Extensive experience navigating and manipulating large-scale cloud data environments such as Databricks, Redshift, or Snowflake

Candidates must be willing to participate in at least one in-person interview.

Minimum Requirements

  • Minimum Education: Bachelor’s Degree in a business or STEM field (Information Systems, Math, Computer Science, Finance, etc.
  • Minimum Experience: 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering or Advanced Analytics
  • Required Technical Skills:
    • Advanced SQL (Stored Procedures and Performance Tuning)
    • Tableau (LOD calculations and Dashboard Optimization)
    • ETL/Automation processes
Visa sponsorship not available for this role

Salary Range

Compensation: $72,400.00/Year - $103,400.00/Year

About Our Department

Our Sales team advocates for our products and the customers they serve. We’ve built a loyal customer base by selling consumers, retailers, affiliate partners, distributors and industry stakeholders on the DISH brands with authenticity. The sales department is critical to driving demand and creating strategic partnerships across the industry.

About Our Company

EchoStar is reimagining the future of connectivity. Our business reach spans satellite television service, live-streaming and on-demand programming, smart home installation services, mobile plans and products.

Today, our brands include Boost Mobile, DISH TV, Gen Mobile, Hughes and Sling TV.

We offer meaningful health perks, including flexible spending accounts, HSA, a 401(k) plan with company match, employee stock purchase plan, career opportunities, and a flexible time away plan. Review a benefits summary here: EchoStar Benefits

Department: Data

Location: Remote

Description

Grasshopper Bank is a client-first, digital bank built for the business and innovation economy, with an obsession for providing leading-edge technology, solutions-driven products and superior service through a combination of passionate people and digital resources.

We are a highly experienced team who pride ourselves on diversity of thought and perspective. Nationally chartered, our portfolio of products and services range from VC, PE & Portfolio Companies to SBA Lending, as well as direct SMB and Embedded Banking.

Our entrepreneurial drive allows us to support the growth and success of a wide range of clients at every stage of their business through inclusive partnership. We seek out team members who will enable both our organization and our people to grow and thrive through collaboration and acting with integrity and respect.

Our focus on cross-functional teamwork provides a culture where ideas are valued, accountability is encouraged, and successes are celebrated. We welcome all those searching for the opportunity to contribute to banking innovation that influences and supports the emerging digital world of Financial Services.

Our digital first approach enables our teams the flexibility to work remotely. We have offices in NYC and Boston.

What You'll Do

As a Customer Analytics Engineer, you will operate at the intersection of modern data engineering, customer behavior analytics, and growth enablement. Reporting to the Director of BI & Analytics, you will serve as the technical engine and strategic architect behind our bank-wide Customer 360 and customer lifecycle analytics initiatives.

In this high-impact role, you will move beyond standard descriptive reporting to build the foundational data models, pipelines, and semantic layers that explain who our clients are, how they interact with our digital banking platforms, and what drives long-term customer lifetime value (LTV). You will be responsible for modeling complex customer event streams, digital touchpoints, and transaction histories into analytics-ready models in Google BigQuery, powering executive Tableau reporting and directly activating customer data downstream into marketing and engagement engines (such as Braze).

If you love writing clean, performant SQL/Python transformation logic, unraveling complex customer journeys, and partnering with Product and Marketing leaders to unlock top-line revenue, this role is for you.

  • Customer 360 & C-MDM Modeling: Design, build, and optimize scalable dimensional models (Kimball methodology) and One Big Table (OBT) datasets in Google BigQuery that unify core banking records, digital session logs, and touchpoints into a trusted, bank-wide customer master (C-MDM) and single source of truth.
  • Identity Resolution, Governance & Attribution: Establish robust customer identity mapping and multi-touch marketing attribution models across diverse platforms, while championing master data management (C-MDM) principles, data quality, and governance across all customer data pipelines.
  • Semantic Layer & Master Data Development: Formalize bank-wide customer entities, core segmentations, and Critical Data Elements (CDEs)—such as Active User definitions (DAU/MAU), primary operating account status, feature adoption, and dormancy thresholds—to align business and technical definitions under a unified C-MDM framework.
  • Scalable ELT Pipelines: Design, deploy, and maintain resilient ELT/ETL pipelines (using SQL, Python, and orchestration tools) to ingest, clean, and enrich raw customer interaction data, API payloads, and core snapshot tables.
  • Downstream Marketing & Activation Sync: Engineer reliable pipelines and reverse-ETL workflows that sync enriched customer traits, behavioral events, and engagement tiers directly into marketing automation platforms (e.g., Braze) and CRM systems to power automated lifecycle campaigns.
  • Data Quality & Observability: Implement automated testing, anomaly detection, and schema validation across customer data pipelines to guarantee platform accuracy, uptime, and alerting.
  • Customer Journey & Cohort Dashboards: Design and maintain intuitive, executive-ready Tableau dashboards focusing on customer acquisition funnels, retention curves, product penetration, churn indicators, and deposit velocity.
  • Storytelling with Data: Translate complex, multi-layered data into clear, actionable narratives that answer the "so what?" for business line leaders and product managers.
  • Performance Optimization: Continuously monitor and tune BigQuery queries and Tableau extracts to ensure rapid workbook performance and cost-efficient query processing.
  • Strategic Growth Partner: Collaborate closely with Marketing, Product, and Business Line leaders to translate business hypotheses into quantitative frameworks and tracking requirements.
  • Data Stewardship & Literacy: Champion data governance best practices, document customer data lineages and KPI definitions in the Data Steward Playbook, and coach end-users on self-service data discovery.

What You Need

  • Experience: 2–4+ years of hands-on experience in a hybrid data role such as Analytics Engineer, Customer Data Engineer, BI Developer, or Marketing Data Engineer. Prior experience in fintech, commercial banking, or digital banking platforms is preferred.
  • Advanced SQL & BigQuery: Expert-level SQL skills, including advanced analytical window functions, complex CTEs, array/struct unnesting, and performance tuning within cloud data warehouses (Google BigQuery strongly preferred).
  • Dimensional & Event Data Modeling: Strong experience with dimensional modeling, star schemas, and structuring behavioral/event-based data models (hands-on experience with dbt for modeling transformations and lineage is a strong plus).
  • Python & Pipeline Engineering: Demonstrated experience using Python for data transformation, API integrations, and workflow automation. Experience scheduling and orchestrating DAGs using tools like Apache Airflow or Google Cloud Composer is preferred.
  • Tableau Expertise: Deep proficiency in Tableau Desktop and Tableau Server/Cloud, including Level of Detail (LOD) expressions, parameters, and thoughtful dashboard UX/UI design principles.
  • Customer Analytics Acumen: Strong conceptual understanding of customer lifecycle metrics: Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Lifetime Value (LTV), cohort retention, and churn. Familiarity with reverse-ETL workflows or customer data activation is a plus.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Proven track record of presenting complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders and driving cross-functional alignment.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Mathematics, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

descriptionHtml:
About Faire

Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

About The Role

Are you passionate about using data and AI to shape the future of Faire's product features for small and medium businesses (SMBs)? If so, we want to talk to you! We're looking for a technical leader in our team to work closely with Data Scientists, Product Analysts and Software Engineers to support product launches and roadmaps by designing and building data capabilities that inform and drive insights. You will lead the path in using AI to boost productivity and transform how analytical engineering operates—leveraging AI to streamline data pipeline development and operations, improve data consumption workflows, and automate routine analytical tasks. In this role, you'll see a direct link between your work, company growth, and user satisfaction. You'll work with A tier players, work with one of the richest data sets in the world, use cutting-edge technology, and see your efforts affect products and SMBs regularly.

Join us and be part of a team that values data-driven innovation and excellence.

What You Will Do

The ideal candidate will possess a perfect blend of analytics and data engineering expertise, along with strong skills in developing and supporting large-scale, high-performance data storage and processing systems. They should have a proven track record of collaborating with key stakeholders to execute on company-wide data initiatives.

  • Lead cross-team and/or multi-phase projects from design through implementation, fostering collaboration with cross-functional partners.
  • Lead the technical execution in building scalable data models and pipelines for a domain defining the architecture, feature requirements, roadmap.
  • Build data pipelines with rigorous approaches to data quality, validation, testing, and observability.
  • Redefine how we build, maintain, and scale data systems by embedding AI into our daily workflows.
  • Optimize processes for operational excellence in project management and system reliability.
  • Ensure security standards are met within data systems and workflows.
  • Ensure and promote data quality standards for accurate and reliable insights.
  • Embrace emerging technologies with enthusiasm.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4+ years experience in analytics & data engineering roles focused on data modeling, large-scale data processing, and tool development for analytics or data science use cases.
  • Demonstrated communication and leadership skills, with a history of initiating and steering successful projects across multiple stakeholders.
  • Production-level development experience in Python.
  • Strong SQL skills with demonstrable competencies in designing well-architected data models and optimizing query performance.
  • Deep experience and knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ETLs, big data technologies, and analytics platforms.
  • Experience with Airflow, Docker, DBT or similar analytics workflow tools.
  • BA/BS degree in Computer Science, Math, Physics, or a related technical field.

Salary Range

California: the pay range for this role is $196,000 to $269,500 per year.

This role will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Actual base pay will be determined based on permissible factors such as transferable skills, work experience, market demands, and primary work location. The base pay range provided is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Hybrid Faire employees currently go into the office 3 days per week on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and a third flex day of their choosing (Monday, Wednesday, or Friday). Additionally, hybrid in-office roles will have the flexibility to work remotely up to 4 weeks per year. Specific Workplace and Information Technology positions may require onsite attendance 5 days per week as will be indicated in the job posting.

Why you’ll love working at Faire

  • Flexible paid time off, plus company-wide recharge days
  • Paid parental leave up to 16 weeks
  • Comprehensive health coverage, with options varying by location
  • Fertility and family-building benefits through Carrot, including a lifetime reimbursement allowance
  • Mental health support and coaching through Modern Health
  • Stipends to support your professional development, wellness, and work from home needs
  • Employer-sponsored retirement plan, dependent on country of employment

Faire was founded in 2017 by a team of early product and engineering leads from Square. We’re backed by some of the top investors in retail and tech including: Y Combinator, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Forerunner Ventures, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Founders Fund, and DST Global. We have headquarters in San Francisco and Kitchener-Waterloo, and a global employee presence across offices in Toronto, London, and New York. To learn more about Faire and our customers, you can read more on our blog.

companySlogan: The context engine for agents
descriptionHtml:
Merge is the connectivity layer for AI. Frontier AI labs, Fortune 500 enterprises, and fast-growing software companies use Merge to connect AI to the tools and data it needs to do real work.

Our platform has two product lines. Merge for Products gives teams shipping AI features everything they need in one setup: integrations with their customers' systems, secure tools for agents, and routing across the major LLMs. Merge for Workforce helps IT and security leaders bring AI to every employee safely, pushing approved models, tools, and skills into Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and more, with identity, audit logs, and spend visibility on every call. Our Universal Context Layer gives those AI tools permission-aware access to company knowledge, so agents stop starting from scratch.

Thousands of companies, including OpenAI, Perplexity, Dropbox, Zoom, Runway, and Factory, trust Merge to ship AI faster, govern it at scale, and save engineering resources so they can focus on their core product.

We're hiring an Analytics Engineer to own the data foundation behind how Merge understands its products, customers, and business. An analyst answers a question and then works out how to repeat it. You'll build the systems that make sure no one answers it by hand again. You think in systems and code: models, pipelines, tests, failure modes, and freshness that teams can rely on. You'll work with Engineering and partner with Finance, RevOps, Product, and GTM to turn changing business concepts into precise definitions and trusted data products. If you want to build the models from first principles, this is the role.

What Will You Do

  • Own and evolve dbt models across our product data and other internal systems.
  • Maintain shared dimensions, facts, transformations, and metrics as source systems and business requirements change.
  • Partner with domain experts to define company metrics, reconcile competing definitions, and consolidate duplicated business logic into trusted, reusable models.
  • Add tests for uniqueness, completeness, relationships, business rules, and important edge cases. Improve documentation, lineage, and discoverability.
  • Partner with Engineering on source contracts, data quality, freshness, warehouse performance, and issues that start upstream.

What experience is required?

  • Degree in data science, computer science, statistics, or a similar quantitative field.
  • 3+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, data science, business intelligence, or a related data role.
  • Advanced SQL, production experience with dbt or similar, and strong dimensional modeling (grain, facts, dimensions).
  • Strong engineering habits: version control, modular design, code review, automated testing, and documentation. Working proficiency in Python. You own the correctness of every model whether you wrote the code or an AI assistant did.
  • Comfort defining and building net-new models, metrics, and processes where definitions are still taking shape.
  • Clear communication with technical and non-technical partners, and sound prioritization across competing requests.

Nice to have

  • Experience at a B2B SaaS or developer tools company.
  • Background working with append-only history, event data, or change data capture.
  • Hands on experience with data contracts, lineage, observability, or automated data-quality monitoring.
  • Familiarity with LLM and AI infrastructure data, or a genuine interest in learning it fast.

Compensation

  • The cash compensation range for this role is $160K-$200K
  • Actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications. In addition to cash compensation, all employees receive an equity compensation package.

companyDescription:
Lovable is a platform that lets you build apps and websites by chatting with AI.

We are a small European team of serial founders, product engineers, physicists, competitive programmers and people who just care about building a great product quickly.

We're on a mission to build the last piece of software that the world will ever need.
descriptionHtml:
TL;DR - We’re seeking an Analytics Engineer to own the data foundations that fuel the GTM teams: building reliable models, shaping metrics, powering automation, and turning raw data into the insights and data products that drive Sales and Customer Success.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What We're Looking For

We’re looking for an Analytics Engineer with a background in Data Engineering or Analytics Engineering who operates as a true full-stack analyst, owning everything from raw data to insights to operationalization.

You bring:

  • Strong SQL and analytical data modeling skills (ideally dbt or SQLMesh).
  • Experience with ELT/ETL workflows and cloud warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks).
  • Comfort with Python for automation and light data engineering.
  • Experience with dashboards, BI tools, and self-serve analytics.
  • Clear communication, collaboration, and comfort working in ambiguity.
  • Nice to have: experience with AI/LLM products, instrumentation, experimentation, or early-stage startups.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with Sales and CS on data and reporting needs. Translate ambiguous business questions into structured data models, analysis and actionable insights, and data-fueled products.
  • Build and maintain data warehouse models that serve as the source of truth for product usage and GTM metrics.
  • Model CRM data, usage data, and billing data to power Sales and CS automation, CRM enrichment, lead definition and creation, and GTM tooling.
  • Design metrics, dashboards, and data UIs in Hex and Lovable for GTM leadership and teams to access and operationalize data.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering on event instrumentation and schema design.
  • Improve documentation, observability, governance, and data best practices.
  • Contribute to forecasting models, KPI definitions, and experimentation frameworks.
  • Own and improve data pipelines, ingestion workflows, and data quality testing.

You’ll thrive here if you

  • Enjoy building clean, reliable, reusable data models.
  • Have experience partnering closely with cross-functional GTM teams to solve real problems with data.
  • Prefer simplicity over complexity in data and tooling design.
  • Communicate clearly and proactively with technical and non-technical teams.
  • Take ownership, move quickly, and iterate often.
  • Want to help define and scale Lovable’s data foundations and culture.
  • Care about the rep experience and view analytics as a product.

How We Hire

  • Fill in a short form then jump on an initial exploratory call.
  • Discuss your experience in more depth during a round of interviews with us.

About Your Application

  • Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
  • We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal.

Compensation:

For sales roles, this range reflects On-Target Earnings (OTE), which includes both annual base salary and target sales commissions or bonuses.

Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as the candidate’s experience, qualifications, location, and applicable market conditions. Only US ranges are shown for this role.

Compensation Range: $141,500 - $192,000 USD

Compensation Range: $141.5K - $192K

descriptionHtml:
Who are we and why should you join us?

BetterHelp is on a mission to remove the traditional barriers to therapy and make mental health care more accessible to everyone. Founded in 2013, we are now the world’s largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy across the globe. Our network of over 30,000 licensed therapists has helped millions of people take ownership of their mental health and change their lives forever. And we’re not stopping there – as the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.

As a Senior Analytics Engineer at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of licensed clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. And as a mental health company, we take employee mental health just as seriously as we do our mission. We deeply invest in our team’s well-being and professional development, because we know that business and individual growth go hand-in-hand. At BetterHelp, you’ll carve your own path, make an immediate impact, and be challenged every day – with a supportive community behind you the whole way.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help us build best-in-class data products that deliver high-quality, trustworthy data and keep pace with our accelerated growth. These products must be built and maintained using best practices so they stay scalable and earn stakeholder trust as we grow in both size and scope. This person will work cross-functionally with technical and business stakeholders across the company, and will optimize our data stack to deliver trustworthy, discoverable, impactful data, served to both people and the AI tools they increasingly rely on.

What will you do?

  • Employ your strong SQL and data modeling skills to propose, design, and build trusted tables in our data warehouse via dbt, serving as a single source of truth for business intelligence, data science, and machine learning use cases.
  • Lead end-to-end dimensional modeling efforts, from requirements gathering through implementation, testing, and delivery, creating high-quality data experiences and collaborating directly with stakeholders to support their analytical success.
  • Design and extend our semantic layer: the governed, metric-driven interface (built as Snowflake semantic views in dbt) that powers Looker and our natural-language BI chatbot, so stakeholders and AI agents get the same trusted answer to the same question. This includes defining canonical metrics, relationships, and verified queries grounded in real business questions.
  • Use your experience with business partners and your empathy for users to translate stakeholder needs into well-structured data models and downstream experiences in Looker.
  • Act as a subject matter expert (SME) for cross-functional teams, enabling data-driven decision-making through dashboards, self-serve tooling, and ad-hoc analyses, especially for data-forward teams like marketing, international growth, and insurance.
  • Uphold data governance and privacy in a healthcare environment, applying PII/PHI classification, masking policies, and data contracts so our data assets stay trustworthy and protected as they scale.
  • Build for performance and cost at "big data" scale, using incrementality patterns, sound warehouse and clustering choices, and query optimization so our models stay fast and efficient as volume grows.
  • Contribute to BetterHelp's data-driven culture by supporting self-service, improving data discovery and lineage, and fostering trust in our data assets.
  • Partner closely with data and machine learning engineers in our modern data stack, which includes dbt, Looker, Snowflake, Airflow, Snowplow, and Fivetran.
  • Enjoy great teamwork, collaborate with data-minded colleagues who care deeply about mental health, and take pride in building a world-class product that makes a difference in people's lives.

What will you NOT do?

  • You will NOT worry about "runway", "cash left", or "how much time we have until the next round". We have the startup DNA but we're fully backed and funded, all the way to success.
  • You will NOT be confined to your "job". You will get involved in product, marketing, business strategy, and almost everything we do.
  • You will NOT be bogged down by office politics, ego, or bad attitude. Only positive, pleasure-to-work-with people are allowed here!
  • You will NOT get yourself burned out. We work hard but we believe in maintaining a sustainable work/life balance. Really.

Can I work remotely?

Yes. We operate on PST and candidates in any time zone are welcome to apply. We ask employees to travel to our San Jose, CA office up to three times per year plus one company-wide offsite to collaborate in person and strengthen working relationships. Travel expenses are covered and reasonable accommodations are made for those under unique circumstances who cannot travel.

Requirements

  • At least 5 years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, data analytics, or a related field
  • At least 4 years of experience working with business intelligence (BI) tools, preferably Looker or Omni
  • At least 3 years of experience using dbt for in-warehouse data transformations
  • Strong technical abilities in SQL, including "big data" scale query design, incrementality patterns, and performance optimization
  • Deep understanding of frameworks and tradeoffs in building analytical data models (for example star schemas, analytics-ready design patterns, and dimensional modeling)
  • Excellent communication skills, strong attention to detail, and effective time management
  • Experience providing mentorship, supporting collaborative development, and conducting team pull request (PR) reviews
  • Strong knowledge of data testing, including assertion design, coverage, orchestration, and data contracts
  • Experience with version control using Git in a collaborative team environment
  • Authorized to work in the U.S.

Bonus (Great To Have, But Not Required)

  • BS/MA in a quantitative discipline such as Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or Engineering
  • Significant experience with dimensional modeling, including building fact and dimension tables at "big data" scale using Kimball-style or denormalized design patterns
  • Experience building or maintaining a semantic or metrics layer (for example Snowflake semantic views, the dbt Semantic Layer, or LookML as a semantic layer), or otherwise designing data for AI and natural-language analytics
  • Familiarity with data privacy and governance in a regulated or healthcare setting
  • Hands-on experience with data pipelines and analytics using a scripting language, preferably Python
  • Background working with web-based B2C products, especially in healthcare or marketing analytics
  • Experience serving as an agile or technical lead within a data-driven organization
  • Strong familiarity with stream event analytics and web event tracking tools (for example Snowplow, Mixpanel, or Amplitude)

Benefits

  • Remote work with regular in-person bonding experiences sponsored by the company
  • Competitive compensation
  • Holistic perks program (including free therapy, employee wellness, and more)
  • Excellent health, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution
  • The chance to build something that changes lives – and that people love
  • Any piece of hardware or software that will make you happy and productive
  • An awesome community of co-workers

The base salary range for this position is $135,000 - $155,000. In addition to the base salary, this position is eligible for a performance bonus and the extensive benefits listed here (subject to eligibility requirements): Teladoc Health Benefits 2025. Total compensation is based on several factors – including, but not limited to, type of position, location, education level, work experience, and certifications. This information is applicable to all full-time positions.

We never have and never will discriminate against any job candidate or employee due to age, race, ethnicity, religion, sex, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, medical condition, marital status, parental status, disability, or Veteran status.

Notice To Candidates

BetterHelp has been made aware of fraudulent job postings and unaffiliated third parties posing as our recruiting team – please know that we have no affiliation or connection to these situations. We only post open roles on our career page (betterhelp.com/careers) or reputable job boards like our official LinkedIn or Indeed pages, and all official BetterHelp recruitment emails will come from the domain @betterhelp.com. Our commitment is to ensure a safe and transparent hiring experience for all candidates. We will never ask you for money, gift cards, or any form of payment during our hiring process, and we will never send money or checks to candidates. If you experience this, it is a scam.

descriptionHtml:
Welcome to Fi.

We’re a passionate team from Square, Google, Oura, Peloton, Uber, and more working to transform the human-pet relationship. Our mission? Develop cutting-edge technology to revolutionize what it means to be a pet parent. The pet industry remains firmly stuck in the past and we are here to change that. Fi is leveraging our team's talent and expertise to improve the lives of millions of pets in the U.S. Real-time location tracking, activity, sleep and behavior monitoring - and that's just the beginning.

The most exciting aspect of our work? Bridging the communication gap between pets and humans. Imagine a world where everyone knows how their pet feels in real time and how to keep their best friend in good shape. That's the future we're building at Fi.

If you're someone who thrives in innovative, collaborative work environments and feels strongly about helping pets live longer, better lives, Fi could be the perfect fit. Join us in our pursuit of the “impossible,” or as we call it here “let me find a way,” to redefine the future of pet ownership together.

Fi is looking for a Lead Analytics Engineer!

Fi is looking for a Lead Analytics Engineer to take ownership of the data layer that powers how we understand our business. You’ll design the models, own the BI platform, and make the architectural calls that shape how our data stack grows, with the autonomy to set direction and the accountability to see it through.

What You'll Do:

  • Design and maintain Fi’s dbt models in our medallion architecture on Databricks
  • Fully own the BI platform, from the data layers underneath to the final product teams use every day
  • Help shape how our transformation and BI layers evolve, in partnership with Data Engineering
  • Build the subscription data foundation that powers acquisition, retention, churn, LTV, and cohort analysis and connect it to a complete collar telemetry picture (activity, sleep, location)
  • Dig into the toughest analytics questions across the business and turn the answers into self-serve tools
  • Set the standard for testing, documentation, and data quality so the numbers are never in question
  • Lead the evaluation and rollout of new tools when they make the stack meaningfully better


What You'll Bring:

  • 8+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI, with meaningful time at a DTC subscription or device / tracking based business
  • Deep data modeling experience, including hands-on ETL and medallion architecture development
  • A track record of owning the data layers behind a BI tool, including leading a rollout and owning the final product
  • Expert SQL and strong command of modern cloud data stacks
  • Fluency in subscription metrics and the modeling it takes to get them right
  • The judgment to make architectural decisions independently and stand behind them
  • Real curiosity about hard analytics problems and a drive to make data self-serve, not ticket-driven


Why You'll Love Us:

  • Time to Recharge: Enjoy flexible PTO to take the breaks you need
  • Top-Notch Health Coverage: We’ve got your back (and teeth and eyes) with full medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Wellness Perks: Free access to One Medical, Kindbody, and Talkspace to keep you feeling your best
  • Dog-Friendly Office: Bring your pup to work — they’re part of the team, too
  • Give Back to the Pups: Make tails wag with a $500 annual donation to a dog charity of your choice through our BarkBack Program
  • Free Fi Membership: Your furry best friend(s) get all the benefits of a Fi collar, on us!
  • Love for Friends + Family: Share the Fi magic with loved ones through our gifting program


The anticipated base salary range for this position is $140,000-$210,000. Actual compensation will vary based on multiple factors, including skills, experience, market conditions, and role scope, which may evolve during the hiring process. As a fast-growing Series B startup, Fi evaluates compensation opportunistically to align with the right candidate. This role is also eligible for equity compensation.

Fi is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Fi makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and our needs at the time.

Zocdoc is the healthcare access infrastructure that connects patients to great care. By powering seamless scheduling wherever patients are seeking care, Zocdoc helps them move from being stuck to being seen. Each month, millions of patients find and book appointments with providers, powered by Zocdoc—on the company’s website and app, and across online search, insurance directories, providers’ websites, practice phone lines, AI platforms, and more—with the typical appointment happening within 24 to 72 hours from booking. 

With nearly two decades of experience unifying healthcare’s fragmentation, Zocdoc is uniquely positioned to power access across insurance plans, EHRs and PMS systems, specialties, visit types, and provider organizations of every size. By fixing healthcare at the start, Zocdoc empowers patients to get the care they need, when they need it, while delivering scaled patient growth providers can count on.
companySlogan: Zocdoc is the healthcare access infrastructure that connects patients to great care, everywhere they search.
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.

We’re here to give power to the patient.

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

Your Impact on our Mission

Zocdoc is seeking a Staff Analytics Engineer to join a centralized team responsible for defining, creating, and maintaining a scalable and robust analytics layer that powers Zocdoc’s strategic analytics, operations, and reporting capabilities. As a Staff-level member, you'll lead the design and implementation of complex data transformations and production-grade data models, establishing standardized datasets that drive critical decision-making across the organization. Collaborating closely with Product Management, Product Engineering, Data Engineering, and Analytics teams, you'll ensure data solutions are strategically aligned, efficient, and consistently reliable, enabling teams across Zocdoc to rapidly gain meaningful insights from high-quality data.

You’ll enjoy this role if you are…

  • Excited about designing and building strategic data products that drive impactful outcomes across the entire organization
  • Passionate about solving complex, high-impact problems using data and analytics at scale
  • Committed to setting a high bar for technical excellence and continuously improving whatever you're working on
  • A collaborative leader who enjoys working cross-functionally in a supportive and highly cooperative environment
  • Enthusiastic about architecting scalable data solutions using cutting-edge technologies to support long-term business strategies

Your day to day is…

  • Defining and enabling trusted, strategic datasets and analytics solutions that empower data consumers to quickly and reliably gain insights at scale
  • Leading efforts to enhance self-serve analytics across the organization through advanced administration, adoption strategies, and training for analytics tools (Looker and Amplitude)
  • Partnering strategically with analysts, product managers, and product engineers to ensure the analytics infrastructure meets evolving business requirements and is robust and maintainable
  • Architecting and developing production-grade data transformations and models using SQL, DBT, and Dagster, ensuring optimal performance, maintainability, scalability, and reliability
  • Collaborating closely with data engineering on strategic infrastructure initiatives to enhance data ingestion, processing pipelines, and integration of new data sources
  • Driving the establishment and continuous improvement of standards around data governance, security, privacy, quality, and retention, influencing best practices across the organization

You’ll be successful in this role if you have…

  • 6+ years of experience as an analytics engineer, data engineer, or similar role
  • 3+ years of experience using DBT & DBT Core, with a strong understanding of data modeling and data warehousing concepts
  • Expertise in writing performant SQL, especially within cloud-based data warehouses like Snowflake, and have strong Looker developer skills, with an emphasis on LookML modeling and overall project design
  • Experience managing the administration and/or adoption of data visualization tools (e.g. Looker) and event-based analytics/user journey tools (e.g. Amplitude)
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and work with urgency in a fast-moving environment with multiple stakeholders
  • Good communication skills across all levels of stakeholders (business & technical) with the ability to influence and build consensus
  • Proficiency with Python
  • Experience with Dagster or other orchestration tools
  • Experience utilizing AI Codegen to improve the efficiency of your workflow
  • Experience with data governance principles, KPI management, and supporting data operations for business intelligence

Benefits

  • Flexible, hybrid work environment at our convenient Soho location
  • Unlimited Vacation
  • 100% paid employee health benefit options (including medical, dental, and vision)
  • Commuter Benefits
  • 401(k) with employer funded match
  • Corporate wellness program with Wellhub
  • Sabbatical leave (for employees with 5+ years of service)
  • Competitive paid parental leave and fertility/family planning reimbursement
  • Cell phone reimbursement
  • Catered lunch everyday along with beverages and snacks
  • Employee Resource Groups and ZocClubs to promote shared community and belonging
  • Great Place to Work Certified

Zocdoc is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Salary ranges are determined through alignment with market data. Base salary offered is determined by a number of factors including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skills. Certain positions are also eligible for variable pay and/or equity; your recruiter will discuss the full compensation package details.

NYC Base Salary Range

$180,000—$250,000 USD

About Us

Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world’s leading investors, and we believe we’re still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish.

Zocdoc is a mission-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. In the spirit of one of our core values - Together, Not Alone, we are a company that prides itself on being highly collaborative, and we believe that diverse perspectives, experiences and contributors make our community and our platform better. We’re an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Applicants are considered for employment regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or any other class protected by applicable laws.

companyDescription:
Lovable is a platform that lets you build apps and websites by chatting with AI.

We are a small European team of serial founders, product engineers, physicists, competitive programmers and people who just care about building a great product quickly.

We're on a mission to build the last piece of software that the world will ever need.
descriptionHtml:
TL;DR - We’re seeking an Analytics Engineer to own the data foundations that fuel the GTM teams: building reliable models, shaping metrics, powering automation, and turning raw data into the insights and data products that drive Sales and Customer Success.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What We're Looking For

We’re looking for an Analytics Engineer with a background in Data Engineering or Analytics Engineering who operates as a true full-stack analyst, owning everything from raw data to insights to operationalization.

You bring:

  • Strong SQL and analytical data modeling skills (ideally dbt or SQLMesh).
  • Experience with ELT/ETL workflows and cloud warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks).
  • Comfort with Python for automation and light data engineering.
  • Experience with dashboards, BI tools, and self-serve analytics.
  • Clear communication, collaboration, and comfort working in ambiguity.
  • Nice to have: experience with AI/LLM products, instrumentation, experimentation, or early-stage startups.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with Sales and CS on data and reporting needs. Translate ambiguous business questions into structured data models, analysis and actionable insights, and data-fueled products.
  • Build and maintain data warehouse models that serve as the source of truth for product usage and GTM metrics.
  • Model CRM data, usage data, and billing data to power Sales and CS automation, CRM enrichment, lead definition and creation, and GTM tooling.
  • Design metrics, dashboards, and data UIs in Hex and Lovable for GTM leadership and teams to access and operationalize data.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering on event instrumentation and schema design.
  • Improve documentation, observability, governance, and data best practices.
  • Contribute to forecasting models, KPI definitions, and experimentation frameworks.
  • Own and improve data pipelines, ingestion workflows, and data quality testing.

You’ll thrive here if you

  • Enjoy building clean, reliable, reusable data models.
  • Have experience partnering closely with cross-functional GTM teams to solve real problems with data.
  • Prefer simplicity over complexity in data and tooling design.
  • Communicate clearly and proactively with technical and non-technical teams.
  • Take ownership, move quickly, and iterate often.
  • Want to help define and scale Lovable’s data foundations and culture.
  • Care about the rep experience and view analytics as a product.

How We Hire

  • Fill in a short form then jump on an initial exploratory call.
  • Discuss your experience in more depth during a round of interviews with us.

About Your Application

  • Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
  • We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal.

Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as the candidate’s experience, qualifications, location, and applicable market conditions. Only US ranges are shown for this role.

About Us

Public is the world’s first agentic brokerage, combining a comprehensive multi-asset investing experience with all the advantages of AI Agents.

Members can invest in stocks, options, bonds, crypto, and event contracts, and manage a variety of accounts including their personal brokerage, margin, retirement accounts, and business accounts—all in the same place.

Since 2019, Public has raised $400 million. Investors include Accel, Tiger Global, Will Smith's Dreamers VC, The Chainsmokers' Mantis VC, as well as renowned figures in business and culture, like Maria Sharapova, Tony Hawk, and NYU Stern professor Scott Galloway.

About The Role

As a key member of Public's data team, you will own the development and optimization of our semantic layer and the data models behind it. Working with stakeholders across product, marketing, finance, CX, and brokerage ops, you'll use SQL and dbt to build reliable pipelines, define the company's core metrics once, and make them usable by people and AI agents alike. Your work will directly shape how Public makes decisions, from daily business reporting to product experiments.

This role is based in New York City and reports directly to the Director of Data.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain centralized company metrics and data models in dbt and our Omni semantic layer, so every team works from the same definitions
  • Partner with product, finance, marketing, CX, and brokerage ops to turn business questions into well-modeled, self-serve data
  • Work with frontend and backend engineers to define data contracts and event tracking, and model eventstream data from app, backend, and Braze sources
  • Design and build Omni dashboards and reports for key metrics and KPIs
  • Make our data AI-ready: curate models, descriptions, and topics so teams can get accurate answers through Claude and other AI agents
  • Run analyses that improve product and business metrics, using visualization, experimentation, backtesting, and data science methods
  • Participate in code reviews and give feedback to keep our codebase high-quality and maintainable
  • Feed data-driven recommendations back to lifecycle marketing and backend systems through automated reverse ETL pipelines (Hightouch, Segment)
  • Maintain, optimize, and improve Public's data infrastructure across dbt, Omni, Snowflake, Fivetran, Airflow, and Hightouch

Experience

  • 3–5 years of experience in analytics engineering, business intelligence, or data analytics, preferably in finance, brokerage, or fintech
  • Hands-on experience building production data models in dbt
  • Familiarity with data modeling techniques such as Kimball dimensional modeling and star schemas
  • Strong SQL and the ability to write efficient queries on a cloud warehouse (Snowflake preferred; Redshift or BigQuery also relevant)
  • Experience with Omni or other modern BI tools with a semantic layer (e.g. LookML)
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor in your data work, such as writing and refactoring dbt models, debugging pipelines, and speeding up analysis
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions
  • Clear communicator who can present data-driven narratives in writing and in person
  • Quick learner who can grasp the fundamentals of the business and the key drivers behind company metrics
  • Investigative mindset; willing to think outside the box and contribute ideas across business functions

Bonus Points

  • Interest in personal finance and investing
  • Experience in a fast-paced startup, especially in fintech or consumer brands
  • Experience with modern ingestion and orchestration tools (Fivetran, Airflow) and reverse ETL (Hightouch, Segment)
  • Experience modeling product event data (Segment, Braze, or similar) and defining tracking plans or data contracts
  • Experience building AI agents or tools on top of data (e.g. MCP servers, text-to-SQL)
  • Demonstrated interest or experience applying machine learning to business problems, including on Snowflake ML
  • Proficiency in Python
  • Expertise in marketing attribution and performance measurement

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $150,000 to $190,000 plus equity, depending on skills and experience.

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans
  • Generous PTO and parental leave policy
  • 401(k) plan with company match
  • Opportunities for career growth and professional development

Public is an equal employment opportunity employer to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. We celebrate people of all race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or expression.
