Build analytics foundations that power smarter decisions.


You play a key role in shaping the technology backbone behind Resmed’s advanced analytics ecosystem. As a Senior Analytics Engineer, you’ll design, optimize, and automate scalable enterprise analytics platforms that enable business and clinical teams to make data-driven decisions confidently. Working closely with Data Engineering and Analytics teams, you’ll build Tableau environments that deliver reliable insights, streamline reporting, and integrate seamlessly across systems including Snowflake, Salesforce Cloud, and Tableau Cloud.

Your expertise in Tableau architecture, performance tuning, and Python-based automation will help transform complex data infrastructure into efficient, secure, and high-performing analytics experiences across the organization.

This position may be based in Peachtree Corners, GA; San Diego, CA; or Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada. Relocation assistance is not available for this position.

What You’ll Do

CI/CD & Deployment


  • Design and implement CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions to automate the deployment of Tableau dashboards, SQL scripts, and Python code.
  • Establish standards for source control, testing, and release management to ensure reliable and consistent analytics delivery.


Tableau Architecture


  • Build scalable Tableau architecture supporting enterprise reporting, and governed data use across teams.
  • Define and maintain standards for Tableau Cloud configuration, data models, permissions, and refresh processes.


Dashboard Optimization & Performance


  • Enhance dashboard performance by optimizing data sources, extracts, and queries for efficient load and user experience.
  • Apply performance monitoring and best practices to identify and resolve bottlenecks across reports and infrastructure.


Tableau Infrastructure


  • Administer and maintain Tableau Cloud environments, including configuration, upgrades, monitoring, and capacity planning.
  • Implement robust security and access controls for effective governance across analytics assets.


Python & Automation


  • Develop Python automation tools for Tableau asset management, performance monitoring, and analytics workflows.
  • Build scripts to support seamless integration across Tableau, Snowflake, and Salesforce systems.


Data & Analytics Engineering


  • Collaborate with Data Engineering to design reusable pipelines and transformations supporting analytics scalability.
  • Translate analytical requirements into reliable, high-performing technical solutions.


What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data infrastructure, or BI platform development
  • Advanced proficiency in Tableau development, architecture, and dashboard optimization
  • Hands-on experience with Tableau Cloud/Server administration
  • Strong Python programming and automation skills
  • Practical experience with CI/CD processes and GitHub or GitLab workflows
  • Solid understanding of SQL and Snowflake
  • Familiarity working within SaaS or software product environments


What Sets You Apart

  • Systems Thinker - You connect data architecture, analytics, and automation into unified scalable platforms.
  • Operational Excellence - You care deeply about reliability, monitoring, and performance at every level.
  • Collaborative Partner - You engage cross-functional teams to deliver seamless analytical solutions.
  • Builder’s Mindset - You continually find ways to improve performance and automate manual processes.
  • Analytical Depth - You approach optimization and scalability challenges with a data-driven perspective.
  • Adaptive Problem Solver - You thrive in evolving technology environments and complex system integrations.


Why Join Resmed


At Resmed, your work directly supports our mission to empower millions of people with better health through innovative digital solutions. You’ll collaborate with talented engineers and data professionals who are passionate about creating technology that drives impact—from faster analytics pipelines to smarter insights across healthcare. We invest in your development, celebrate curiosity, and encourage creativity to advance how data shapes the future of connected care.

Benefits And Compensation

At Resmed, we're shaping the future by investing in our people through competitive pay, flexible work arrangements, and programs that support personal and professional growth.

Benefits (employees regularly scheduled to work 30+ hours per week) include:


  • Medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, and disability insurance
  • HSA, FSA, commuter benefits, and sleep care management
  • 401(k), ESPP, EAP, and tuition assistance
  • Flexible Time Off (FTO) for salaried employees
  • 14 paid company holidays
  • Up to 14 weeks primary caregiver leave or 2 weeks secondary caregiver leave


Compensation: Compensation is based on geographic location, qualifications, experience, skills, and internal equity. For positions outside the U.S., compensation is aligned to local market conditions. Resmed generally does not hire at or near the top of the pay range.

Pay Range: $133,000 - $166,000 USD Annual

Eligible employees may have the opportunity to participate in incentive compensation programs, subject to applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements.

Joining us is more than saying “yes” to making the world a healthier place. It’s discovering a career that’s challenging, supportive and inspiring. Where a culture driven by excellence helps you not only meet your goals, but also create new ones. We focus on creating a diverse and inclusive culture, encouraging individual expression in the workplace and thrive on the innovative ideas this generates. If this sounds like the workplace for you, apply now! We commit to respond to every applicant.

descriptionHtml:
About Us

BURLEBO is a growing brand in men's outdoor clothing, dedicated to providing high-quality, durable, and stylish gear for the Athlete, the Outdoors, and the Family. We are passionate about innovation, sustainability, and performance-driven apparel that empowers our team and customers to explore the great outdoors with confidence.

Role: Lead Data & Analytics Engineer

Overview

We’re looking for an experienced, proactive data professional to build and lead our data and analytics function from the ground up.

We have a growing data environment in GCP (BigQuery, Cloud SQL) across ecommerce, wholesale, and fulfillment systems (Shopify, ShipHero, NuOrder, etc.).

This is a foundational role. You will be the first dedicated data hire, responsible for bringing structure to our data, defining how we use it, and helping the company make better decisions.

You’ll work directly with leadership and collaborate with a small technical team, while also mentoring junior team members who will support analytics efforts over time.

Over time, this role is expected to grow into leading data team as the company scales.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys both building systems and developing people.

  • MUST BE ABLE TO WORK IN OFFICE: AUSTIN HQ**
  • ATTENTION: To be considered for position, YOU MUST fill out this survey.** https://go.cultureindex.com/p/PHBamIPqKwUaH

What You’ll Do

Build the Data Foundation

  • Own and improve our data environment in GCP (BigQuery, Cloud SQL)
  • Structure and model data across ecommerce, wholesale, and fulfillment systems
  • Define core company metrics and ensure consistency across teams
  • Identify and resolve data discrepancies across systems

Own Analytics & Reporting

  • Design and build dashboards used by leadership and operations
  • Establish standardized reporting across departments
  • Replace ad-hoc spreadsheet workflows with scalable solutions
  • Ensure data is accessible and understandable across the company

Drive Business Insights

  • Partner with leadership to define what we should measure and why
  • Analyze product performance, inventory trends, and customer behavior
  • Proactively surface insights that impact revenue, operations, and efficiency

Build & Develop the Data Function

  • Act as the owner of data and analytics within the company
  • Mentor and guide junior team members supporting analytics work
  • Establish best practices for data modeling, reporting, and governance
  • Help define the roadmap and structure for the future data team
  • Contribute to hiring and scaling the team over time

What We’re Looking For

  • 4–8+ years of experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, or similar roles
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with modern data warehouses (BigQuery preferred)
  • Experience building and owning dashboards used by business stakeholders
  • Experience working in environments with messy or evolving data
  • Proven ability to work independently and bring structure to ambiguity
  • Strong communication skills — able to translate data into business insights
  • Experience mentoring or guiding others (formal or informal)

Nice To Have (Not Required)

  • Experience in ecommerce or retail (Shopify, inventory, order data, etc.)
  • Familiarity with GCP (BigQuery, Cloud SQL)
  • Experience with dbt or data modeling frameworks
  • Basic Python for analysis or automation
  • Experience working across multiple operational systems (WMS, ERP, etc.)

What Success Looks Like

Within 6–12 months:

  • Core company metrics are clearly defined and trusted across teams
  • Data discrepancies across systems are identified and significantly reduced
  • Leadership has reliable dashboards for key decisions
  • Reporting is standardized and scalable (not ad-hoc)
  • Junior team members are contributing effectively under your guidance
  • A clear roadmap exists for how the data function will scale with the business

Growth Opportunity

This role is designed to evolve into a senior leadership position within the company.

As we scale, this person will have the opportunity to:

  • Build and lead a dedicated data team
  • Shape the company’s data strategy
  • Influence key decisions across operations, merchandising, and growth
  • Grow into a long-term leader within the technology organization

At Brooklinen, we believe great data helps us make better decisions and create better experiences for our customers. As an Analytics Engineer on our Analytics & Insights team, you’ll help build the foundation that makes that possible.

  • Turn business needs into data solutions. Partner with analysts, engineers, and teams across Brooklinen to build data models, dashboards, and measurement tools that answer important business questions.

  • Make data easier to use. Ingest, organize, catalog, and document datasets so teams can confidently find, understand, and use the information they need.
  • Solve problems from start to finish. Investigate data issues, identify what's causing them, and communicate findings and solutions clearly to technical and non-technical partners.

We're Looking For Someone Who Brings

  • 2–4 years of experience in analytics engineering or a similar role, with hands-on experience building and maintaining data models.
  • Strong SQL skills, preferably with experience using dbt or similar data modeling tools.
  • Experience building dashboards and reporting solutions in a BI tool like Omni, Looker, or something similar.
  • Experience partnering with cross-functional teams to understand business needs and translate them into practical technical solutions.
  • Experience working with marketing data in retail, e-commerce, or consumer goods is a plus.

Benefits & Perks

Great work deserves great support. From taking care of yourself and the people you love to making time for what matters outside of work, our benefits are here to support you through the different stages of life and career.

  • Health Coverage: Up to 100% medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees.
  • Family-building support: Up to $20,000 in reimbursement for fertility and family-building journeys.
  • Retirement savings: A 401(k) plan with a 4% company match.
  • Commuter benefits: Pre-tax benefits to help cover travel costs.
  • Product perks: 40% off Brooklinen products, 25% off for friends and family, and a product allowance.
  • Wellness support: Complimentary One Medical and Talkspace memberships, plus a flexible $1,000 annual wellness and lifestyle reimbursement through Joon.
  • Pet benefits: 10% off pet wellness and insurance plans through Wagmo, helping cover everything from routine care to unexpected vet expenses.
  • Parental leave: 16 weeks of fully paid leave for all new parents.

A home that feels like you. A career you can make your own.

Just as every home is shaped by those who live in it, Brooklinen is shaped by the ideas, creativity, and individuality of our team. We're curious about what's possible, open to new ways of thinking, and excited to build what's next together.

Here, you'll have the freedom to take ownership, bring your ideas to life, and make a meaningful impact alongside colleagues who care about their work and each other. Your perspective matters, and there's room to make your mark.

If this role excites you, even if you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply. Diverse experiences and backgrounds make us stronger.

Since 2014, we've been creating thoughtfully designed products that make everyday living more comfortable, personal and joyful. What started with better sheets has grown into a bigger ambition, making Brooklinen one of the largest soft goods brands in the U.S.

Along the way, we've earned more than 150,000 five-star reviews and recognition from Architectural Digest, Good Housekeeping and Wirecutter. We're proud of where we've been. And we're looking for people who want to help shape where we go next.

descriptionHtml:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

Preferred locations for team members for our Data Platform roles are our San Francisco or Seattle hubs.

About Superhuman

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company's products include Grammarly's writing assistance, Docs’ collaborative workspace, Mail's inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here.

The Opportunity

As a Data Engineer on the Business Unit (BU) Pod supporting Go, you’ll build the pipelines and data models that help us understand how people use Superhuman’s proactive AI assistant. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to give teams the data they need to improve the product and measure its impact.

Go helps people where they already work, through conversations, inline suggestions, and built-in and custom agents. Understanding how people use these experiences takes more than counting clicks. Your work will help teams see where users get stuck, which capabilities they find useful, and what brings them back. It will also help connect Go’s usage to customer adoption and business growth.

You’ll own projects and datasets with a clear scope, supported by experienced engineers. Most of your work will focus on production pipelines and reusable data models that teams can use to answer their own questions. You’ll also contribute analysis and dashboards when they help move a decision forward. As you learn the product and our systems, you’ll have opportunities to take on more complex work.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain production data pipelines in Databricks that process product events, user activity, and agent interactions across Go.
  • Develop datasets for onboarding, activation, engagement, retention, and conversion so teams can work from consistent metrics.
  • Work with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to define what needs to be measured, improve event logging, and check that new features are represented correctly in downstream data.
  • Make data models easy to understand and use, with clear definitions and documentation that support self-service through analytics and AI tools. Build focused analyses and dashboards when they help partners use the data or make a decision.
  • Connect Go usage with customer and account data to help teams understand adoption, customer value, and Go’s contribution to growth and revenue.
  • Keep the datasets you own accurate, up-to-date, and reliable. Add tests and monitoring, investigate discrepancies, and fix the underlying causes.
  • Improve pipeline and query performance, manage compute costs, and make the code you work on easier to maintain.

You’ll work alongside engineers and partners across Data Platform and Go. We care about understanding the problem, questioning assumptions, and following through when the answer takes some digging. You’ll contribute to design decisions and have teammates to turn to as you build your expertise.

Qualifications

  • You have 2+ years of experience building and operating production data pipelines, ideally for product analytics or other critical business use cases.
  • You’re highly proficient in SQL and have experience writing, debugging, and optimizing transformations in a modern lakehouse or cloud data warehouse such as Databricks or Snowflake.
  • You understand data modeling and warehouse design, and can turn complex source data into tables that others can understand and reuse.
  • You test your work carefully, investigate unexpected results, and trace data issues back to their source.
  • You have experience with workflow orchestration, version control, and deployment practices for data pipelines, using tools such as Databricks Workflows, Airflow, and Git.
  • You use AI-assisted development tools such as Codex, Claude Code, or Cursor, and take responsibility for testing and validating the code they produce.
  • You communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical partners. You can turn a product question into data requirements and explain the assumptions and limitations behind an answer.
  • You’re curious about how people use products and how your work can help teams make better decisions.
  • You follow your work through to production, break problems into manageable steps, raise risks and dependencies early, and ask for help when you need it.

Nice to have

  • Experience using Python and/or Spark for data transformations, pipelines, or automation.
  • Experience with product or growth analytics, including adoption funnels, retention, conversion, or A/B experiments.
  • Experience working with event logging and behavioral data from web, desktop, or mobile products.
  • Experience supporting AI products or agents, including measuring adoption, interaction quality, reliability, latency, or usage costs.
  • Experience building dashboards or other data tools that product, analytics, and business teams use to answer their own questions.

Compensation And Benefits

Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing the following and more:

  • Excellent health care (including a wide range of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and fertility benefits)
  • Disability and life insurance options
  • 401(k) and RRSP matching
  • Paid parental leave
  • 20 days of paid time off per year, 12 days of paid holidays per year, two floating holidays per year, and flexible sick time
  • Generous stipends (including those for caregiving, pet care, wellness, your home office, and more)
  • Annual professional development budget and opportunities

Superhuman takes a market-based approach to compensation, so base pay may vary by location. Our US locations are categorized into two compensation zones based on proximity to our hub locations.

For more information about our compensation zones and locations where we currently support employment, please refer to this page. If a location of interest is not listed, please speak with a recruiter for additional information.

Base pay may vary considerably depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The expected salary ranges for this position are outlined by compensation zone and may be modified in the future.

We encourage you to apply

At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all to apply—especially those whose identities are traditionally underrepresented in tech organizations. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, political belief, or any other characteristic protected by law. Superhuman is an equal opportunity employer and a participant in the US federal E-Verify program (US). We also abide by the Employment Equity Act (Canada).

Compensation Range: $117K - $205K

descriptionHtml:
🏆 Great Place to Work® Certified | USA

Harbor Compliance is a leading technology platform for entity compliance, helping more than 80,000 businesses and nonprofits manage licensing, tax registration, and legal entity requirements nationwide. Founded in 2012 and recognized repeatedly by the Inc. 5000 and Deloitte Technology Fast 500, we've grown through five strategic acquisitions — and are now backed by a 2026 majority growth investment from Bregal Sagemount to accelerate product, AI, and customer experience. We're a passionate team making compliance simpler and smarter for every organization we serve.

Harbor Compliance is launching its first company-wide data and analytics platform, pulling fragmented data from HubSpot, financial systems, and HRIS into one AI-augmented source of truth for a business that's scaling fast. Modern tools sit underneath and a shared metrics layer makes every number mean the same thing no matter who asks or which tool they ask in. As an Analytics Engineer, you'll join our Data Platform & Analytics team turning raw data into models, metrics, and dashboards the business leans on every day. You'll talk directly with stakeholders, pick up ambiguous problems and run with them, and have a real voice in how the team works.

Key Responsibilities

  • Model the business. Build and maintain clean, tested, documented dbt models in Snowflake, organized in clear staging, intermediate, and mart layers.
  • Partner with stakeholders. Work directly with teams across the company to understand what they're trying to accomplish, ask the questions behind the question, and steer requests toward something meaningful rather than just something requested.
  • Build the last mile. Create dashboards, explorations, and self-serve datasets in our BI tools so teams can answer their own questions with confidence.
  • Own metric and data governance. Define and maintain a shared set of metric definitions, document them, and resolve discrepancies when numbers don't match.
  • Keep the data trustworthy. Add tests, monitoring, and alerting so we find data issues before our stakeholders do, and help triage and fix them when they surface.
  • Work alongside data engineering. Collaborate on ingestion, warehouse performance, cost, and help define how raw data lands so downstream models stay reliable.
  • Ship like an engineer. Use Git, pull requests, code review, and CI to make changes safely and repeatedly.
  • Use AI to move faster. Apply AI tools in your daily workflow for writing and reviewing SQL, documentation, exploration, and debugging, and help the team figure out where AI genuinely helps and where it needs a human check.
  • Improve the program. Help define the best practices, standards, and documentation the team follows as we build out our analytics practice.

Requirements

  • 3–5 years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a similar role.
  • Strong SQL: fluent in CTEs and window functions, and able to untangle someone else's query.
  • Hands-on dbt and a cloud warehouse, ideally Snowflake, with a solid grasp of modeling patterns, testing, and documentation.
  • Python for data work and automation.
  • Experience with a modern BI tool (Metabase, Hex, Sigma, Omni, Looker or Tableau) and the speed to pick up the others.
  • Stakeholder fluency: you turn a vague ask into a defined problem, explain tradeoffs plainly, and push back when it helps.
  • Genuine curiosity about how the business works, because understanding the why is how you build things that get used.
  • A working grasp of metric governance, data governance, and observability.
  • Git workflows on GitHub or GitLab.
  • AI in your daily workflow, with the judgment to verify what it gives you.
  • Appetite for a fast-moving company where you'll often build the process yourself.
  • Nice to haves:
    • Airbyte or another ingestion/orchestration tool (ex: Airflow, Dagster)
    • Experience building a semantic layer (dbt Semantic Layer, Omni, LookML, or similar), especially one that serves both humans and AI agents.
    • Comfort with command line
Skills And Knowledge

  • Fluency with SQL and working knowledge of dbt + lakehouse workflows
  • Working knowledge of BI/Viz tools
  • Working knowledge of ELT/ETL tools (e.g., Fivetran, Airbyte) for batch use cases.
  • Working knowledge of data observability/reliability practices — automated alerting, lineage tracking.
  • Fluency with AI-augmented development tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to accelerate engineering and documentation.

Accommodations

Harbor Compliance is committed to providing any reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

Compensation

Harbor Compliance’s base salary range for this role is listed below. Compensation at the time of offer is based on factors such as skill set, experience, qualifications, and work location. Salary is one part of Harbor Compliance’s total compensation package. Other benefits may include health benefits, flexible paid time off, parental leave, fertility and adoption assistance, 401(k), and educational reimbursement. Note that the salary range and benefits apply only to U.S.-based candidates.

Pay Transparency Policy Statement

Harbor Compliance will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by Harbor Compliance, or (c) consistent with Harbor Compliance’s legal duty to furnish information.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Harbor Compliance is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.

Notice Regarding the Use of Selection Technology

Harbor Compliance uses third-party automated tools and skills assessments (such as Testlify and Rippling) to help evaluate job applications and streamline our hiring workflow. These tools assist our recruitment team in reviewing qualification trends and scheduling, but all final employment decisions are made solely by humans on our Talent Success team, and all tools are subject to human oversight.

Depending on your location, local laws may grant you specific disclosure rights or the option to request an alternative evaluation process. If you require a reasonable accommodation or wish to opt out of automated assessment steps due to regional regulations, please notify your recruiter. Opting out will not negatively impact your application.

The Pay Range For This Role Is

93,800 - 117,300 USD per year(US National)

Job Title: Senior Analytics Engineer

Location: Philadelphia, PA

Health Union powers the first and largest community-based activation and data platform, transforming healthcare by providing unparalleled support, information, and validation for millions navigating complex health conditions and their care teams. With over 125+ condition-specific online communities and 15 years of community leadership, Health Union’s authentic engagements fuel the company’s robust suite of endemic media, influencer marketing, market research, and data solutions, driving proven outcomes for patients, HCPs, and brands.

Position Overview

At Health Union, data is the foundation of how we understand our business and serve our communities. Our Analytics Engineering team turns raw data into trusted insights for decision-makers across the organization, working in a modern stack built on dbt and Snowflake, along with AI tools like Claude.

We’re looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to own work end to end: translating business requirements into robust, well-documented data models, then turning those models into intuitive AI-driven tools that stakeholders rely on. You’ll also partner with our Data Platforms team on everything from ingestion to transformation readiness, including building and evolving the data quality monitoring that catches issues before they reach a dashboard.

This is a highly collaborative role. You’ll work closely with business analysts and stakeholders across the organization to understand their needs and deliver data they can trust. If you enjoy pairing technical rigor with cross-functional partnership, we’d love to hear from you.

What You Do

Data Modeling & Transformation

  • Design, build, and maintain dbt models that power business intelligence and decision support across Health Union
  • Translate business requirements from analysts and stakeholders into well-structured, documented, and tested transformation logic
  • Partner with the Data Platforms team to define what data is extracted and loaded from source systems, and confirm it’s structured for clarity and usability
  • Contribute to architectural and design decisions with your team and manager

Semantic Layer Development

  • Build and maintain semantic models, including migrating existing BI data models into the semantic layer
  • Make sure AI tools generate accurate queries from natural-language business questions
  • Partner with analysts and stakeholders to confirm that AI-driven BI tools meet their analytic needs

Data Quality

  • Enhance our existing data quality monitoring so issues are caught before they reach business stakeholders
  • Build on our current dbt tests to design a more robust testing framework
  • Establish processes and standards that improve the reliability of data across the business

Collaboration & Issue Resolution

  • Serve as a senior technical resource for analysts and stakeholders, helping diagnose and resolve data issues
  • Raise the team’s technical bar through code review, documentation, and knowledge sharing
  • Manage and prioritize work transparently within the team’s Kanban process

Qualifications

What You Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering or a similar role
  • Advanced SQL skills in a cloud data warehouse environment; Snowflake experience preferred
  • Advanced dbt proficiency, especially in testing, documentation, and model design best practices
  • Deep knowledge of relational and dimensional data modeling, as well as data warehouse and BI system design principles
  • Proven ability to translate business questions and stakeholder needs into data models and reporting solutions
  • Experience with, or strong instincts for, data quality monitoring and observability
  • Hands-on use of AI tools, both to accelerate development and to solve business problems directly
  • Clear communication with technical and non-technical teams alike
  • Self-direction and strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage your own priorities

Nice to Have

  • Experience building semantic models or working with a semantic layer
  • Python scripting experience
  • Background in health, pharmaceutical, or online publishing data
  • Familiarity with Kanban or similar lightweight delivery frameworks

Annual base salary for positions at this level and job group is $95,000-$120,000, and your base pay will depend on the qualifications, experience, skills, and competencies required for this job.

At Health Union, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range that provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role.

In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan, a professional development budget, and paid time off available to full-time employees upon hire. You will also be granted time off for designated company-paid holidays, summer Fridays, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

HEALTH UNION REALLY IS THE BEST PLACE TO WORK

As a dynamic organization that offers flexible work options, we foster a workplace that encourages an authentic, respectful culture of teaching and learning. We work hard and save space to form close-knit relationships that are meaningful to us individually. Health Union also offers top-tier benefits and other perks to full-time employees, starting day one. We cultivate a dynamic, collaborative work environment that values inclusion, community, excellence, and transparency. But don’t just take our word for it: The Philadelphia Inquirer, Philadelphia Business Journal, Inc., and Forbes have all named Health Union a “best place to work”-and we take pride in living up to that hype every day.

Commitment to Inclusion

At Health Union, we believe that individually we make a statement, but collectively we make an impact. Diversity and inclusion power that impact. We strive to create a sense of belonging by embracing our differences. We are an organization where everyone is valued, heard, and appreciated. Health Union encourages applicants from historically marginalized populations to consider our team as your next opportunity for change. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and advancement regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or gender expression, Veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

To comply with federal law, Health Union participates in E-Verify. Successful candidates must pass the E-Verify process after hire.

The position offers a hybrid work arrangement, requiring a minimum of two in-office days per week. Our office is located in Center City, Philadelphia.

Applicants must be legally eligible to work in the U.S for any employer.

Description

AWS is seeking a Senior Business Intelligence Engineer III to lead analytics strategy for the Specialist Insights team, focused on Data and AI. This team operates at the intersection of data engineering and AI — building systems where intelligent automation handles the default case and human expertise focuses on exceptions, strategy, and novel problems.

Working closely with Data and AI Sales Operations leadership, the Senior BIE owns the end-to-end analytics architecture: data platforms, governance frameworks, self-service products, and the integration points where AI capabilities plug into the stack. This role defines how the team builds, sets technical standards others follow, and drives the evolution from traditional reporting toward systems that learn and scale. The ideal candidate has deep data engineering fundamentals, has worked with AI/ML in production or near-production contexts, and treats system design and organizational influence as equal parts of the job.

Key job responsibilities

  • Owns the architecture and technical roadmap for the team's analytics systems — data platforms, governance layers, self-service products, and the integration patterns that connect them to AI-powered downstream applications.
  • Designs and drives implementation of scalable data platforms: pipeline orchestration, automated quality monitoring, schema management, and infrastructure that supports both traditional BI and AI-native consumption patterns.
  • Architects governance frameworks that maintain data trust at scale: lineage, freshness enforcement, validation pipelines, ownership models, and content lifecycle practices — especially as AI systems become consumers of the team's data.
  • Builds and owns automated analytics systems — report generation, KPI monitoring, anomaly detection, insight delivery — designing for progressive automation where AI handles the routine and humans handle the exceptions.
  • Defines the team's AI tooling strategy: evaluates frameworks, builds shared infrastructure (prompt libraries, evaluation patterns, integration templates), and establishes practices that help the whole team work effectively with AI.
  • Drives cross-functional alignment on data product architecture; influences partner teams on integration patterns, API contracts, and standards for how data products interoperate across the ecosystem.
  • Makes technical decisions with broad impact: data modeling trade-offs, build-vs-buy on capabilities, migration strategies from legacy systems, and cost/performance optimization across the stack.
  • Applies advanced statistical and ML methods within production systems; ensures analytical rigor in automated outputs and designs experimentation frameworks that quantify business impact.
  • Mentors and levels up the team on data engineering craft, system design, governance thinking, and practical AI/ML application — raising the bar for what the team can build and maintain.
  • Communicates complex technical architecture and strategy to senior leadership; writes design documents that drive alignment, presents trade-offs clearly, and translates technical capability into business outcomes.

About AWS

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. The AWS Global Support team interacts with leading companies and believes that world-class support is critical to customer success. AWS Support also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission-critical applications on top of AWS services.

  • 4+ years of SQL, ETL or Oracle experience
  • 4+ years of processing large, multi-dimensional datasets from multiple sources experience
  • 4+ years of developing automated reporting experience
  • Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field
  • Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in scripting for automation (e.g. Python) and advanced SQL skills.

Job Summary

The Senior Data & AI Analytics Engineer's key objective is to own NC America's data from raw table to finished insight. They will turn raw game, player, and business data into clean, well-modeled summary tables, write the analysis themselves, and build the Tableau dashboards that teams across the company use to make decisions.

This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role that sits across data engineering, analytics, and AI. NC America is looking for someone who uses AI tools as a core part of how they work, building workflows that let one engineer support several projects at once without sacrificing quality. They'll set the standard for how data is modeled, documented, and used at NC America.

Essential Job Functions

The following section contains key work that will be performed. NC is a dynamic organization, and the environment can be fluid. Roles and responsibilities can often be expanded to accommodate changing business conditions and objectives. Accordingly, employees may be asked to perform duties that are outside the specific functions that are listed.

Data Modeling & Transformation

  • Design and build the data layer between raw source tables and our analysts, from staging to cleaned to summarized tables.
  • Build and maintain dbt models with tests, documentation, and clear naming, so anyone can find and trust the right table.
  • Define core business and player metrics once, so every report and dashboard counts the same way.
  • Monitor data quality and pipeline health, and fix issues before they reach a decision-maker.

Analytics & Insights

  • Write SQL to answer business questions end to end, from scoping the question to presenting the findings.
  • Partner with product, marketing, live operations, and leadership to turn open-ended requests into clear metrics and deliverables.
  • Review other analysts' queries and guide them to the right tables and methods.

Dashboards & Reporting

  • Build and maintain Tableau dashboards that teams use to run the business day to day.
  • Design dashboards for non-technical audiences: clear, fast, and focused on the decisions they support.
  • Audit existing reporting, consolidate duplicates, and retire dashboards that are no longer used.

AI-Enabled Workflows & Scale

  • Use AI tools daily to write, review, and debug SQL, dbt models, and Python faster and with fewer errors.
  • Build repeatable AI-assisted workflows, such as auto-generated documentation, data quality checks, and first-draft analyses.
  • Identify routine reporting work that AI can take on, and put those solutions into production.
  • Set practical guardrails for AI use, including output review and protection of sensitive data, and share what works with the team.

Qualifications/Skills Sets

This section contains competencies and qualifications directly related to successful job performance. The categories are broad, reflecting minimum requirements in the context of the scope of the job. The following is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all possible requirements, nor does it include general competencies/expectations/skills that are universally applicable to office work.

Required

  • Experience in the games industry, especially with player telemetry, live-service, or monetization data.
  • Expert SQL, including window functions, CTEs, performance tuning, and modeling large, messy source data.
  • Production experience with dbt: models, tests, sources, macros, and documentation.
  • Strong Python for data work, such as pandas, automation, and pulling data from APIs.
  • Deep Tableau experience, including data sources, calculated fields, LOD expressions, and dashboards built for non-technical users.
  • Solid grounding in dimensional modeling (facts, dimensions, grain).
  • A proven track record of using AI tools to speed up real data work, with examples you can walk us through.
  • Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs or AI agents, beyond chat-based use.



Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with MMOs and shooters, as a player or from working on them.
  • Experience with a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or Databricks.

Education & Experience

What education, specialized training, is required to perform this job? How many years of directly related experience are required for the job? Can additional experience or education be substituted for all or part of requirement?

  • 5+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI, with hands-on experience in both data modeling and analysis.

Additional Requirements

Does job have travel requirements? Does job have any licenses or certifications required?

  • Some travel may be required (both domestically and internationally)

Physical Demands and Work Environment

Performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, sit, talk, hear, and use hands and fingers to operate a computer and telephone along with reaching. Specific vision abilities include close vision requirements due to computer work. Moderate noise, ability to work in a confined area, and ability to sit at a computer for an extended period of time are also included. descriptionHtml:
Gopuff's engineering team is building solutions to dramatically change the way people purchase their daily goods. We provide the modern-day solution to meet customers' immediate everyday needs with products ranging from snacks and ice cream to household goods and beer, at the click of a button.

As an Analytics Engineer at Gopuff, you'll build and maintain the bridge between our data and the rest of the organization. This role sits on the Analytics Engineering team and is dedicated to our Supply Chain and Merchandising partners, with a secondary focus on marketing and CRM analytics. You'll own the models that our planning, allocation, and merch teams use to decide what we buy, where we place it, and how we promote it, and you'll be accountable for the integrity, reliability, and usability of that data.

What We Offer

  • Medical/Dental/Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
  • HSA or FSA eligibility
  • Long and Short-Term Disability Insurance
  • Fitness Reimbursement Program
  • 25% employee discount & FAM Membership
  • Flexible PTO
  • Group Life Insurance
  • EAP through AllOne Health (formerly Carebridge)

Compensation

  • Gopuff pays employees based on market pricing and pay may vary depending on your location. The salary range below reflects what we’d reasonably expect to pay candidates. A candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, interview performance, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. Exceptions may be made for exceptional individuals. For additional information on this role’s compensation package, please reach out to the designated recruiter for this role.
  • This role is eligible for a discretionary annual cash bonus and participation in Gopuff’s equity incentive plan.
  • Base Salary Range: $100,000 - $125,000

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain the production data models that power supply chain and merchandising decisions: sales and demand, inventory position and in-stock, damage and expiration, turn, vendor fill rate, purchase orders, and allocation.
  • Be the go-to data expert for these domains, with a deep understanding of our data warehouse and the processing layers feeding it.
  • Partner with Supply Chain divisional teams, Merchandising, Marketing, CRM, product managers, and engineers to translate business questions into durable models and self-serve tooling rather than one-off pulls.
  • Own data integrity, availability, transformation logic, and efficient data access for the domains you support.
  • Build and maintain reporting and dashboards in Looker that planners and merchants use daily, and retire the manual reporting they replace.
  • Support marketing and CRM analytics alongside the supply chain work: campaign and promotion performance, channel reporting.
  • Identify gaps in existing data, write data product specs, and work with engineering teams to get the right tracking in place.
  • Automate wherever possible, and build testing and monitoring so data quality problems surface before stakeholders find them.
  • Document your models so every stakeholder can find, understand, and trust the data without asking you first.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with ETL/ELT tooling (bonus points for dbt).
  • Strong knowledge of data warehousing concepts, big data technologies, and analytics platforms. Snowflake, Redshift, and/or Azure experience strongly preferred.
  • Exposure to supply chain, inventory, merchandise planning, or allocation data. You don't need years of planning experience, but familiarity with concepts like model stock, lead time, replenishment cycles, sell-through, and turn will get you productive faster.
  • Experience with marketing or CRM analytics: campaign performance, promotion lift, channel attribution, or customer segmentation.
  • Experience with demand planning or ERP systems such as JustEnough or Kinaxis.
  • Comfort working with AI-assisted development tools. We use assistants like Claude in our day-to-day analytics engineering work, and we value engineers who use them well: accelerating model development, SQL review, testing, and documentation while independently verifying outputs and knowing when the tool is the wrong answer.
  • Alcohol beverage or CPG category experience is a plus.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or another quantitative discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience building data models that integrate complex and disparate data sources, using tools such as dbt.
  • Expert in SQL and database table design, able to write structured and efficient queries against large datasets. Advanced Excel skills for partner collaboration.
  • 1+ years building and maintaining reporting and dashboards in Looker or a comparable BI tool.
  • Strong analytical judgment: able to move from raw data to a clear recommendation, and to explain the 'so what' to business partners who will act on it.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate business needs into tractable work items and to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical partners.
  • Top-notch organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Move fast, be a team player, always be learning, and give back.

At Gopuff, we know that life can be unpredictable. Sometimes you forget the milk at the store, run out of pet food for Fido, or just really need ice cream at 11 pm. We get it—stuff happens. But that’s where we come in, delivering all your wants and needs in just minutes.

And now, we’re assembling a team of motivated people to help us drive forward that vision to bring a new age of convenience and predictability to an unpredictable world.

Like what you’re hearing? Then join us on Team Blue.

Description

Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

We are seeking a strategic and technical Business Intelligence Engineer to build the analytics and data foundations that power Amazon Leo's global marketing engine. This role is critical in defining how a new Amazon business measures customer behavior, marketing effectiveness, funnel performance, and growth. You will design and build datasets, dashboards, pipelines, and measurement frameworks that enable Marketing, Product, and Leadership teams to make fast, data-driven decisions at scale.

This is a high-impact role requiring both strategic vision and hands-on technical execution. You will own and evolve the backend data architecture within our Customer Dat (Treasure Data), building upon existing foundations as new data sources and use cases emerge. You will design and maintain datasets and pipelines across our B2C tech stack, partnering with Data Engineering and Product teams to ensure complete, accurate, and actionable data across the full customer journey. This role requires collaborative autonomy—you will make independent strategic and technical decisions and drive your work forward with minimal oversight, while actively coordinating with cross-functional partners to ensure alignment and shared success.

Key job responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and maintain foundational business datasets across our tech stack and other internal systems to support analytics, reporting, and customer growth use cases.
  • Develop SQL-based transformations, data models, and ETL/ELT workflows to structure and unify marketing and customer data for customer lifecycle use cases.
  • Design, optimize, and manage Amazon QuickSight dashboards that provide visibility into acquisition performance, attribution, and lifecycle funnels.
  • Conduct deep-dive analysis to identify funnel drop-offs, diagnose performance issues, uncover customer insights, and evaluate marketing effectiveness.
  • Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches, data models, and scalable self-service tools.
  • Drive alignment on KPI definitions, measurement frameworks, taxonomy, and data governance across global marketing teams.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Sales Ops, Data Science, and cross-functional partners to support experimentation, segmentation, forecasting, and predictive insights.
  • Communicate effectively with senior management audiences (e.g. narratives, inputs into weekly/monthly/quarterly business reviews).* Drive best practices in operational excellence, data modeling, and analysis. Ensure that BI solutions are correctly and efficiently supporting the business.* Participate in hiring activities and mentor junior team members

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

A day in the life

You will spend part of your day improving the business health data architecture—designing better datasets, cleaning pipelines, and enabling new use cases in the CDP and other internal spaces. Another part of your day will involve partnering with Data Engineering to review instrumentation or troubleshoot data issues. You will also work directly with Marketing and Product teams to conduct deep dives, and design new measurement approaches. You will be a strategic and technical owner ensuring that Amazon Leo Marketing can make accurate, timely, data-driven decisions.

About The Team

The Amazon Leo B2C team is responsible for building a world-class experience and driving global demand for a transformational connectivity service. The B2C Analytics team builds the systems, data flows, measurements, and insights that support a multi-LOB global business. We operate with the agility of a startup inside Amazon, partnering closely with Engineering, Product, Science, and global marketing teams to ensure our decisions are grounded in high-quality data.

You will design and maintain datasets and pipelines across our B2C tech stack, partnering with Data Engineering and Product teams to ensure complete, accurate, and actionable data across the full customer journey. This role requires collaborative autonomy—you will make independent strategic and technical decisions and drive your work forward with minimal oversight, while actively coordinating with cross-functional partners to ensure alignment and shared success.

-  Architect, build, and maintain foundational business datasets across our tech stack and other internal systems to support analytics, reporting, and customer growth use cases.
-  Develop SQL-based transformations, data models, and ETL/ELT workflows to structure and unify marketing and customer data for customer lifecycle use cases.
-  Design, optimize, and manage Amazon QuickSight dashboards that provide visibility into acquisition performance, attribution, and lifecycle funnels.
-  Conduct deep-dive analysis to identify funnel drop-offs, diagnose performance issues, uncover customer insights, and evaluate marketing effectiveness.

Walton Enterprises is seeking a skilled, highly motivated and entrepreneurial individual to join the team as a Senior Engineer, Business Intelligence. The ideal teammate will have the demonstrated ability to transform complex enterprise data into actionable insights through advanced SQL, data modeling, and business intelligence solutions while collaborating with stakeholders to support informed decision-making.


About the Position

The Senior Engineer, Business Intelligence builds and maintains the analytics and visualization layer used by Walton Enterprises teams to support data-informed decisions. This position transforms raw enterprise data into governed metrics, curated data models, production dashboards, and reusable self-service reporting tools. The role partners with business stakeholders, software engineering, and infrastructure teams to ensure analytics are accurate, secure, actionable, and aligned with business needs.


Please note: We are unable to sponsor employment visas for this position, including OPT and CPT authorizations.

What you will do

In this role, you will develop and maintain business intelligence solutions that make enterprise data accessible, reliable, and actionable. You will partner with stakeholders to understand business needs, design reporting solutions, establish consistent data definitions, and support self-service analytics across the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Write, optimize, and maintain advanced SQL queries against the enterprise data warehouse to source, join, and validate data for analysis.
  • Design and maintain curated data models, views, and a governed semantic layer that makes enterprise data reusable and ready for self-service reporting.
  • Build and maintain production dashboards and data visualizations, from requirements gathering through implementation and user adoption.
  • Establish and document shared metric definitions, data dictionaries, and reporting standards to promote consistency across teams.
  • Partner with stakeholders to frame business questions and translate analysis into clear recommendations and actions.
  • Develop data-quality checks and monitoring within reporting solutions; investigate discrepancies and work with business and engineering partners to resolve root causes.
  • Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate analysis and documentation while validating AI-generated output before it is shared with stakeholders.
  • Train and support business users in self-service reporting to increase adoption and reduce recurring ad hoc reporting requests.
  • Collaborate with software engineering and infrastructure teams regarding data availability, access controls, and upstream data-pipeline requirements.
  • Perform other duties as needed to support the Data Strategy and Insights team.

Who we are looking for

Skills needed

  • Advanced SQL and hands-on experience working with data warehouses
  • Data visualization, dashboard design, and data storytelling
  • Data modeling and semantic-layer design for self-service analytics
  • Business acumen and the ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured, analyzable problems
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with technical and nontechnical audiences
  • Data quality, documentation, and data-stewardship discipline

Qualifications required for success

  • Bachelor’s degree in analytics, statistics, computer science, information systems, business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
  • Five to seven years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, analytics engineering, or a related field
  • Demonstrated proficiency in SQL, including performance tuning of complex queries against large datasets
  • Experience with other programming languages, such as Python, or advanced statistical-analysis software preferred
  • Hands-on experience with Google BigQuery or a comparable cloud-based data warehouse
  • Proven experience building and maintaining production dashboards using Looker, Looker Studio, Power BI, or comparable visualization tools
  • Demonstrated examples of data visualizations or analyses that influenced how a team operated or what a stakeholder decided
  • Experience defining and governing shared metrics across multiple stakeholder groups
  • Experience working with accounting, investment, philanthropic, or family-office data preferred

Personal attributes that support success

  • Demonstrates discretion, integrity, and expertise while serving as a trusted advisor to principals and colleagues.
  • Collaborates respectfully and effectively with others, contributing to a supportive, team-oriented environment.
  • Approaches challenges with curiosity, bold thinking, and a commitment to continuous learning and innovation.
  • Maintains a strong focus on results while consistently exercising sound judgment and decision-making.
  • Brings a visionary mindset, planning strategically for the future with imagination and insight.
  • Demonstrates a commitment to excellence and actively engages with others to accomplish shared goals.


All offers of employment are contingent on your successful completion (where permitted by state law) of a confidentiality agreement and background check. In addition, you will need to provide proper identification verifying your eligibility to work in the United States on your first day of work.


Benefits Information


Benefits Information: We offer a comprehensive and generous benefits package which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan and paid time off.


Work Environment and Physical Demands

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Qualified individuals must be able to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation. Reasonable accommodations will be made, provided they do not pose an undue hardship to the company.


Work is generally performed in a standard office or remote office environment. Duties typically require sitting for long periods; prolonged use of a computer, phone, and other standard office productivity equipment; participating in meetings, communicating by phone, video, and email; and occasional movement within the office or between meeting locations. Occasional lifting of boxes, files, or paperwork may be required. The role is not normally subject to extreme environmental conditions or unusual physical demands.


This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals assigned to this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications associated with the role. Duties and responsibilities may change based on business needs.

The Information Technology Department provides a suite of services including hardware and software support, custom application development, cybersecurity, networking and tools for software integration. These services are provided to Walton Enterprises, the Walton Family Foundation and to Walton Family Entities.

descriptionHtml:
Why work at Higgsfield AI?

Higgsfield AI is the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $1B in annual revenue run rate, 30M+ users worldwide, 6M+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands.

We're building at the absolute frontier of AI-powered video creation and next-generation creative tools. Joining Higgsfield means becoming part of a high-impact team shaping the future of AI-native experiences, at a company that isn't just moving fast, but rewriting what fast looks like.

About the role:

We're looking for a Data Engineer to own the data that runs Higgsfield's enterprise business, from raw data to the numbers leadership makes decisions on.

You'll own data end to end, from raw data collection through transformation, modeling and validation, to the reporting that Sales, RevOps, Finance and Product use to run the business. Revenue, contracts and commissions all run through this work, so accuracy matters.

This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You'll report to our Data Engineering Lead, take on projects independently, and help make sure data is never the bottleneck as the business accelerates. We're an AI company, and we expect our data engineers to use AI to multiply what they can deliver.

What you'll do:

  • Own end-to-end data pipelines, from raw data collection and transformation to modeling, validation and reporting.
  • Integrate CRM, billing, contract and product usage data into a consistent, trusted view of our B2B customers.
  • Build the data models and dashboards behind revenue reporting, commissions, forecasting and customer insights.
  • Turn ambiguous business questions from Sales, RevOps and Finance into scoped projects, and drive them to completion.
  • Close data gaps across teams, whether that means partnering with backend engineering to capture new data or fixing a broken pipeline.
  • Build AI-powered workflows (agents, reusable skills, automations) that work with our infrastructure and scale your impact.
  • Validate every number before it ships, with automated checks, monitoring and documentation that keep our data audit-ready.
  • Build executive-facing reports and dashboards (CEO / VP level) that are easy to read and highlight what needs action

Requirements:

  • 4+ years in data engineering, analytics engineering or a related role, including building and maintaining complex production pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience building with AI, not just using it: for example, creating custom agents, skills or automations with tools like Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or Cursor. You know where these tools help and where they fall short.
  • Strong SQL and Python, plus experience with modern data warehouses and transformation/orchestration tools (e.g., Snowflake or BigQuery, dbt, Airflow or Dagster).
  • Experience integrating data from business systems such as Salesforce, HubSpot or Stripe.
  • Structured thinking: you break ambiguous problems into clear steps and solve them methodically.
  • A proactive, self-directed approach. You learn fast, take ownership without waiting for instructions, and push work over the finish line.
  • Clear communication, including explaining technical work and its tradeoffs to nontechnical stakeholders.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience partnering with Finance on data that demands high precision (revenue, billing, commissions).
  • Early or growth-stage startup experience.

Compensation & Benefits

  • We offer a competitive and thoughtfully structured compensation package designed to align with impact, experience, and long-term growth.
  • Base Salary: The anticipated salary range for this role is $200,000 - $260,000, depending on experience, skills, scope, and location.
  • Bonus: This role is Bonus eligible and may participate in the Company's discretionary annual bonus program.
  • Equity: In addition to cash compensation, employees are eligible to participate in the company’s stock option program and share in Higgsfield’s long-term growth.
  • Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees professionally and personally, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a competitive 401(k) retirement plan with company matching, and additional benefits and perks.
  • The opportunity to work on ambitious AI products alongside a highly experienced, fast-moving, and international team.
  • Significant ownership, direct impact, and opportunities for professional growth as the company scales.

This is a hybrid role based in the San Francisco Bay Area. Team members are expected to work from our San Francisco office three full days per week, with the remaining days worked remotely and are expected to be available during agreed working hours and to maintain sufficient overlap with the relevant team’s time zone. We value in-person collaboration, active communication, responsiveness, and close partnership across teams.

Higgsfield AI is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Compensation Range: $200K - $260K

descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Our cloud games offering is an incredible opportunity to deliver new experiences that delight and entertain our growing membership. You will be joining us at an exciting time as we roll out more games on our cloud service and be in a position to help us redefine what a Netflix subscription means for our members around the world.

This analytics engineering role owns the datasets produced by the systems that power the cloud games experience, spanning areas such as the quality of experience (QoE) members have when they play and the capacity and utilization of the infrastructure that delivers it. This role will build the metrics, tooling, and data products that make this data trustworthy, discoverable, and self-service, and operationalize them across the business to drive prioritization of the highest-impact opportunities. You will join the team of Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, and Data Engineers who partner closely with the infrastructure engineering teams to turn telemetry into self-service data products that guide how the business invests in its cloud gaming infrastructure.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner closely with our engineering teams to develop deep expertise in how the cloud gaming infrastructure works, across both quality of experience and capacity and utilization, and understand how data, analytics, experimentation, and algorithms can drive improvements to its performance and how we invest in it.
  • Own the analytic data layer and the data products (pipelines, tables, dashboards, AI agents, tooling, and self-service assets) that turn our QoE framework and our capacity and utilization characterization into reliable insights for partners.
  • Work across the entire data stack, including telemetry extension and logging, data modeling, metrics development, visualization, and insights generation, to drive alignment of resources against the most important problems in this space.
  • Build toward self-service access rather than ad hoc delivery, and ensure what the team publishes is trustworthy, well-documented, and maintainable over time.
  • Independently identify and drive the highest-leverage investments across the cloud games infrastructure data domain.

You Have

  • Passion for solving real-world problems through analytics, tooling, and visualization, and an eye for independently identifying new, impactful analytic opportunities.
  • Expertise in SQL (Trino, Spark SQL), programming (e.g., Python), ETL, and data warehousing concepts at scale. Previous dbt experience as a bonus.
  • An appetite for learning and adopting AI capabilities as a means to supercharge your workflow, paired with the judgment to know when their output is trustworthy and explainable enough to act on.
  • Curiosity to pursue deep expertise in data science and engineering with a detailed understanding of distributed systems engineering and networking.
  • Experience developing pipelines of moderate complexity on massive telemetry data sets, with the ability to effectively partner with data engineering teams, building more scalable solutions for the most important use cases.
  • Strong judgment about where to invest, the discipline to keep sight of the bigger picture, and a bias toward durable, scalable capability over one-off outputs.
  • Experience building strong partnerships and communicating technical and analytical concepts clearly and concisely among audiences at many different levels.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to thrive with minimal oversight and process.
  • Embodied the Netflix values while bringing a new perspective to continue improving our culture.

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $330,000.00 - $566,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Our cloud games offering is an incredible opportunity to deliver new experiences that delight and entertain our growing membership. You will be joining us at an exciting time as we roll out more games on our cloud service and be in a position to help us redefine what a Netflix subscription means for our members around the world.
