descriptionHtml:
Empower Pharmacy is a visionary healthcare company dedicated to making quality, affordable medication accessible to millions of patients nationwide. As the nation’s most advanced 503A compounding pharmacy and FDA-registered 503B outsourcing facility, we’re redefining what’s possible in personalized medicine and pharmaceutical manufacturing. We’re proud to be recognized as one of Houston’s fastest-growing private companies and ranked #116 in Healthcare & Medical on the Inc. 5000 List for 2025.

Our strength is built on four core values: People, Quality, Service, and Innovation. Guided by these principles, we’ve created a uniquely integrated healthcare platform powered by advanced technology, operational excellence, and a relentless commitment to patient care. From manufacturing and quality control to distribution and customer experience, our teams work together to raise industry standards, expand access to critical medications, and improve outcomes for patients and providers across the country.

At Empower, joining our team means more than starting a new role. It means becoming part of a mission-driven organization that’s transforming healthcare at scale. We invest deeply in our people, encourage bold thinking, and create opportunities for growth, leadership, and innovation at every level. Your ideas matter here, your development is supported, and the work you do has a direct impact on the lives of millions.

If you thrive in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment where innovation, collaboration, and ambition come together, Empower Pharmacy is the place for you. Let’s transform healthcare together.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Senior Analytics Engineer builds reliable data solutions that improve decision-making, operational efficiency, and business performance across Empower. Operating in a hyper-growth, highly regulated 503A/503B environment, this individual contributor owns analytics delivery from problem definition through deployment and monitoring. The role translates ambiguous business needs into scalable, maintainable, cost-effective data models, pipelines, and reporting solutions while strengthening data quality and infrastructure reliability. Success requires strategic thinking, disciplined execution, sound technical judgment, and learning agility to balance immediate priorities with sustainable engineering practices. The engineer identifies valuable analytics opportunities, communicates findings clearly, and partners with stakeholders to align solutions with business objectives. Through mentoring, knowledge sharing, and reusable tools, this role increases team productivity and supports Empower’s mission of expanding access to high-quality medications with dependable, actionable insights that guide decisions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Analytics Delivery and Business Impact

  • Project Delivery: Lead analytics projects from problem definition through deployment and monitoring, delivering solutions aligned with business objectives and stakeholder needs.
  • Opportunity Assessment: Propose analytics initiatives with data-driven business cases that clarify expected value, operational benefits, and priorities for stakeholder evaluation.
  • Solution Design: Design scalable, maintainable, cost-effective data models, pipelines, and reporting solutions that resolve ambiguous business problems through structured technical analysis.

Data Quality and Operational Reliability

  • Data Quality: Identify and resolve data issues, validate analytical outputs, and monitor deployed solutions to maintain reliable insights for business users.
  • Infrastructure Improvement: Improve data infrastructure and engineering workflows to reduce recurring issues, increase processing efficiency, and sustain reliable analytics delivery.
  • Engineering Discipline: Maintain version-controlled code and solution documentation to support consistent maintenance, accountable changes, and reliable analytics in regulated operations.

Technical Leadership and Collaboration

  • Technical Mentorship: Mentor junior team members through technical guidance and knowledge sharing, strengthening problem-solving capability and consistent analytics engineering practices.
  • Reusable Solutions: Develop shared tools and libraries that reduce duplicated effort, improve engineering consistency, and increase team productivity across analytics projects.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Partner with business stakeholders to clarify requirements, communicate insights through effective data storytelling, and adapt solutions to evolving priorities.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:

  • Proficiency in Python, SQL, and data modeling methods, including Kimball and Data Vault 2.1, for scalable, maintainable analytics solutions.
  • Technical proficiency with Apache Hop, dbt, Snowflake, AWS, and Azure to build reliable data pipelines and improve infrastructure efficiency.
  • Ability to use Power BI, DAX, and data storytelling to communicate actionable insights and explain technical findings to varied stakeholders.
  • Skill in Git, conceptual modeling with LucidChart, structured problem-solving, and technical mentoring to support maintainable solutions, knowledge sharing, and team productivity.

EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:

  • At least 5 years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related role delivering practical business solutions required.
  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and practical experience required.
  • Knowledge of the pharmacy business and Certified Data Vault 2.0 Practitioner certification for translating business requirements into structured data models required.
  • Certified DBT Developer and Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst (PL-300) certifications, demonstrating analytics development and reporting expertise highly preferred.
  • Snowflake experience or SnowPro certification, along with AWS Data Engineering or AWS Data Analytics certification supporting cloud analytics delivery preferred.

KEY COMPETENCIES:

  • Customer Focus: Builds trust through customer-centric solutions.
  • Strategic AI: Guides responsible AI adoption and adaptation.
  • Optimizes Work Processes: Drives efficiency with continuous improvement.
  • Collaborates: Partners effectively to achieve shared goals.
  • Resourcefulness: Secures and deploys resources efficiently.
  • Manages Complexity: Simplifies and solves complex challenges.
  • Ensures Accountability: Delivers on commitments with integrity.
  • Situational Adaptability: Adjusts approach to shifting conditions.
  • Communicates Effectively: Tailors messages to diverse audiences.

VALUES:

  • People: Empowering people defines who we are.
  • Quality: Excellence in every product, every time.
  • Service: Serving others is our highest purpose.
  • Innovation: Advancing care through technology and discovery.

EMPLOYEE BENEFITS, HEALTH AND WELLNESS:

We offer comprehensive benefits to support your health, well-being, and future, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, 401(k) matching, wellness perks, IV therapy, and compounded medications. Learn more: https://careers.empowerpharmacy.com/benefits/

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

While performing the responsibilities of the job, the employee is required to talk and hear. POSITION SUMMARY:

The Senior Analytics Engineer builds reliable data solutions that improve decision-making, operational efficiency, and business performance across Empower. The role translates ambiguous business needs into scalable, maintainable, cost-effective data models, pipelines, and reporting solutions while strengthening data quality and infrastructure reliability. Success requires strategic thinking, disciplined execution, sound technical judgment, and learning agility to balance immediate priorities with sustainable engineering practices. The engineer identifies valuable analytics opportunities, communicates findings clearly, and partners with stakeholders to align solutions with business objectives.   • Enable stakeholders through documentation, demos, and shared patterns to support adoption.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or other applicable degree.

descriptionHtml:
About OnePay

OnePay is the consumer fintech trusted by millions of Americans to make money better.


Our financial system is broken. High fees, low rates, and too few ways to actually grow your money. We’re fixing it. And we’re moving fast.


We’re an all-in-one financial services platform that brings together banking, high-yield savings, credit cards, point-of-sale lending, investing, and crypto in one place. We also partner with employers, HCM providers, gig platforms, and others to deliver embedded financial services to millions of employees and frontline workers.


We’re backed by Walmart, the world’s largest retailer, and Ribbit Capital, one of fintech’s most respected investors, giving us rare scale, distribution, and the opportunity to build something truly category-defining.


But what really sets OnePay apart is how we move. Our customers don’t have time to wait… and neither do we. This place moves fast, and we’re looking for people who are:

  • Ready to run
  • Hungry and driven by urgency
  • Exceptional at what they do, with low ego
  • Comfortable operating in motion


The Role

As an Analytics Engineer at OnePay, you'll own the analytics foundation (dbt models, testing, and Databricks BI) so the business can move fast on trusted data. We build for humans and AI, so you’ll use AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor) daily to move faster and design models, metrics, and documentation that agents and analysts can both rely on.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and build production dbt models on Databricks that the organization uses as the source of truth for what’s happening in the business
  • Support external reporting with accurate, governed data that stakeholders and partners can trust
  • Own data quality: testing, CI/CD, documentation, and patterns the team follows
  • Build and evolve Databricks dashboards and semantic metrics for self-service across the business
  • Partner with Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and analytics stakeholders to turn messy business problems into durable data products
  • Drive AI-native workflows: Cursor/Claude (or equivalent) in daily development; model and doc design that works for LLM consumers


You Bring

  • 3+ years in analytics engineering or equivalent: you’ve owned production models end-to-end, not just ad hoc analysis
  • Expert SQL and deep dbt experience (architecture, incremental models, tests, macros, CI/CD)
  • Strong Databricks BI (or equivalent semantic layer) delivery
  • AI-savvy in practice: you already use AI coding tools daily, validate outputs rigorously, and design data for both humans and agents
  • Proven ability to execute in ambiguity: startup pace, incomplete specs, bias toward shipping
  • Clear communicator across technical and non-technical audiences
  • Owner mentality: you see what’s broken, fix it, and raise the bar for others


Tools We Use

We use Typescript front to back, with node and NestJS frameworks for server code and React Native for our iOS, Android, and Web clients. We run on a highly distributed cloud-native stack with Kubernetes and AWS, and scale and resiliency are at the heart of everything we build. We also embrace agentic development, so engineers have their choice of a variety of models and agent harnesses, including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and more to fit their workflow. While you don't need experience with our exact stack, familiarity with modern software engineering practices will help you ramp up quickly.


What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary, stock options, and health benefits from Day 1
  • 401(k) plan with company match
  • Remote-friendly (US), flexible time off (FTO), and opportunities for growth
  • A high-growth, mission-driven, inclusive culture where your work has real impact


Standard Interview Process

Our process varies by role. Most candidates go through:

  • AI-assisted initial screen
  • Interview with Talent Partner
  • Technical or Hiring Manager Interview
  • Team Interview
  • Executive Interview
  • Offer!


Equal Employment Opportunity

To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us at talent@onepay.com.

Position Summary

The Analytics Engineer, WNBA will transform data from first- and third-party systems into standardized analytical datasets that support reporting, advanced analytics, AI product development, and data enablement. Reporting to the Business Intelligence Platforms Lead, this role will serve as DSA's subject matter expert for WNBA fan, subscription, engagement, and viewership data, including WNBA ID, Evergent, Amplitude, Bitmovin, and strategic media partners.

Major Responsibilities

  • Own the design and development of analytical data models that support reporting, analytics, and AI across the WNBA.
  • Lead the development of the WNBA's analytical data foundation by integrating fan identity, subscription, engagement, and viewership data into a unified view of the WNBA fan journey.
  • Identify recurring business questions and develop scalable data models and reusable datasets that reduce manual analysis and enable self-service reporting.
  • Develop and manage the semantic layer for WNBA analytical data, ensuring consistent business definitions and reusable datasets for reporting, self-service analytics, and AI applications.
  • Establish and maintain documentation, in conjunction with tools such as Alation and Confluence, to improve the discoverability, understanding, and governance of WNBA analytical data assets.
  • Lead data quality efforts by developing automated testing, monitoring, and validation processes to identify, prevent, and remediate data issues.
  • Serve as the internal subject matter expert for WNBA analytical data, partnering with stakeholders to shape analytical solutions, identify new data opportunities, and support evolving business needs.
  • Partner with DSA's Data Science and Analytics teams to develop analytical datasets that support advanced analytics, experimentation, machine learning, and AI initiatives.
  • Collaborate with internal business teams, Data Engineering, and external partners to onboard new data sources and expand the WNBA's analytical capabilities.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve analytical data models, analytics engineering practices, and the overall data foundation supporting the WNBA.

Required Skills/Knowledge

  • Advanced SQL skills with demonstrated experience developing complex analytical data models.
  • Experience building production-ready data pipelines and transformations using dbt or a similar analytics engineering framework.
  • Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, data warehousing, and analytics engineering best practices.
  • Experience working with cloud-based data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or Redshift.
  • Experience developing semantic layers, business metrics, or reusable analytical datasets that support reporting and self-service analytics.
  • Familiarity with Git-based development workflows (GitHub or Azure DevOps) and collaborative software engineering practices.
  • Experience implementing automated data quality testing, monitoring, and documentation as part of analytics engineering workflows.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate business requirements into scalable analytical solutions.
  • Experience/Education
  • Bachelor’s degree required with a technical or quantitative field preferred
  • 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or building analytical data models within cloud data platforms.

Job Title

Business Intelligence Engineer

Job Description

How You’ll Add Value:

The Business Intelligence (BI) Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise data and analytics solutions that enable data-driven decision-making across the organization. This role will build and optimize cloud-based data platforms, design scalable ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) pipelines, and develop curated datasets that support reporting, dashboards, advanced analytics, and Artificial Intelligence initiatives.

Working within AWS, Snowflake and PostgreSQL-based data environments, the BI Engineer will transform complex business and operational data into trusted, actionable insights while ensuring data quality, governance, and scalability.

What You’ll Do:

Data Engineering and ETL Development:

  • Design, develop, and maintain ETL pipelines that integrate data from enterprise applications, operational systems, APIs, and third-party platforms
  • Build automated processes to extract, load, and transform structured and unstructured data into analytics-ready datasets
  • Implement data validation, cleansing, enrichment, and monitoring processes
  • Optimize data pipelines for performance, scalability, and reliability


Snowflake Data Platform:

  • Design and manage Snowflake databases, schemas, tables, views, and data models
  • Develop and maintain dimensional, operational, and semantic data models to support analytics and reporting. Create structured and governed datasets that enable self-service business intelligence
  • Optimize Snowflake performance through effective clustering, partitioning, and query tuning


AWS Data Lake & Cloud Analytics:

  • Develop and support AWS-based analytics solutions utilizing:
    • Amazon S3
    • Amazon SageMaker
    • AWS Glue
    • Amazon Athena
    • AWS Lambda
    • Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL
  • Design and maintain S3 data lake structures and table architectures that support enterprise reporting and analytics
  • Support data ingestion and transformation processes from multiple internal and external data sources
  • Design, develop, and optimize PostgreSQL database objects including schemas, tables, views, materialized views, stored procedures, and data transformation logic to support analytics and reporting workloads

Reporting & Business Intelligence:

  • Partner with business stakeholders to understand reporting and analytics requirements
  • Create and maintain reusable datasets, KPIs, metrics, and reporting structures
  • Support dashboard and visualization development utilizing BI and reporting tools
  • Enable self-service analytics through governed data models and semantic layers


AI & Advanced Analytics Enablement:

  • Collaborate with Data Science and AI teams to prepare and curate datasets for machine learning models
  • Support data engineering activities required for Amazon SageMaker and AI initiatives
  • Develop scalable data assets that support predictive analytics and operational intelligence


Data Governance & Quality:

  • Establish and maintain data quality standards and controls
  • Document data lineage, mappings, business rules, and transformation logic
  • Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and regulatory requirements
  • Participate in master data and metadata management initiatives


What You Will Bring:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or related field
  • 4+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or related disciplines
  • Strong experience with ETL development and data integration.
  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, including query optimization, schema design, indexing strategies, and performance tuning
  • Strong SQL development, data modeling, and PostgreSQL database development expertise
  • Experience working within AWS cloud environments
  • Experience developing and managing enterprise reporting datasets
  • Knowledge of dimensional modeling, data warehousing, and analytics best practices
  • Experience with Python or other scripting languages for data processing


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Amazon SageMaker and machine learning data preparation
  • Experience with AWS Glue, Athena, Lambda, and S3-based data lake architectures
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytics platforms
  • Familiarity with Apache Iceberg, Parquet, or modern data lake table formats
  • AWS and/or Snowflake certifications
  • Experience supporting AI, predictive analytics, or enterprise data strategy initiatives
  • Experience with PostgreSQL advanced features such as partitioning, materialized views, JSON/JSONB, extensions, and analytical query optimization
  • Experience implementing medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) or similar multi-layer data lake design patterns
  • Experience with Change Data Capture (CDC), event-driven architectures, data products, and operational analytics platforms


Your Working Conditions:

  • General office setting
  • This position qualifies for a hybrid schedule - 4 days in-office,1 day working remote

Headquartered in Dalton, Georgia, Shaw is a wholly owned subsidiary of Berkshire Hathaway, Inc. with more than $6 billion in annual sales and 18,000 associates worldwide.


Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Analytics Engineer III to join our Residential Enablement and Insights team in Dalton, GA. This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, advanced analytics, and data engineering — with a strong emphasis on data modeling, Power BI, and Databricks.


As an Analytics Engineer, you will design and implement scalable, trusted data models and visualization tools that drive strategic decision-making across our Residential Sales and Marketing organizations. The ideal candidate will blend technical depth with business insight, playing a critical role in enabling data self-service and modern analytics practices across Shaw.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with senior business leaders (DVPs, VPs, Directors) to gather requirements and translate them into scalable data models and analytic frameworks.
  • Design, develop, and maintain semantic models, star schemas, and data marts to support self-service analytics.
  • Build and deploy advanced analytic pipelines using Databricks, transforming large and complex data sets into analytics-ready assets.
  • Create clear, actionable visualizations and dashboards using Power BI, enabling users to uncover insights and make informed decisions.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering to ensure data integrity, optimize pipeline performance, and enforce data governance standards.
  • Provide subject matter expertise in Power BI development, data modeling practices, and dashboard UX.
  • Coach and mentor analysts and business users in best practices for data visualization, model reuse, and analytic thinking.
  • Contribute to the development of enterprise data standards, catalogs, and metadata documentation.
  • Stay current with evolving technologies in analytics, cloud computing, and data engineering — especially Databricks, Power BI, and modern data architectures.


Requirements

Technical Skills & Experience:

  • Advanced knowledge of SQL and experience designing scalable logical and physical data models.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Power BI (DAX, Power Query, dataflows, custom visuals, row-level security).
  • Proven experience working with Databricks (preferably on Azure) to process and model data using notebooks and Delta Lake.
  • Strong understanding of data pipeline orchestration, ETL, and data lake architectures (Azure Data Lake).
  • Familiarity with Python or R for advanced analytics and automation tasks.
  • Experience working with version control (e.g., Git) and implementing DataOps or CI/CD practices.


Core Competencies:

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business context.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical thinking skills.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally in a highly collaborative environment.
  • Interest in continuous learning, especially in areas of machine learning, AI, and advanced analytics.
  • Passion for creating clean, reusable, and well-documented data assets.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Business, or a related field.
  • 2–5+ years of experience delivering modern analytics solutions using Power BI, Databricks, and strong data modeling practices.
  • Experience working in or supporting business analytics teams within a large enterprise environment.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing large-scale big data systems using Hadoop, Spark, Apache Hive, or similar frameworks.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL databases such as Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, and cloud databases including Azure Data Lake or similar platforms.
  • Extensive knowledge of data warehousing design principles including dimensional modeling and ETL pipeline development.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud-based data management solutions on AWS or other public cloud providers.
  • Proficiency in software development languages such as Java and Python for building scalable analytics applications.
  • Familiarity with business intelligence tools like Looker for creating insightful dashboards and reports.
  • Knowledge of data modeling techniques including linked data concepts to enhance data integration across diverse sources.
  • Experience working within Agile development environments with tools like Talend for ETL workflows.
  • Strong analysis skills combined with expertise in database design, query management, shell scripting (Bash/Unix), VBA, and RESTful API integration.


Join us to be at the forefront of transforming raw data into actionable insights that drive strategic growth!

descriptionHtml:
Description

Prime Video is changing the way customers watch movies, TV shows, live events, and channels—offering unparalleled choice and convenience across devices such as Fire TV, mobile phones, game consoles, and connected TVs. We deliver world-class viewing experiences to customers in over 240 countries and territories.

The Prime Video Product Analytics (PVPA) team is a centralized analytics organization supporting the Prime Video Product organization. We bring together Business Intelligence Engineers, Data Engineers, and Data Scientists to deliver comprehensive data tools and insights that drive product decisions and enhance customer experience. Our work spans the full analytics lifecycle—from data infrastructure and pipeline development to advanced analytics, customer insights modeling, AI-driven solutions, and self-service reporting.

This role sits within the PVPA team focused on out-of-app engagement and full-funnel customer journey analytics. Our mission is to understand and optimize how customers discover, engage with, and return to Prime Video—connecting off-app marketing touchpoints (such as email, push, a.com, WhatsApp, search engines, and paid media) with in-app behavior and engagement to build a complete, end-to-end view of the customer experience. We harness data across this full funnel—from acquisition and onboarding through long-term retention—to inform personalization, measure customer engagement and channel effectiveness, and deliver the right content to the right customer at the right time.

Key job responsibilities

We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Data Engineer II to join the PVPA team. In this role, you will be responsible for building and maintaining the data infrastructure that powers Prime Video's out-of-app and full-funnel customer journey analytics. You will own critical datasets and pipelines that directly support analytics, experimentation, and machine learning use cases, enabling smarter targeting, personalization, and measurement.

As a Data Engineer on the PVPA team, you will:

  • Design, implement, and maintain scalable and reliable data models and ETL pipelines that span the full customer funnel—including the reporting layer for the out-of-app messaging platform and other PV marketing channel infrastructure.
  • Build and enhance the AI tooling and analytics products to enable self-serve and improved efficiency.
  • Partner with engineering and dependency teams to define data contracts, ensure upstream data reliability, and proactively manage communication and change coordination for data schema updates.
  • Collaborate with Business Intelligence Engineers and Data Scientists to deliver clean, structured data for dashboards, reporting, experimentation, full-funnel attribution, and ML use cases.
  • Monitor pipeline health, resolve job and cluster issues, and improve automation, testing, and observability to increase system resilience.
  • Champion data engineering best practices across the team—including documentation, version control, peer reviews, and operational excellence.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of data engineering experience
  • Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
  • 3+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
  • Experience with SQL

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases)
  • Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions

  • Thoughtful about using AI in your own craft, using coding and analytics agents well, and evaluating what they produce rather than taking it on faith.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. descriptionHtml:
Join an award-winning company!

Who are we?

Since 1967, Toll Brothers has been building luxury homes and communities in the best locations in the U.S. Today, we’re a Fortune 500 company operating in over 60 markets. We’re the country’s premier luxury builder with the widest range of product offerings and price points in the industry, serving first-time, move-up, active-adult, and second-home buyers.

 

From the homes we build to the talent we recruit, we know that to be the best, we have to work with the best. Toll Brothers is a place where diverse perspectives and experiences are welcomed and where employees of all backgrounds are treated with fairness, dignity and respect. We believe every employee should feel safe to be their true and authentic self at work. Our employees are our family, and we strive to uphold the values that our founders instilled in us, creating an exceptional place to work that is inclusive to all.

 

Toll Brothers, America's leading luxury home builder, seeks an Data Analytics Engineer to join our team at our Corporate office in Fort Washington, Pennsylvania.

 

What is the opportunity?
The Data Analytics Engineer is a member of the Enterprise Data & Analytics team, reporting to the Director, Data Strategy and Development. This role is responsible for building and maintaining pipelines, models, and data products that power reporting, analytics, and decision-making across Toll Brothers. Working within a modern cloud data ecosystem, including Fivetran, Coalesce, and Snowflake, the Data Analytics Engineer ensures trusted, scalable, and high-performing data solutions that support business operations.

 

This role partners directly with stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Production, and other business units to translate business needs into technical solutions. Deliverables may include curated data models, interactive applications built with Streamlit or React, and AI-powered capabilities that make governed enterprise data more accessible and actionable.


What are the primary responsibilities?

  • Build and maintain ingestion pipelines in Fivetran to land source system data into Snowflake reliably and on schedule
  • Develop custom Python and API based integrations for source systems not covered by managed connectors
  • Develop and maintain transformation models in Coalesce Transform, applying dimensional and layered modeling patterns that support reporting and analytics at scale
  • Document data assets, definitions, and lineage in Coalesce Catalog so business users can find and trust the data they use
  • Design and tune Snowflake objects, including warehouses, roles, and storage patterns, for performance and cost efficiency
  • Partner with business stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Production, and other business
    units to gather reporting requirements and translate them into scalable data models and metric definitions
  • Build data applications in Streamlit and React that put analytics and workflow tools directly in the hands of business users
  • Apply AI and large language model capabilities to accelerate development, improve data quality checks, and enable natural language access to governed data
  • Establish and enforce data quality testing, monitoring, and alerting across pipelines and models
  • Partner with analysts and BI developers to ensure downstream dashboards are built on certified, well modeled data
  • Contribute to data governance, security, and access control practices in coordination with the broader Technology Organization
  • Troubleshoot pipeline and data issues, identify root causes, and implement durable fixes
  • All other duties as assigned

 

Does this describe you?

  • Systematic thinker who maps dependencies, data flows, and failure modes before writing code
  • Able to seamlessly shift between solving technical data challenges and partnering with business stakeholders.
  • Able to translate business needs into clear data requirements and constructively challenge ambiguous or incomplete requests
  • Curious about emerging technologies and eager to explore how AI can meaningfully improve data engineering and analytics.
  • Communicates proactively about scope, priorities, tradeoffs, and blockers
  • Demonstrates exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
  • Balances thoughtful design with pragmatic execution, delivering value iteratively rather than waiting for a perfect solution
  • Shares knowledge openly and contributes to a collaborative, high-performing team
  • Adapts well to shifting priorities and maintains momentum across concurrent projects

Do you have these qualifications?

  • Essential:
    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
    • 3-5 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a comparable data role
    • Strong SQL skills
    • Hands-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse
    • Experience building and maintaining ELT pipelines with a managed ingestion tool such as Fivetran
    • Experience with a modern transformation framework such as Coalesce Transform or dbt
    • Demonstrated experience gathering reporting requirements directly from business stakeholders and delivering data solutions that meet the business needs
    • Working knowledge of Python for data transformation, automation, and scripting
    • Experience working with REST APIs to source and deliver data
    • Experience with version control and code review practices in a team setting
    • Work in office 3-days per week. Additional in office days may vary per Division/Department.
  • Preferred:
    • Experience with Coalesce Transform and Coalesce Catalog specifically
    • Experience building data applications in Streamlit
    • Front-end development experience with React
    • Demonstrated ability applying AI or large language model tooling to data engineering, data quality, or analytics use cases
    • Experience with data governance, cataloging, and lineage practices in an enterprise environment
    • Familiarity with homebuilding, real estate and construction
    • Exposure to BI platforms such as Power BI or Tableau

We offer an excellent compensation and benefits package that includes comprehensive medical/dental, 401(k) with a company match, discounted stock purchase, discounts on mortgages, homes, and much more!

 

Come see why Toll Brothers has been attracting and retaining some of the best professionals in the industry!

APPLY ONLINE TODAY!

 

Toll Brothers is committed to ensuring equal employment opportunity. All employment decisions, policies, and practices are in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination laws. Toll Brothers will not engage in or tolerate unlawful discrimination (including any form of unlawful harassment) on account of a person's sex (including pregnancy), age, race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender nonconformity, status as a transgender individual, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, family responsibility, armed services, or any other status protected by law.

Staff Analytics Engineer

San Mateo, CA

Sony Interactive Entertainment LLC seeks a Staff Analytics Engineer in San Mateo, CA to design and implement curated analytics data products (gold datasets) with clear ownership, versioning, and governed definitions to support multiple stakeholder groups.

Requirements

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent, and six (6) years of experience serving as an analytics/business intelligence engineer; performing comprehensive data analysis of functional and business requisites utilizing Python, SQL, Tableau, MicroStrategy, and Databricks; collaborating with data scientists and engineering groups to ensure seamless and accurate data processing; pioneering and enacting data modeling strategies and operationalizing novel experiment designs and key performance indicators (KPIs) to refine data models; conducting statistical analyses to evaluate and quantify operational and technical challenges, drawing input from both end-users and partner teams; harnessing advanced Data Science approaches to devise and oversee experiments to enhance model performance and generate insightful recommendations; and leading the development of scalable BI solutions using platforms including MicroStrategy and Tableau, from building the semantic layer or data modeling to reporting. descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

We’re looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to join Kraken’s Finance Data Eng & Analytics team within Data Platform. You’ll build trusted financial data products, using automation and AI to reduce manual work and improve the close process.

Working at the intersection of data engineering and accounting, you’ll turn complex financial data into reliable pipelines, models and automated reconciliations. You’ll use AI-assisted tools to accelerate development and investigations, keeping financial outputs tested and traceable.

The opportunity

  • You’ll work closely with Data Engineers, Finance and Platform Accounting to improve reporting and decision-making. Clear communication and collaboration will help you agree priorities, explain findings and drive adoption.
  • Partner with Finance to understand workflows, identify pain points and translate business needs into practical data and automation solutions.
  • Build and maintain automated workflows for data preparation, reconciliations, reporting and follow-ups, with clear controls, monitoring and exception handling.
  • Build intuitive dashboards and visualizations that help stakeholders understand performance, investigate issues and make decisions.
  • Resolve finance data issues and reconciliation breaks with Finance, Product and Engineering, addressing root causes and communicating progress.
  • Build scalable, reliable pipelines to collect, transform and curate data from internal platforms and external systems.
  • Support the design and rollout of a trusted finance data lake, with clear definitions, ownership and quality checks.
  • Improve data timeliness, enabling near-real-time insights where they add business value.
  • Evaluate new technologies, including AI-assisted automation, and prototype solutions to Finance needs that can be reliably supported in production.

What You Bring

  • 7+ years of experience in data analytics and data management within financial services or a regulated industry, working directly with Finance teams.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills, including writing, debugging and maintaining production code.
  • Solid experience with Git, merge requests, and code reviews, supported by strong software engineering practices, including testing and documentation.
  • Hands-on experience building and operating pipelines and models using dbt, Spark, Airflow or comparable tools.
  • Direct experience with finance or accounting data, such as reconciliations, subledgers, cost basis or month-end close, including investigating discrepancies and validating outputs with accounting stakeholders.
  • A track record of owning pipelines end to end, making sound technical decisions and improving reliability as requirements and systems evolve.
  • Judgment and autonomy to lead complex work, navigate ambiguity and remain accountable for production outcomes.
  • Experience supporting recurring financial close activities, combined with a proactive approach to identifying manual processes and replacing them with reliable, sustainable automation.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across Engineering and Finance, explain complex technical issues, articulate financial implications, and recommend actionable solutions.

Nice to haves

  • Experience with cryptocurrency transaction data and how digital-asset activity flows into financial records and reconciliations.
  • Experience processing large volumes of financial transactions using distributed frameworks such as Spark or PySpark.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

companySlogan: Where capital works together
descriptionHtml:
Behind many of life’s most important transactions like buying a house, applying for a mortgage, getting a small business loan, or refinancing a credit card, is a network of credit relationships. Setpoint provides critical infrastructure for relationships between the world’s largest banks, credit funds and capital markets counterparties. Because when capital works together, ambition goes further.

About The Role

We are looking for an Analytics Engineer to join our team supporting our external data products. In this position, you will be reporting into our Head of Analytics and partnering closely with engineering, product, and implementation teams to build and maintain the data infrastructure that powers our products. This is a hands-on role where you’ll design and maintain data pipelines, create dashboards, and work directly with stakeholders to deliver insights that drive business outcomes.

Who Will Love This Job

  • A data product builder: You love creating robust, scalable analytics solutions that drive decision-making.
  • A client partner: You enjoy working directly with clients (asset managers, business owners, technical stakeholders) to understand their needs and deliver solutions that work in the real world.
  • A technical problem solver: You’re fluent in Python, SQL, and DBT, and know how to integrate them into a seamless analytics workflow.
  • A team collaborator: You thrive in cross-functional work with engineering, product, and implementation teams.
  • A strategic thinker: You look beyond the immediate task to anticipate analytics capabilities needed for future growth.

What You’ll Do

  • Own end-to-end implementations for the data products for our external customers.
  • Build and maintain scalable data pipelines and analytics models using Python, DBT, and SQL.
  • Create and manage dashboards in our external and internal analytics products so stakeholders have actionable insights.
  • Prototype new data products to add to our product suite.
  • Collaborate with engineering to drive the roadmap for the data products.
  • Use GitHub-based workflows to maintain clean, version-controlled analytics code.
  • Act as a subject matter expert for analytics best practices.

You should have

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a similar technical role.
  • Proven expertise DBT, SQL, and GitHub-based development. Python is a plus.
  • Strong experience designing, implementing, and maintaining data pipelines and models.
  • Experience in a customer-facing role, working with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Experience working with asset managers, business owners, or financial services data sets is a plus.
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Compensation: $160,000-$180,000 dependent on multiple factors, which may include the successful candidate's skills, experience and other qualifications.

About Setpoint

Setpoint is the new operating standard for asset-backed finance. Our collaborative, AI-native platform brings capital providers and borrowers together around the same verified information: extracting and verifying asset and servicer data, automating reporting and compliance, and surfacing risk and opportunity in real time. Leading institutions use Setpoint to strengthen oversight, reduce risk, and make better decisions across $550B+ in financed assets.

In August 2024, Setpoint announced the successful completion of its $31 million Series B funding round. 645 Ventures led the round, with significant strategic investments from Citi and Wells Fargo, alongside Andreessen Horowitz, NextView Ventures, Floating Point, Henry Kravis, Zillow founder’s 75 & Sunny, Vesta Ventures, Fifth Wall, Eltura Ventures, and Outrunner Capital.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes competitive salaries, stock options, unlimited paid time off, medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k), and health and wellness support through One Medical and a 24/7 Employee Assistance Program. We have offices in Austin, TX, New York, NY, and Salt Lake City, UT, with hybrid roles based in these locations and an expectation of two days a week in office (Tuesdays and Thursdays).

Setpoint provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

descriptionHtml:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

Finance Analytics builds Coinbase's financial data and reporting foundations so Finance, Accounting/Controllership, Treasury and FP&A can run accurate, timely and auditable operations. We sit at the intersection of data engineering, data science and business analytics: we own the source-of-truth financial datasets in Snowflake/Databricks, the pipelines that produce them, and the reconciliation, month-end close, safeguarding and reporting workflows built on top. We partner closely with Product Engineering to make sure upstream financial data is complete, reconciled and traceable.

What you'll be doing:

As the Staff Analytics Engineer on Finance Analytics, this person sets the technical direction for Coinbase's financial data layer and works side by side with Accounting, Controllership and FP&A. They need to understand how the books are closed, audited and controlled, not just how the data moves:

  • Partner with Accounting and FP&A to support month-end and quarter-end close, building the datasets, reconciliations and reporting that let us close the books accurately and on time.
  • Make financial data and pipelines audit-ready: SOX-compliant controls, lineage, change management and evidence for internal and external auditors.
  • Design and own the architecture of curated, well-documented source-of-truth financial datasets in Snowflake/Databricks that are correct, consistent and tie out to the general ledger.
  • Build and own scalable batch (and where needed, near-real-time) pipelines orchestrated with Airflow/dbt, including dependency management, backfills and runbooks.
  • Define reusable data quality and reconciliation frameworks (tests, monitoring, alerting, SLAs) and agree with Accounting on what "done" means for financial correctness.
  • Drive data contracts with upstream engineering teams, mentor Analytics Engineers, and build abstractions (Python packages, UDFs, LLM-assisted tools) that make finance data users more efficient.

What we look for in you:

  • Accounting exposure, either formal (accounting/finance degree or coursework, CPA/CMA) or hands-on work with Accounting/FP&A teams, such as supporting month-end close, reconciliations or financial reporting.
  • Expert SQL (window functions, complex aggregations, optimization) and strong Python (OOP, reusable frameworks). No production ETL or SQL experience = reject.
  • Deep data modeling: designed modular, reusable source-of-truth models (star/snowflake schemas, SCDs) used by many teams.
  • Built and owned production ETL/ELT pipelines with dbt, Airflow or similar, including testing, monitoring and SLAs.
  • Modern data warehouse/lakehouse experience (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift). Snowflake is not required; no comparable warehouse experience = reject.
  • Staff-level scope: led multi-quarter, cross-team technical initiatives, set architecture/direction, mentored engineers.

 

Pay Transparency Notice: Base salary varies by location (see range below). Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility, and benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k)).  

Annual base salary range (excluding equity and bonus):: $207,485 USD - $244,100 USD

  • Equal Opportunity Employer: Coinbase is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information. Applicants with criminal histories will be considered consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
  • US Applicants: View Employee Rights, Know Your Rights, and E-Verify Notice of Participation.
  • Accommodations: If you are an individual with a disability who needs a reasonable accommodation, email us your request and contact info at accommodations[at]coinbase.com. Need screen reading technology? Click here to download a free compatible screen reader and view the tutorial.
  • Data Privacy & Arbitration: By submitting your application, you agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice. US applicants: By submitting your application, you agree to Arbitration of Disputes.

descriptionHtml:
What you’ll need to succeed as a Analytics Engineer at XPO


 

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or equivalent experience/bootcamp completion accompanied by a strong portfolio of SQL projects.
  • 1 year mimum experience in Computer Science , Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Solid understanding of relational database concepts, JOIN types, aggregations, window functions, and subqueries/CTEs.
  • High attention to detail with an intrinsic desire to understand “why” a number looks wrong and dig into raw data to find the root cause.
  • Familiarity with the concepts of Git (making commits, pulling, pushing, and branching).

 

Preferred qualifications:

  • Familiarity with dbt: Any experience running a local dbt project, dbt Learn certification, or class projects using dbt.
  • Data Visualization Experience: Prior experience building simple dashboards in Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or Sigma.
  • Basic Python: Familiarity with Python basics (pandas, list manipulations, syntax).


 


About the Analytics Engineer job

Pay, benefits and more:

  • Competitive compensation package 
  • Full health insurance benefits are available on day one 
  • Life and disability insurance 
  • Earn up to 15 days of PTO over your first year  
  • 9 paid company holidays 
  • 401(k) option with company match 
  • Education assistance 
  • Opportunity to participate in a company incentive plan 


 

 

What you’ll do on a typical day:

 

  • Wryte Clean SQL: Write, Debug, and Optimize SQL queries using Common Table Expressions (CTES) to transform raw staging data into structured dimension and fact tables.
  • Dbt Development: Build and run modular models in dbt (Data Build Tool) under the guidance of senior engineers.
  • Schema & Format Alignment: Help map, cast, and clean incoming raw database schemas so they align with our global database definitions.
  • Implement Tests: Write automated dbt schema tests (such as unique, not_null, and referential integrity tests) to verify that raw data isn’t breaking our downstream models.
  • Debug Failures: Troubleshoot daily data quality alerts and pipeline warning logs, collaborating with data engineers to fix source data bugs.
  • Code Review Participation: Submit pull requests (PRs) for your code and participate in reviews to learn company coding styles and design standards.
  • Maintain Data Catalog: Ensure our internal data catalogs, dbt descriptions, and schema documentation are up to date so business users can easily find the metrics they need.
  • Dashboard Maintenance: Assist data analysts in pointing BI tools (like Tableau, Power BI, or Looker) to newly deployed data warehouse tables.
  • Requirement Gathering: Partner with analysts to understand what new fields or business metrics need to be added to existing datasets.
  • Skill Growth: Dedicate time to learning Python, basic command-line utilities, cloud data warehousing structures (Snowflake, BigQuery), and modern data modeling theories.

 

 

 

 

 

About XPO

XPO is a top ten global provider of transportation services, with a highly integrated network of people, technology and physical assets. At XPO, we look for employees who like a challenge and can communicate effectively in all situations. We want to leverage your skills and years of experience to drive positive results while ensuring a bright future for yourself and XPO. If you’re looking for a growth opportunity, join us at XPO. 

 

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, disability, veteran or other protected status.

 

All applicants who receive a conditional offer of employment may be required to take and pass a pre-employment drug test. 

 

The above statements are not an exhaustive list of all required responsibilities, duties and skills for this job classification. 

 

Review XPO's candidate privacy statement here.

Company Details

 Preferred Employers Insurance, A Berkley Company specializes in providing workers’ compensation insurance to California business owners. The company serves three major Product/Client Segments: Small Business, Mid-Larger Businesses and Group Association Members (Programs). The company’s distribution partners (agents & brokers) number just under 400 locations throughout the state. Preferred serves thousands of policyholders and provides medical claims handling and claims management as needed to care for injured workers. The company is rated A+ Superior by industry-rating organization, AM Best & Company.

Company URL: https://www.peiwc.com

The company is an equal opportunity employer.

Responsibilities

Preferred Employers Insurance is seeking a Data Analytics Engineer to support the Actuarial department's data, reporting, and analytical infrastructure. This role will own and enhance the actuarial sandbox datamart, data quality processes, reporting platforms, and analytical datasets that support actuarial, underwriting, claims, finance, and executive decision-making. The Data Analytics Engineer will partner with business and technical teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and well-governed data and analytical solutions while supporting advanced analytics and predictive modeling initiatives.

Key Functions Include But Are Not Limited To

  • Own, maintain, and enhance the actuarial sandbox datamart, including data architecture, permissions, documentation, and integration of new data sources.
  • Serve as the Actuarial department’s primary liaison for enterprise data platform initiatives, including requirements gathering, testing, issue resolution, implementation, and adoption.
  • Lead data stewardship activities, including data validation, reconciliation, QA/QC, auditing, root-cause analysis, and remediation of data integrity issues.
  • Automate data pipelines, reporting workflows, and repeatable analytical processes using SQL, Python, R, Power BI, Databricks, or comparable tools.
  • Perform business analytics that support underwriting, claims, finance, distribution, and product decisions.
  • Partner with actuarial staff on predictive modeling, segmentation, KPI development, model monitoring, and implementation of analytical solutions.
  • Translate business questions into clear data requirements, analytical approaches, and practical recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Coordinate day-to-day work and knowledge transfer from the department’s data engineering contractor, including documentation of systems and processes.
  • Establish scalable standards for data development, version control, testing, documentation, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Manage multiple recurring and ad hoc priorities while communicating status, risks, dependencies, and recommended actions.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve data quality, reporting efficiency, analytical capability, and business decision support.
  • Design, develop, and maintain curated analytical datasets, Power BI semantic models, dashboards, recurring reports, and monitoring tools that serve as trusted sources for operational, actuarial, and executive reporting.

This role is based in our San Diego, CA office and offers a hybrid work environment.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in data science, computer science, statistics, mathematics, actuarial science, engineering, or a related quantitative field.
  • 3–5 years of relevant experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence, or advanced analytics.
  • Property and casualty insurance or workers’ compensation experience is preferred.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and working proficiency in Python or R.
  • Experience building and maintaining automated data pipelines, analytical datasets, and reporting solutions.
  • Experience with Power BI, semantic models, dashboard development, and business intelligence solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead analytics, reporting, automation, or data engineering projects.
  • Understanding of data quality, reconciliation, testing, and documentation practices.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to collaborate across departments and translate business needs into scalable data and analytical solutions.
  • Experience coordinating contractors, vendors, or technical workstreams is preferred.
  • Experience with Databricks, cloud data platforms, or comparable data environments.

Additional Company Details

We do not accept any unsolicited resumes from external recruiting agencies or firms.

Benefits

The company offers a competitive compensation plan and robust benefits package for full time regular employees which for this role include:

  • Base Salary Range: $117,000 – $139,000 annually
  • Benefits: Health, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, Wellness, Paid Time Off, 401(k) and Profit-Sharing plans.

The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment.

Sponsorship Details

Sponsorship not Offered for this Role

descriptionHtml:
EvenUp is on a mission to close the justice gap using technology and AI. We empower personal injury lawyers and victims to get the justice they deserve. Our products enable law firms to secure faster settlements, higher payouts, and better outcomes for victims injured through no fault of their own in vehicle collisions, accidents, natural disasters, and more.

We are one of the fastest-growing vertical SaaS companies in history, and we are just getting started. EvenUp is backed by top VCs, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Bain Capital Ventures, SignalFire, and Lightspeed. We are looking to expand our team with talented, driven, and collaborative individuals who seek to have a lasting impact. Learn more at www.evenuplaw.com.

As an Analytics Engineer on the Finance Team you will build and maintain data models, transformation pipelines, and reporting which will be leveraged by the Finance team. You will have ownership around the accuracy and consistency of data and dictionaries for reporting and analytics within the Finance domain.

What You'll Do

  • Enable the Finance team by providing documented, auditable, trusted tables that analysts and AI-assisted workflows can use without engineering support
  • Design and build the Finance warehouse on Google Cloud (BigQuery), including environments, access controls, cost management, and documentation
  • Own PHI identification and removal by inventorying source columns, classifying them, and building the scrubbing layer (e.g., field-level removal, tokenization, and free-text redaction)
  • Define data specifications and partner cross-functionally with Analytics to ingest and incorporate necessary data feeds
  • Define and operate controls in partnership with Legal and Security to set the de-identification standard and automate checks for PHI leakage
  • Build finance data models in dbt, including recognized revenue, billings, cash collections, CARR bridge, and credit consumption
  • Reconcile and validate warehouse outputs against Salesforce, Stripe, and the general ledger
  • Transition existing finance workstreams and models from shared warehouse datasets to the new Finance-owned environment

What We Look For

  • 5+ years of data engineering, including at least one data warehouse built from scratch, ideally in finance at a pre-IPO company
  • Experience supporting finance, accounting, or revenue operations teams
  • Strong SQL, hands-on data modeling, and dbt experience, with familiarity with medallion architecture
  • Hands-on experience with BigQuery or comparable cloud data warehouse, including IAM, security controls, and policy tags
  • Experience de-identifying or restricting access to sensitive data (PHI, PII, financial data) and working knowledge of HIPAA de-identification methods
  • Experience building tested, documented dbt models that enable analyst self-sufficiency
  • Comfort partnering with Legal, Security, and Finance stakeholders to explain technical tradeoffs
  • Ability to work independently with no existing playbook; innate curiosity and root-cause analysis skills
  • Proficiency with software engineering best practices, including Git version control

NICE TO HAVE

  • Agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) are part of your regular workflow, and you verify and take ownership of AI-generated output
  • Experience building, shipping, evaluating, and monitoring LLM or agent systems in production
  • Google Cloud Sensitive Data Protection (DLP) or similar redaction tooling
  • Familiarity with Salesforce data models, Stripe billing data, or an ERP such as NetSuite
  • Experience with Metabase or similar BI tools
  • Python experience
  • Background in legal tech, healthcare, or another regulated industry

SUCCESS METRICS

  • First 90 days: Complete the source and PHI inventory, agree the de-identification standard with Legal and Security, and finalize the warehouse architecture and project plan
  • First 6 months: Core finance sources landing in the warehouse with automated PHI checks passing, and a first set of validated finance model
  • First 12 months: Finance reporting runs from the Finance-owned warehouse, recognized revenue and cash models reconcile to the ledger, and the Finance team queries the data without engineering support

Benefits & Perks:

As part of our total rewards package, we offer attractive benefits and perks to our employees, including:

  • Choice of medical, dental, and vision insurance plans for you and your family.
  • Additional insurance coverage options for life, accident, or critical illness.
  • Flexible paid time off, sick leave, short-term and long-term disability.
  • 10 US observed holidays, and Canadian statutory holidays by province.
  • A home office stipend.
  • 401(k) for US-based employees and RRSP for Canada-based employees.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • A local in-person meet-up program.
  • Hubs in San Francisco and Toronto.

(Please note the above benefits & perks are for full-time employees)

Notice to Candidates:

To ensure fairness and proper consideration, we do not accept resumes or expressions of interest via email or social media messages. If you’re interested in a role, please submit your application directly through our careers page.

Please note that EvenUp may use AI notetakers and other recording devices in the recruiting process. If you interview with us, with your consent, we may record your conversations and summarize them into notes for internal use. Recording is optional, and declining will not affect your candidacy.

EvenUp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to diversity and inclusion in our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Compensation Range: $160K - $180K

descriptionHtml:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

What You'll Do

Horizon3 is investing in a company-wide data strategy to make our data trusted, governed, and built to power revenue growth. The Federal Senior Product Analytics Engineer sits at the center of that effort: you're the bridge between how product data is modeled and built and how it's trusted and used across the company with a specific focus on our growing Federal business and platforms.

You'll work hand-in-hand with Data Engineering to help shape the canonical product data layer at the source, with the emerging Data Governance function to get metrics certified and documented, and with the Product analysts and PMs to turn that foundation into self-service, decision-ready data products. You're equally comfortable writing a dbt model, troubleshooting a pipeline, and helping a non-technical stakeholder define a company wide KPI.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable ELT pipelines and data models that translate raw product usage and event telemetry into trusted, well-documented analytics assets.
  • Partner with Product Engineering on the canonical product data layer — ensuring product usage cohorts and behavioral signal definitions are built on accurate, governed source data, not just what's convenient downstream.
  • Partner with the new Data Governance function: support taxonomy definition work, prepare metrics for certification, and maintain documentation to governance standards (including AI/machine-readable structure).
  • Build and own the semantic layer and self-service data models for Product Analytics, so internal stakeholders can query with confidence without needing a SQL expert in the room every time.
  • Own data quality monitoring and anomaly detection for product usage data specifically, partnering with Data Engineering when issues trace back to pipeline or platform-level causes.
  • Contribute analytics engineering support to the expansion/upsell cohort work, building the pipelines and models that turn usage thresholds, feature adoption, and seat utilization into certified, production-grade metrics.
  • Collaborate with data people across the company to help define analytics standards and tooling enablement and then ensure Product Analytics' practices align with the company-wide methodology as it matures.
  • Present technical data concepts and their business implications clearly to both engineering and non-technical stakeholders, including leadership.
  • Drive engineering best practices within the Product Analytics team's data assets.
  • Ensure compliance of new tooling and data flows with appropriate US Federal frameworks to include FedRAMP, DoW IL4/5 and growing into classified workloads.

What You'll Bring

  • A builder's mindset for data — you enjoy shaping how product data is modeled at the source, not just querying what already exists
  • Comfort moving fluidly between technical and business conversations
  • A governance driven approach to data. You default to documenting, defining, and getting alignment on what a metric means, rather than shipping something that "mostly works"
  • Bias toward self-service, you build data models assuming someone else will need to understand and trust them without you in the room
  • Curiosity and ownership when something looks off in the data
  • Adaptability in a fast-paced, evolving data environment and comfortable building foundational structure while priorities and requirements are still taking shape

Required Education/Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field
  • 7+ years of experience spanning data engineering and analytics, ideally in a role bridging both
  • Advanced SQL and hands-on experience with dbt and/or government approved equivalents
  • Hands-on experience building both production data pipelines and stakeholder-facing analytics/dashboards
  • Experience translating ambiguous business requirements into governed, well-documented data models

Preferred Education/Experience

  • Proven experience partnering directly with product/engineering teams on instrumentation and source data design — not just consuming what's handed downstream
  • Experience standing up or contributing to a data governance or metrics-certification process
  • Familiarity with BI/visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI)
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Experience with Git-based workflows and CI/CD for data pipelines
  • Regular use of AI in coding/development workflows (agents, memory files, copilots)
  • Experience operating within Federally compliant organizations and systems at the FedRAMP, IL4/5 levels and classified environments.

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.
  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.
  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.
  • Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.
  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

Compensation And Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

  • Base salary range: $142,718 - $186,560 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.
  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.
