descriptionHtml:
Why Wellthy is for you!

At Wellthy, we dream of a world where everyone has the care infrastructure they need to manage their own health and the health and well-being of their loved ones.

We’re building something new in the care space - reimagining how care is delivered, accessed, and supported by families around the globe. As we grow, we’re seeking collaborative, curious, and purpose-driven teammates to help us expand what’s possible.

Our work is grounded in the expertise of seasoned care professionals who deeply understand families’ real challenges paired with agile, tech-powered solutions that deliver support efficiently and at scale. We embrace a mindset of continuous learning, especially around emerging technologies. Tools like AI and other innovations are accelerators, enabling us to scale our impact, work smarter, and stay at the forefront of care delivery.

Through Wellthy, millions of families have access to support to help them manage care during every stage of life, with hands-on experts guiding families through caregiving or backup care journeys. And with the acquisition of Patch Caregiving, Wellthy continues to expand how care shows up for working families by pairing care navigation and coordination with on-site and near-site employer-based childcare. This combination allows us to support families not just in navigating care decisions, but in accessing real, hands-on help when and where they need it most. Together, we’re building a more connected, comprehensive care experience for families and caregivers alike.

We partner with leading companies including more than 40 Fortune 500 companies to support the care needs of their workforces globally. We also work alongside health plans and carriers to embed care support into their offerings, enhancing the experience and outcomes for members.

We’re building, evolving, and expanding the market category for care, and we’re looking for responsive, collaborative, curious, and purposeful colleagues to join us.

As an Analytics Engineer, you will help company leaders make better decisions by building and maintaining our data stack to power analysis, insights, and reports.

We love collaborating here at Wellthy and in this role you will work closely with all areas of our organization (Marketing, Product, Client Success and Care Team).

You will report directly to our VP Data, Product, and Engineering Operations.

To Be Successful In This Role

  • Build and maintain data transformations using dbt for analytics, and help empower end users to do self-service reporting and data exploration
  • Apply software engineering best practices to write efficient, well-tested code and contribute to improving the performance and automation of our ELT process and analytic workflows
  • Collaborate with data analysts, data engineers, and business stakeholders to gather and translate data requirements for downstream analyses and projects
  • Support company-wide efforts to improve data quality, accessibility, and governance
  • Ensure data quality and integrity by writing and maintaining tests
  • Participate in evaluations of analytics tools to help meet the needs of the organization
  • Follow and contribute to data team best practices, workflows, and documentation as we build a sustainable and scalable data function
  • Troubleshoot data issues and clearly communicate findings and processes to internal stakeholders, escalating complex problems when needed
  • Work closely with senior team members who will provide guidance on more complex modeling and architecture decisions, with opportunities to take on greater scope over time
  • Use a modern data stack of Fivetran, Snowflake, dbt, Hightouch, Snowplow, DeepNote, Metaplane, and Omni

Qualifications Required For This Role Include

To be successful in this role, you’ll need to be open to learning, experimenting, and evolving. Comfort with emerging technology and curiosity around how tools like AI can support your workflow or help families more effectively is a plus.

  • 2–5 years of experience in analytics engineering or a closely related role
  • Experience with analytics modeling (e.g. dimensional modeling, staging/intermediate/mart layers)
  • Strong SQL skills
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining data transformations with dbt or similar tools
  • Comfortable using the command line and version control (git)
  • Experience querying a cloud data warehouse (e.g. Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift)
  • Experience using AI tools (e.g. Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to write, explain, and QA code, along with the judgment to review, test, and validate AI-generated output before it goes into production
  • Strong communicator, life-long learner, problem solver, and always curious

Qualifications That Are Preferred But Not Mandatory

  • Experience writing basic Python scripts (e.g. for data processing, API calls, or automation)
  • Experience working with user event tracking data to support product analytics (e.g. Snowplow, Segment, Rudderstack)
  • Experience building reporting in modern BI tools (e.g. Omni, Looker, Tableau, Thoughtspot)
  • Experience automating data workflows
  • Familiarity with AWS tools (e.g. S3, Lambda)

Total Rewards Package

  • Salary Range: $125,000.00 - $152,000.00
  • Remote work environment.
  • Medical, dental and vision benefits within 30 days of hire.
  • Retirement saving account with matching company contributions.
  • Mental health benefits.
  • 15 days paid vacation, two additional days for each subsequent years (up to a maximum of 25 days)
  • Sick and Caregiving Days
  • Professional development initiatives for growth.
  • Generous parental leave (maternal and paternal) during a new child’s first year (born into family or adopted) and pregnancy loss leave.

Location:

This is a fully remote position. Our Wellthians are located throughout the United States but we are currently not accepting candidates in the following states: Alaska, Hawaii, Idaho, Maine, Mississippi, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Dakota, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, and West Virginia.

Role Requirements

To work from home, you must have a strong internet connection, quiet space to take calls and a professional (distraction free) environment.

What’s Next?

We encourage you to apply for this position by clicking the apply here button on job posting and attaching your resume. We understand that there is no “perfect” candidate and never expect every candidate to meet 100% of the qualifications listed above. We look for our Wellthian’s to enhance and advance our company from their past experiences. Our diverse backgrounds and perspectives are what make Wellthy a top company to work for. We hope that it not only encourages you but excites you to get started with our process.

All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability protected veteran status, or any other characteristics protect by law.

For those who require reasonable accommodations, please let us know on your application or email us at jobs@wellthy.com.

descriptionHtml:
About the Role

1-800-FLOWERS.COM, Inc. is seeking a Senior Data Solutions Engineer to join our growing Data Products & Platforms team. This role is ideal for an experienced data professional who works comfortably across analytics engineering and data engineering and can translate business needs into trusted, scalable data solutions.


As a senior individual contributor, you will help shape our analytics data layer, standardize business metrics and datasets, and enable high-quality reporting and self-service analytics across the organization. You will partner closely with business stakeholders, analytics teams, and technical partners to onboard data from multiple systems and make it reliable, well-documented, and ready for advanced analytics and AI applications.


What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and own analytics-ready datasets within Snowflake.
  • Develop and maintain curated ELT pipelines using Coalesce.io, dbt, or similar tools.
  • Create semantic views that standardize business logic, KPIs, and metric definitions.
  • Partner directly with business stakeholders to understand data, reporting, and analytical needs.
  • Translate complex or ambiguous requirements into scalable, reusable data solutions.
  • Onboard data from multiple source systems and standardize information across brands and business areas.
  • Develop dimensional data models, including fact and dimension tables and star schemas.
  • Enable self-service analytics through platforms such as Sigma and Power BI.
  • Establish clear documentation for datasets, metrics, analytical models, and business rules.
  • Monitor and improve data quality, performance, accuracy, and reliability.
  • Collaborate with data engineering and platform teams to evolve the enterprise analytics data layer.
  • Deliver high-quality datasets that support forecasting, machine learning, generative AI, and other advanced analytics initiatives.
  • Provide senior-level guidance on analytics engineering practices, data modeling standards, and dataset design.
  • Independently own assigned business domains and help drive the enterprise data roadmap.


What We’re Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Five or more years of experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related field.
  • Advanced SQL skills with experience developing complex queries and data transformations.
  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake or another modern cloud data warehouse.
  • Experience building and maintaining ETL or ELT pipelines using Coalesce.io, dbt, or a comparable framework.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, including dimensional modeling, fact and dimension tables, and star schemas.
  • Experience integrating, standardizing, and normalizing data from multiple source systems.
  • Proven ability to work directly with business stakeholders and translate their needs into effective data solutions.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, and take ownership of projects with limited oversight.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience with Snowflake, Coalesce.io, or dbt.
  • Experience designing or managing semantic or metrics layers.
  • Familiarity with Sigma, Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar business intelligence tools.
  • Knowledge of modern data-stack and analytics-engineering best practices.
  • Experience with data documentation, testing, quality validation, or observability tools.
  • Exposure to forecasting, machine learning, generative AI, or other advanced analytics workflows.
  • Experience supporting merchandising, marketing, inventory, costing, or other enterprise business data.


Why Join Us?

  • Join a modern data organization that approaches data as a product.
  • Work with a contemporary technology stack that includes Snowflake, Coalesce.io, Sigma, and Power BI.
  • Take ownership of high-impact data solutions used across multiple business areas.
  • Help shape how the organization standardizes, trusts, and scales its data.
  • Collaborate with business and technical leaders on highly visible enterprise initiatives.
  • Operate with meaningful autonomy while contributing to a close-knit, growing team.


1-800-FLOWERS.COM, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.


The expected salary range for this position is $95,000 to $105,000 annually. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, internal equity, and other factors permitted by law.

To support our commitment to being an employer of choice, we offer comprehensive and competitive health, wellness, and additional benefits to eligible full-time team members. Benefit eligibility may vary based on location, average hours worked, and length of service.

Benefits may include*:

  • Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance for the associate and eligible dependents
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • 401(k) retirement savings program
  • Mental health resources and Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Paid vacation time (accrued based on hours worked and tenure)
  • Paid company holidays

- Proven ability to work directly with business stakeholders and translate their needs into effective data solutions.
- Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.

- Direct experience with Snowflake, Coalesce.io, or dbt.
- Experience designing or managing semantic or metrics layers.
- Familiarity with Sigma, Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar business intelligence tools.

- Experience with data documentation, testing, quality validation, or observability tools.
- Exposure to forecasting, machine learning, generative AI, or other advanced analytics workflows.
- Experience supporting merchandising, marketing, inventory, costing, or other enterprise business data.


Why Join Us?

- Join a modern data organization that approaches data as a product.
- Work with a contemporary technology stack that includes Snowflake, Coalesce.io, Sigma, and Power BI.

Ready to Help Shape How Data and AI Are Used Across the Business?


Are You Someone Who...


  • Has expert SQL skills and hands-on experience with dbt in a production environment?
  • Understands dimensional modeling deeply, including fact design, star/snowflake schemas, and slowly changing dimensions?
  • Has built semantic layers, governed metrics, and trusted datasets that business teams rely upon?
  • Is comfortable working across Snowflake and Power BI, including data models, DAX, governed datasets, access controls, and cost-aware design?
  • Has practical experience applying AI or generative AI to enterprise analytics and understands the importance of using approved, appropriately secured data?
  • Enjoys translating business needs into well-designed data products and explaining technical concepts clearly to stakeholders?
  • Wants to help establish standards and build trusted data assets that an organization will rely on for years to come?


If you answered yes, this may be the opportunity for you.


Founded in 1974, Brandes Investment Partners is a pioneer in global value investing. We serve institutions, pension funds, intermediaries, and financial advisors worldwide through a disciplined, long-term investment approach grounded in the principles of Benjamin Graham.


We are seeking a Senior Analytics Engineer (AI-Enabled) to join our newly established Data Office as one of its founding hires. You’ll help build and own the governed analytics layer that supports reporting, self-service analytics, AI, and better decision-making across the firm. The annual base salary range we reasonably expect to pay for this role is $130,000 to $165,000. Placement within the range will depend on several factors, including the candidate’s experience, skills, qualifications, and overall fit for the position, as well as internal equity considerations and market conditions.


What You’ll Do


This is a hands-on senior role with the opportunity to help establish our analytics environment and standards from the beginning. You will:


  • Design and build the analytics layer in Snowflake using dbt, transforming raw data into trusted, well-documented, reusable models.
  • Establish a single source of truth for key business measures by defining and maintaining semantic layers and governed metrics.
  • Partner with teams across operations, investments, distribution, and client service to translate business needs into data models, certified datasets, and reporting solutions.
  • Build and support governed Power BI datasets and dashboards that enable reliable self-service analytics.
  • Identify and deliver AI-enabled analytics use cases, including natural language querying and LLM-powered workflows using governed data.
  • Establish strong practices around data quality, documentation, lineage, testing, code review, and CI/CD.
  • Partner with the Senior Data Engineer on architecture, data ingestion, performance, and cost-efficient use of the platform.
  • Help drive adoption through documentation, training, and enablement while measuring the usage and business value of the solutions delivered


What We’re Looking For


We’re looking for a hands-on senior technical builder who combines strong technical depth with business fluency. Preference given to local candidates but will consider non-local or remote. Candidates require a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, Finance, or a related field, along with a minimum of six years of experience in analytics engineering, BI development, or data engineering, including at least three years building production data models on a cloud data platform.


The role calls for production experience with dbt and Snowflake, a track record of delivering governed metrics and reporting to business stakeholders, and hands-on experience delivering AI-enabled analytics or generative AI use cases using enterprise data. Experience within financial services, asset management, or another regulated environment is strongly preferred.

Experience with Snowflake Cortex, Python/Snowpark, Airflow, Dagster, Fivetran, Atlan, Alation, or Monte Carlo is also valuable, as is exposure to data governance and data stewardship initiatives.


Why This Role Matters


This isn't simply an opportunity to maintain an established reporting environment.


It’s an opportunity to help build the foundation for how Brandes uses trusted data and AI. As one of the founding hires of the Data Office, you'll have the opportunity to establish standards, build governed data assets, and help shape capabilities designed to support the firm for years to come

If you're the kind of person who looks at data and sees the opportunity to make it more trusted, more useful, and more intelligent, we'd like to hear from you.


Why Join Brandes?


As you get to know Brandes, you will quickly recognize that value is at the heart of everything we do. Value refers not only to our investment style, but also to how we engage with our colleagues and conduct ourselves as a firm.


We often say that Brandes is purpose-built for value. We believe this focus on value-valuing our colleagues sets us apart.


This role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by managing your own territory while being part of a firm that values its people and fosters an environment that supports our mission: "To be an exceptional firm which provides superior investment advisory services in an atmosphere of accomplishment and enjoyment."


Our Workplace


We are looking for dynamic, self-motivated individuals with diverse perspectives and experiences who are eager to roll up their sleeves and become part of a collaborative team culture built on mutual respect.


At Brandes, you'll work in an environment where colleagues can connect, thrive, and grow. We value our clients and are committed to placing their interests ahead of our own.


As part of our inclusive workplace, we take a holistic approach to supporting our people. You'll have access to comprehensive benefits and programs designed to promote health, wellbeing, and professional development at every stage of life and career.


Team members enjoy competitive compensation, firm-contributed retirement plans, support for all family types, and policies grounded in respect and flexibility. You take care of our clients-and Brandes helps take care of you.


Health & Wellbeing

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision (HSA and FSA options)
  • Fertility benefits, telemedicine, and mental health support
  • Generous PTO, holidays, and parental leave

Financial Security

  • 401(k) match and profit sharing with employer contributions
  • Company HSA contributions
  • Life, disability, critical care, and pet insurance

Wellness & Community

  • Fitness benefits, wellness programs, and employee-led resource groups
  • Paid time off to volunteer in your community
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and mental health resources

Growth & Development

  • CFA sponsorship and generous tuition reimbursement
  • Internal mobility
  • Career development programs


We provide equal opportunity to all qualified applicants. All candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, disability status, protected veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by law.


We offer a welcome and inclusive environment that values diversity and a culture in which employees feel empowered to share their perspectives.


Brandes Investment Partners, L.P. will not request credit information or reports (or other sensitive information) from a job candidate via email. Please report any suspicious emails from Brandes at Careers@Brandes.com.


The salary range for this position represents what we reasonably expect to pay at the time of hire. Actual compensation will be based on a variety of factors as permitted by law, including relevant experience, skills, education, and work location. We are committed to equitable and transparent pay practices.

About The Role

Total Wine & More is seeking a Senior Analytics Engineer to join our growing Data Services team in our Bethesda, MD office This role will play a pivotal role in transforming raw data into trusted, actionable insights. In this role, you will bridge the gap between data engineering and data analysis, building scalable, well-documented, and tested data models that empower business users across merchandising, supply chain, marketing, and e-commerce. This role reports to the Senior Director, BI & Data Platform.

You will

  • Design, build, and maintain robust, modular, and scalable data models using tools like dbt to support self-service analytics and reporting.
  • Partner with data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to translate business logic into clean, reusable data transformations.
  • Own and optimize semantic layers and data marts that power dashboards, KPIs, and advanced analytics.
  • Ensure data quality, consistency, and governance across multiple domains (e.g., sales, inventory, customer loyalty).
  • Collaborate with data platform teams to improve data tooling, observability, and performance.
  • Contribute to the documentation and data literacy efforts across the organization.

You will come with

  • Bachelor's Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics or related fields required or equivalent years of experience.
  • Master's Degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering). preferred or equivalent years of experience.
  • 3-6 years experience in analytics engineering, data modeling, or BI development.
  • Expert-level SQL skills and strong experience with dbt, Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar modern data stack tools.
  • Familiarity with version control (e.g., Git), CI/CD pipelines, and data testing frameworks (e.g., dbt tests, Great Expectations).
  • Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, data warehousing, and ETL/ELT best practices.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally in a large, matrixed organization.
  • Exposure to data visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI).

We offer

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Generous store discounts
  • Health care plans (medical, prescription, dental, vision)
  • 401(k), HSA, FSA, Pre-tax commuter benefits
  • Disability & life insurance coverage
  • Paid parental leave
  • Pet insurance
  • Critical illness and accident insurance
  • Discounted home and auto insurance
  • College tuition assistance
  • Career development & product training
  • Consumer classes

Description

The USRM Data Office turns data into a competitive advantage. As a Principal Data Solutions Analyst, you’ll design and develop solutions that power Distribution & Marketing—translating business needs into technical requirements, building prototypes, and partnering with data engineers to deliver scalable data products on Snowflake. You’ll use advanced SQL and Python skills to solve complex problems, balance competing priorities, and help stakeholders make faster, better business decisions.

About The Team

The Data Office within Insights & Solutions at Liberty Mutual partners across USRM to define data strategy, deliver data products, and govern data for quality, security, and compliance. Our performance-driven team is passionate about using data to create value for customers and drive business results. The Distribution & Marketing Data Products team partners with business, reporting, and analytics stakeholders to identify emerging data needs and turn them into reliable, reusable solutions.

Why this role?

  • Solve high-impact Distribution & Marketing challenges through hands-on data solutioning.
  • Collaborate with business and technical leaders to build our modern data landscape.
  • Help shape scalable, AI-ready data products that enable better business decisions.

This is a ranged posting. Grade level offered will be determined based on individual skills & experience.

For this role, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship now or in the future.

  • This role may have in-office requirements dependent upon candidate location.**

At Armanino, you determine your career path. This means it's possible to pursue challenges you are passionate about, in industries you care about.

Armanino is proud to be Among the top 20 Largest Accounting and Consulting Firms in the Nation and one of the Best Places to Work. We want you to integrate all aspects of your life with your career.

At Armanino, we know you don’t check-out of life when you check-in at work. That’s why we’ve created a unique work environment where your passions, work, and family & friends can overlap. We want to help you achieve growth by giving you access to a network of smart and supportive people, willing to listen to your ideas.

Job Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain curated Gold-layer datasets, reusable analytical data products, and business-ready transformations within Microsoft Fabric.
  • Translate business requirements and source-system data into well-structured facts, dimensions, conformed attributes, and governed business logic that support enterprise analytics.
  • Develop, enhance, and support Power BI semantic models, including relationships, measures, calculated logic, row-level security, refresh behavior, and performance considerations.
  • Own low to moderate-complexity engineering work with limited day-to-day direction, researching solutions and driving assigned work from requirements through validation and release.
  • Partner closely with senior analytics engineers to learn established architecture and development patterns, absorb repeatable work, and expand independent ownership over time.
  • Use SQL and, as appropriate, Python, Spark, notebooks, DAX, or Power Query to transform, validate, troubleshoot, and reconcile analytical data.
  • Create and execute practical unit tests, source-to-output reconciliations, regression checks, and deployment validation to confirm grain, joins, totals, historical behavior, and downstream readiness.
  • Participate in Git-based development practices, including branches, pull requests, peer reviews, work-item traceability, and controlled promotion through development, test, and production environments.
  • Learn and contribute to CI/CD, Microsoft Fabric deployment pipelines, release automation, environment configuration, and repeatable deployment evidence.
  • Investigate data discrepancies, failed refreshes, model issues, and deployment defects; document findings clearly, resolve routine problems, and escalate complex issues with relevant diagnostic evidence.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, data mapping, runbooks, release notes, lineage information, and operational procedures that make solutions supportable and repeatable.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Analytics & Insights, DataOps, governance, consultants, and business stakeholders while maintaining clear ownership of assigned day-to-day work.
  • Apply established naming, security, documentation, change-management, monitoring, and engineering standards, and recommend practical improvements as experience grows.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence engineering, data development, or a closely related technical role.
  • Strong working knowledge of SQL, including joins, aggregations, window functions, data profiling, troubleshooting, and source-to-output reconciliation.
  • Experience building or supporting analytical datasets, dimensional models, semantic models, reporting data structures, or data transformation workflows.
  • Understanding of data engineering and analytics fundamentals, including grain, keys, relationships, transformation logic, data quality, and validation concepts.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently with broad objectives, identify gaps, research solutions, and drive assigned tasks to completion before escalating for assistance.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and learning agility, with a genuine interest in understanding both the technical solution and the business process it supports.
  • Ability to create and execute practical testing and validation plans that confirm data accuracy, reliability, and deployment readiness.
  • Strong attention to detail and appreciation for source control, documentation, operational standards, and maintainable engineering practices.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to collaborate with senior engineers while independently managing day-to-day work and priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric components such as lakehouses, warehouses, notebooks, data pipelines, semantic models, deployment pipelines, monitoring, or capacity concepts.
  • Experience with Power BI semantic models and DAX, including relationships, filter context, totals, time intelligence, row-level security, and performance troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with dimensional modeling and medallion architecture, particularly the development of curated Gold-layer data products from governed Bronze and Silver foundations.
  • Experience with Python, PySpark, Spark SQL, Fabric notebooks, Power Query, or comparable data transformation technologies.
  • Experience using Git, branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews, and work-item-linked development practices.
  • Exposure to Azure DevOps, GitHub, CI/CD, deployment automation, infrastructure-as-code, environment configuration, or release governance.
  • Experience documenting data lineage, business rules, data contracts, technical designs, runbooks, or deployment procedures.
  • Experience working in an evolving environment where architecture, standards, and processes are being established while active delivery continues.

descriptionHtml:
Convene Hospitality Group (CHG) operates a global portfolio of lifestyle brands focused on creating places and experiences that bring people together. The company designs, develops, and operates hospitality-driven destinations to host gatherings of all kinds, ranging from small corporate meetings to immersive brand activations and beyond. We love bringing people together in person, and that passion for great experiences extends to our employees as well. If you're interested in creating inspiring moments of connection, consider joining our team.


Analytics Engineer

We’re hiring Analytics Engineers to join Convene Hospitality Group’s (CHG) Technology organization. We’re building out the foundational platform to democratize data at CHG so that a venue GM, a finance lead, and an AI agent are all able to ask a question and get the same trusted answer.


Analytics engineers own the full path from ingestion to visualization, including governance and observability. You’ll bring data in from source systems, model it through bronze, silver, and gold, define the semantic layer, and breathe life into the visualizations, conversational analytics, and business agents that teams rely on to make decisions.


You’ll join the Data Platform team, reporting to its Engineering Manager, and work closely with other analytics engineers and business partners across the company. You’ll build on Snowflake, dbt, and Fivetran, using Snowflake-native capabilities like semantic views and Cortex to power ThoughtSpot and beyond.


What You’ll Do:

  • Partner with the business. Work with Finance, Sales, Operations, and venue teams to understand their needs and turn them into models and metrics they trust.
  • Own ingestion for your domains. Set up and maintain Fivetran connectors, land data in bronze, and handle schema drift and load failures.
  • Model the business. Build dbt models that move data through bronze, silver, and gold, and shape gold around how CHG runs so people outside the data team can understand and use it.
  • Own the semantic layer. Set metrics, dimensions, and relationships so a number means the same thing in a dashboard, a search, or an agent’s answer. Tune synonyms and descriptions so a model picks the right measure, trace wrong answers to the root cause, and help us decide where each definition lives.
  • Power self-service in ThoughtSpot. Build the models and Liveboards that let teams explore data on their own, and turn the questions people actually ask into new test cases.
  • Own the quality of conversational analytics. Test answers the way you’d test code. Build and maintain a golden question set of real business questions paired with certified answers as your test cases, run them as a regression suite on every model or semantic change, and block releases that fail. Back your models with dbt tests and clear documentation.
  • Apply governance day to day. Tag sensitive data at ingestion, apply access controls such as tag-based masking and row access policies, and follow the standards the team sets, so an agent only returns what the person asking is allowed to see.
  • Keep it fast and fresh. Monitor freshness, data quality, and pipeline health so problems surface to you before they reach a dashboard or an agent’s answer. Tune query and model performance, from incremental dbt models to warehouse sizing, so answers come back fast and Snowflake costs stay in check.
  • Work AI-native. Lead with specs, then hand agents end-to-end tasks, from exploring source data to building models, tests, and documentation. Let agents run loose in the wild (with some guardrails in place). You hold agent and human work to the same review bar, so code from Claude and code from a teammate get the same scrutiny. Share what you learn, and help set the playbook for agentic data work.


What We Look For:

  • You have 3+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI development, building data products people rely on.
  • You write strong SQL and have built and maintained dbt models in production.
  • You’ve worked in a cloud data warehouse, ideally Snowflake.
  • You’ve worked with ELT ingestion tools like Fivetran and can troubleshoot source-data issues such as schema changes, late-arriving data, and API limits.
  • You understand data modeling: dimensional models, medallion layering, and clear reasoning about grain, slowly changing dimensions, and event lifecycles.
  • You’ve built dashboards or self-service data products that people use to make decisions.
  • You test and document your work as a habit.
  • You’re curious about the business. You ask what decision a request supports before you start building.

Convene Hospitality Group (CHG) operates a global portfolio of lifestyle brands focused on creating places and experiences that bring people together. The company designs, develops, and operates hospitality-driven destinations to host gatherings of all kinds, ranging from small corporate meetings to immersive brand activations and beyond. We love bringing people together in person, and that passion for great experiences extends to our employees as well. If you're interested in creating inspiring moments of connection, consider joining our team.


Analytics Engineer
We’re hiring Analytics Engineers to join Convene Hospitality Group’s (CHG) Technology organization. We’re building out the foundational platform to democratize data at CHG so that a venue GM, a finance lead, and an AI agent are all able to ask a question and get the same trusted answer.


Analytics engineers own the full path from ingestion to visualization, including governance and observability. You’ll bring data in from source systems, model it through bronze, silver, and gold, define the semantic layer, and breathe life into the visualizations, conversational analytics, and business agents that teams rely on to make decisions. 


You’ll join the Data Platform team, reporting to its Engineering Manager, and work closely with other analytics engineers and business partners across the company. You’ll build on Snowflake, dbt, and Fivetran, using Snowflake-native capabilities like semantic views and Cortex to power ThoughtSpot and beyond.


What You’ll Do:

- Partner with the business. Work with Finance, Sales, Operations, and venue teams to understand their needs and turn them into models and metrics they trust.
- Own ingestion for your domains. Set up and maintain Fivetran connectors, land data in bronze, and handle schema drift and load failures.
- Model the business. Build dbt models that move data through bronze, silver, and gold, and shape gold around how CHG runs so people outside the data team can understand and use it.
- Own the semantic layer. Set metrics, dimensions, and relationships so a number means the same thing in a dashboard, a search, or an agent’s answer. Tune synonyms and descriptions so a model picks the right measure, trace wrong answers to the root cause, and help us decide where each definition lives.
- Power self-service in ThoughtSpot. Build the models and Liveboards that let teams explore data on their own, and turn the questions people actually ask into new test cases.
- Own the quality of conversational analytics. Test answers the way you’d test code. Build and maintain a golden question set of real business questions paired with certified answers as your test cases, run them as a regression suite on every model or semantic change, and block releases that fail. Back your models with dbt tests and clear documentation.
- Apply governance day to day. Tag sensitive data at ingestion, apply access controls such as tag-based masking and row access policies, and follow the standards the team sets, so an agent only returns what the person asking is allowed to see.
- Keep it fast and fresh. Monitor freshness, data quality, and pipeline health so problems surface to you before they reach a dashboard or an agent’s answer. Tune query and model performance, from incremental dbt models to warehouse sizing, so answers come back fast and Snowflake costs stay in check.
- Work AI-native. Lead with specs, then hand agents end-to-end tasks, from exploring source data to building models, tests, and documentation. Let agents run loose in the wild (with some guardrails in place). You hold agent and human work to the same review bar, so code from Claude and code from a teammate get the same scrutiny. Share what you learn, and help set the playbook for agentic data work.


What We Look For:

- You have 3+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI development, building data products people rely on.
- You write strong SQL and have built and maintained dbt models in production.
- You’ve worked in a cloud data warehouse, ideally Snowflake.
- You’ve worked with ELT ingestion tools like Fivetran and can troubleshoot source-data issues such as schema changes, late-arriving data, and API limits.
- You understand data modeling: dimensional models, medallion layering, and clear reasoning about grain, slowly changing dimensions, and event lifecycles.
- You’ve built dashboards or self-service data products that people use to make decisions.
- You test and document your work as a habit.
- You’re curious about the business. You ask what decision a request supports before you start building.
- You use AI agents for real multi-step work, like writing SQL and dbt models, generating tests, and drafting documentation, and you verify what they produce.
- You explain your work clearly to technical and non-technical partners.
- You take ownership. You see work through, ask for help when you’re stuck, and look for ways to make things better.


Bonus Points

- You’ve evaluated LLM or natural-language analytics output, for example with golden sets or regression testing.
- You’ve worked in hospitality, events, real estate, or another customer-centric, multi-location business.

descriptionHtml:
EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. With its EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell brands specializing in Home, Health, and Wellness service industries, EverCommerce provides end-to-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications. Learn more at EverCommerce.com.

We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here: https://www.evercommerce.com/about-us/careers/

EverHealth, a business within EverCommerce, provides modern end-to-end solutions for healthcare providers. Our open, connected ecosystem of solutions and services helps providers engage patients, increase revenue, improve business efficiency, and remain market competitive. We serve 72,000+ healthcare practices and counting. EverHealth consists of SaaS products including DrChrono, iSalus, CollaborateMD, Updox, eProviderSolutions, AlertMD, and MD Coder. With two EHRs and platform-level solutions such as communication platforms and a clearinghouse, EverHealth delivers a turn-key, end-to-end solution for the software needs of a modern healthcare practice.

We are looking for a Forward Deployed Data Engineer III, a data engineer or analytics engineer who wants to work directly with the business, to join EverHealth’s revenue cycle management (RCM) team. RCM is at the heart of how our customers get paid, and we are building a new generation of RCM tools that pair modern workflow software with AI agents to help billing teams work smarter, resolve issues faster, and collect more of what they’ve earned. This work is part of our broader focus on finding where automation, AI, and new experiences can make the biggest impact across the EverHealth portfolio.

As a Forward Deployed Data Engineer III, your customers are our internal RCM professional services team and the product and engineering teams that serve them. Your job is to make sure the people accountable for results have the data and insights they need. Today, many RCM workflows and outcomes are hard to see. You will close those visibility gaps by building the pipelines, models, dashboards, and custom reports that show what is happening across our operations, our products, and the AI agents working alongside our teams.

This is a forward deployed role. You will spend time with billers, operations leaders, and product partners to understand the questions they need answered, then deliver quickly: a first trusted metric within weeks, working dashboards soon after, and a durable data foundation over time. You will partner with the forward deployed engineers building AI agents so that every agent is measurable from day one and its impact is visible to the people who depend on it. This role is part of the EverHealth engineering organization, reporting to the engineering leader for RCM, with dotted-line partnerships into RCM professional services and the RCM product teams.

Our warehouse and BI stack for this work is still taking shape, so you will help evaluate and choose it. As the program grows, you will help shape how EverHealth uses data to learn, adjust, and move faster.

How this role fits: Our software engineers build the RCM worklist and the shared automation foundation that agents run on. Our forward deployed engineers work with RCM operations to build and tune use-case agents on top of it. As our data-focused forward deployed engineer, you make the work and its outcomes measurable.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with RCM professional services, operations, product, and engineering stakeholders to understand the decisions they need to make and the data that supports them
  • Identify visibility gaps across RCM workflows and turn them into clear metrics and reporting requirements, such as A/R aging and days in A/R, clean-claim and rejection rates, denial rates by payer and reason code, net collection rate, cost-to-collect, worklist volume, backlog and throughput, and productivity per FTE or BPO team
  • Design, build, and maintain data pipelines and models that bring together data from EverHealth products, our clearinghouse (including 835/ERA remittances and 277CA acknowledgements), payer responses, operational tools, and AI agents
  • Build dashboards, self-service BI, and custom reports that give accountable owners timely, trustworthy insight into performance and outcomes
  • Instrument AI agents and automations so their resolution rates, accuracy, handle time, and business impact can be compared with human-driven work
  • Deliver quickly and iterate based on feedback, starting with the highest-value questions and evolving solutions as needs change
  • Keep data definitions, quality checks, and lineage documented and consistent so stakeholders trust the numbers
  • Help evaluate and shape our warehouse, transformation, and BI tooling as the stack takes form
  • Partner with the forward deployed engineers building AI agents, providing the data, metrics, and integrations they need
  • Use AI throughout the development lifecycle, including for analysis, SQL, pipeline development, testing, and documentation
  • Keep PHI within our AWS environment, with role-based access, audit logging, and de-identification for broader reporting, in line with HIPAA, SOC 2, and HITRUST requirements

Technology Environment:

  • Cloud Infrastructure: AWS
  • Languages: SQL and Python
  • Data Platforms: relational databases such as Postgres, MySQL, and MSSQL, plus cloud data warehouses and lakehouses such as Databricks, Redshift, or Snowflake (our stack is still being decided)
  • Data Tooling: ELT/ETL and transformation tools such as dbt, and orchestration tools such as Airflow or Dagster
  • BI & Reporting: modern BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Amazon QuickSight
  • AI: LLM and agent-based capabilities integrated into business workflows
  • Security & Compliance: HIPAA, SOC 2, and HITRUST, with PHI kept within our AWS environment

Skills and Experience needed for success in this role:

  • 5+ years of professional experience as a data engineer, analytics engineer, or software engineer with a strong data focus
  • Expert SQL and solid Python skills, with experience building and maintaining production data pipelines
  • Hands-on experience with data warehouses or lakehouses, dimensional modeling, and ELT/transformation tooling
  • Experience building dashboards and reports in modern BI tools that business stakeholders actually use to make decisions
  • Strong interpersonal skills: you build relationships with non-technical stakeholders, ask good questions, and translate business needs into metrics and reports
  • Ability to work with incomplete or messy data, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and deliver incremental value quickly
  • Daily, hands-on use of AI coding and agent tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) across the development lifecycle in your own work
  • An outcome-focused mindset, caring as much about the decisions the data enables as the data itself
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including presenting findings clearly to business audiences

Nice to Have:

  • Experience instrumenting or measuring AI agents, LLM applications, or automated workflows
  • Experience building AI agents or LLM-powered automation, including with AWS Bedrock or Bedrock AgentCore
  • Healthcare/RCM experience, such as claims, EDI 837/835, eligibility, denial and A/R workflows, and HIPAA
  • Experience with operational analytics for professional services, BPO, or contact center teams

Where: The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Jordan, New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States. Candidates based in the Chicago area will work hybrid, meeting with the team in person 1–2 days per week. Candidates elsewhere in the U.S. will work remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America. This role may also include periodic, optional travel to our RCM operations sites.

Benefits and Perks:

  • Hybrid or remote work, depending on location
  • Continued investment in your professional development
  • Day 1 access to robust health and wellness benefits, including an annual wellness stipend
  • 401k with up to a 4% match and immediate vesting
  • Flexible and generous (FTO) time-off
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program

Compensation: The target base compensation for this position is $140,000 to $170,000 USD per year in most US locations. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, and candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We look forward to reviewing your credentials and getting to know more about your experience!

EverCommerce uses approved artificial intelligence (“AI”) tools to support its business operations. Employees are encouraged to use authorized AI tools, when appropriate for their roles, to improve efficiency, quality, and innovation. All AI use must comply with company policies, including requirements concerning confidentiality, data security, intellectual property, accuracy, and human review. Employees remain responsible for reviewing and validating AI-assisted work.

descriptionHtml:
TITLE: Senior Analytics Engineer DEPARTMENT: Data REPORTS TO: Director of Data WHO WE ARE:

Thistle’s mission is to help people get and stay healthy while improving the sustainability of our food system. We make nutritious, delicious, ready-to-eat meals, snacks, and juices delivered right to our customers’ doorsteps. We’ve served over 27 million meals to customers all over America, but we’re just getting started. We’re launching in new cities, expanding our menu, and upgrading our user experience to mainstream a new way of eating that can genuinely heal people and our planet — and we need more teammates to join us.

Thistle is headquartered in San Francisco, but our product team is remote. Currently, the team has members in SF, LA, Oregon, Denver, Kansas City, Austin, and Philadelphia, with other Thistle departments spread across the US. You can learn more about life as a remote employee at Thistle here. While this is a remote role, the Senior Analytics Engineer will be expected to travel 2-4 times a year to visit our production facilities and collaborate with teammates in person.

About The Role

The Senior Analytics Engineer will play a critical leadership role in shaping and scaling Thistle’s data infrastructure, strategy, and culture. You will be responsible for driving the evolution of our modern data stack, delivering robust and high-quality data models, and enabling strategic, data-informed decisions throughout the business.

As a senior member of the Analytics team, you’ll act as both a technical expert and thought partner to cross-functional leaders, including marketing, product, engineering, operations, and finance. Your work will have a direct impact on Thistle’s growth trajectory, operational efficiency, and customer experience.

How You’ll Make a Difference

  • Own the architecture and governance of Thistle’s end-to-end data infrastructure, ensuring scalability, reliability, and adherence to best practices.
  • Lead the design and implementation of our core data models and pipelines (ETL/ELT), enabling advanced analytics, reporting, and experimentation.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment on data definitions, metrics, and source-of-truth models to ensure consistency and clarity across teams.
  • Develop and mentor analytics engineers and analysts, elevating technical standards and fostering a data-driven mindset throughout the company.
  • Serve as a strategic partner to senior leadership by identifying opportunities for data to unlock business value and advising on high-impact initiatives.
  • Continuously optimize the performance of our data warehouse (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift), workflows, and query efficiency.
  • Champion best-in-class tooling and practices, including dbt, Airflow, version control, testing frameworks, and documentation standards.
  • Support self-serve analytics by building scalable, intuitive data products, dashboards, and exploration tools tailored to business stakeholders.

Qualifications

Who You Are

  • 5–8+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data architecture, or data engineering, with a strong record of owning end-to-end data solutions.
  • Proven experience building and scaling cloud-based data ecosystems using modern tools like dbt, Airflow, and a cloud data warehouse (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift).
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python, with strong data modeling and transformation skills.

Pearson Virtual Schools (PVS) – Enabling Technology

About Pearson Virtual Schools



At Pearson Virtual Schools (PVS), we are committed to expanding access to high-quality education through innovative digital learning solutions. PVS is a division within Pearson, a global leader in the education industry. Our PVS Enabling Technology team plays a critical role in this mission by building scalable, trusted data products that empower school leaders, educators, and operational teams to make informed decisions that improve student outcomes.



As we evolve toward a Data Product–driven organization , we are investing in modern analytics capabilities that combine trusted data pipelines, semantic models, and self-service reporting experiences .



Role Overview



We are seeking a Power BI Developer to help build and deliver analytics and ETL (extract, transform & load) solutions that support decision-making across Pearson Virtual Schools. This role will work across data engineering and business intelligence , turning data into clear and useful reporting experiences.



You will work with data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to develop semantic models, dashboards, and reports that follow established data products and organizational standards. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with independent ownership of reporting work across the delivery lifecycle—from gathering requirements through deployment and support—while collaborating with experienced team members on broader analytics and data engineering initiatives.



What You’ll Do



Data Visualization & Reporting



  • Design and develop Power BI dashboards and reports that support school operations, student outcomes analysis, and enterprise reporting


  • Translate business needs into intuitive, actionable visualizations aligned with PVS reporting standards


  • Help improve report performance, usability, and accessibility for diverse end users (school leaders, analysts, executives)


  • Implement and maintain data security policies within reporting tools in adherence with PVS data security policies, governance and best practices


Semantic Modeling



  • Build and maintain Power BI semantic models (datasets) that serve as governed, reusable data foundations


  • Apply established data modeling practices such as star schema, DAX optimization, and row-level security


  • Partner with engineering to ensure alignment between data pipelines and reporting layer


Data Quality & Reliability



  • Validate data outputs and ensure consistency between reports and source systems


  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies, refresh failures, and performance issues


  • Contribute to monitoring, testing, and documentation of reporting solutions


  • Implement and validate Row Level Security in a multi-tenant environment


Collaboration & Delivery



  • Work closely with business stakeholders to refine requirements and prioritize features


  • Participate in design discussions, backlog refinement, and peer reviews


  • Communicate technical tradeoffs, risks, and timelines clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences


Scalability & Data Product Enablement



  • Contribute to the development of scalable, reusable reporting assets that align with PVS data product strategy


  • Support self-service analytics by enabling well-documented datasets and consistent definitions


  • Contribute to improvements in deployment practices, governance, and lifecycle management


What You Bring



Technical Expertise



  • 4+ Years of practical experience with Power BI , including report development, visualizations, DAX, Power Query, and semantic modeling; exposure to tools such as Tabular Editor 3 , DAX Studio , or ALM Toolkit is helpful


  • Strong knowledge of data modeling concepts , including star schema and fact/dimension design


  • Experience with SQL and working with structured datasets in data warehouses/lakehouses


  • Familiarity with data pipelines and integration concepts (e.g., Azure Data Factory, ETL/ELT patterns)


Problem Solving & Growth



  • Experience independently delivering reporting solutions from requirements through deployment and support


  • Ability to troubleshoot common data, performance, and visualization issues , with support when needed


  • Experience improving data quality, reliability, and usability


Collaboration & Communication



  • Strong communication skills that deliver exceptional value to internal and external customers


  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights


  • Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, analytics, and business teams


  • Strong documentation and knowledge-sharing practices


Qualifications



  • 3–5 years of experience in Power BI development, business intelligence, data analysis, or a related area


  • Experience building or supporting reports and dashboards used for operational or business decision-making


  • Experience working with data in an environment where tools, architecture, and governance practices continue to evolve


Preferred Experience



  • Experience in education, EdTech, or multi-tenant data environments


  • Experience with Google BigQuery


  • Exposure to data governance, lineage, and semantic layer standardization


  • Experience supporting self-service analytics at scale


Why Join Us



  • Contribute to meaningful analytics work that supports students, educators, and school systems nationwide


  • Be part of a growing Data Product organization shaping the future of analytics at PVS


  • Work in a collaborative environment that values innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement


  • Become part of the Pearson Virtual Schools mission where we are helping people achieve success through lifelong learning


Success in This Role Looks Like



  • Trusted, high-performing Power BI reports used consistently by stakeholders


  • Scalable semantic models enabling self-service analytics


  • Reduced data discrepancies and improved reporting reliability


  • Strong partnership across engineering, analytics, and business teams


  • Consistent delivery of reporting projects meeting and exceeding requirements and timeframes

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The Role

As a Data Engineer, you will handle everything from data architecture and modeling to data pipeline tooling and dashboarding. You will enable a range of other engineering and business teams to make impactful business decisions by laying the foundation of our large and unique datasets that span across multiple products. This role will support the product data engineering team.


The Product Data Engineering Team at Block builds and maintains the curated data foundation that powers all of Block's product lines — Cash App, Square, Afterpay, and Tidal. We transform raw event streams, transactional systems, and operational data into governed, tested, and reliable analytical assets across domains including banking, lending, commerce, investing, checkout, and AI assistants. We partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, and Applied AI teams to deliver the metrics, experimentation frameworks, and ML-ready datasets that enable Block's products to grow, improve, and serve customers at scale.

 

You Will
  • Lead the creation and optimization of data models across eventing, customer-level, and process-level data, leveraging AI-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery.
  • Take shared or independent technical ownership of critical data pipelines across Block — including foundational customer datasets, money transfer and movement pipelines, and the data infrastructure powering Block's experimentation platform.
  • Build monitoring to assess data quality and lineage and further, build AI agents for false positive reduction and automated resolution. 
  • Participate in on-call rotation, monitor daily execution, diagnose and log issues, and fix business critical pipelines to ensure SLAs are met with internal stakeholders. Automate this process through AI agents to focus human effort on highest priority tasks.
  • Work with non-technical partners and product teams to understand their needs, translate business requirements into applicable data requirements, and develop automated end-to-end solutions.

 

You Have
  • A minimum of 10 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 8 years and a Master’s degree; or equivalent experience.
  • High proficiency in SQL, Python, and Dbt
  • Experience designing medium-to-large data engineering solutions and responsible for the entire lifecycle of projects including scoping, design, development, testing, deployment, and documentation
  • Experience with ETL scheduling technologies with dependency checking, such as Airflow or Prefect, as well as 
  • Experience in schema design and dimensional data modeling
  • Experience with setting up data quality and data lineage monitoring
  • Experience with data driven decisions through AI and agentic automation

 

Technologies We Use and Teach
  • Snowflake
  • Databricks
  • Dbt
  • Github
  • Airflow
  • Prefect
  • Omni
  • Terraform

- Build monitoring to assess data quality and lineage and further, build AI agents for false positive reduction and automated resolution. 
- Participate in on-call rotation, monitor daily execution, diagnose and log issues, and fix business critical pipelines to ensure SLAs are met with internal stakeholders. Automate this process through AI agents to focus human effort on highest priority tasks.

- A minimum of 10 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 8 years and a Master’s degree; or equivalent experience.
- High proficiency in SQL, Python, and Dbt
- Experience designing medium-to-large data engineering solutions and responsible for the entire lifecycle of projects including scoping, design, development, testing, deployment, and documentation
- Experience with ETL scheduling technologies with dependency checking, such as Airflow or Prefect, as well as 
- Experience in schema design and dimensional data modeling
- Experience with setting up data quality and data lineage monitoring
- Experience with data driven decisions through AI and agentic automation

descriptionHtml:
Level Access is hiring a Senior Analytics Engineer to own the data products that power trusted reporting, business decisions and AI experiences at Level. With an initial focus on GTM and revenue, you will translate commercial data into reliable models, certified metrics and a governed semantic layer that people and AI agents can use consistently. 

You will work directly with senior leaders and data champions across the company. Our Senior Data Engineer owns the Databricks platform, ETL pipelines and operations. Your focus is the analytics layer: business modeling in dbt, metric implementation, semantic definitions and business-facing data products. You will partner closely on source requirements and upstream issues. 

What you will do 

You own the path from raw commercial data to certified metrics and KPIs that a person or an AI agent can act on. 

  • Own commercial data models. Design, build and maintain dbt models on Databricks for go-to-market and revenue data. Start with pipeline, bookings and subscriptions, then expand into other business domains as the company grows. 
  • Turn business definitions into certified metrics. Own the full catalog of go-to-market, revenue and customer metrics, from bookings and retention to pipeline, forecast, customer health and efficiency. Work with business leaders to drive alignment across each definition and its edge cases. Add new metrics as the business asks new questions. 
  • Maintain the semantic layer. Build and maintain Databricks metric views, the data dictionary and model documentation in Unity Catalog, so every certified metric has one definition used everywhere. 
  • Make commercial data AI-ready. Curate the catalog, descriptions and verified queries the AI agent reads over MCP and maintain a revenue regression question set that measures agent accuracy as models change. 
  • Protect data quality. Apply dbt model contracts and tests to certified models. Define freshness, volume and anomaly checks, maintain model lineage and work with the Senior Data Engineer to resolve upstream issues. 
  • Enable predictive analytics. Supply governed revenue, contract and subscription features to machine learning models, alerts and AI agents. 
  • Deliver business-facing analytics. Own GTM and revenue forecasting datasets and BI feeds. Translate stakeholder questions into reusable data products and prioritize work with business partners. 
  • Raise engineering standards. Review dbt code, establish modeling conventions and mentor peers. Use AI-assisted tools for SQL, tests, and documentation while holding generated work to production standards. 

What you bring 

These are required. We are hiring for depth in modeling and business judgment. 

  • Production modeling. 5+ years building production data models in analytics or data engineering, ideally with a GTM, RevOps or SaaS revenue focus, including at least 3 years in dbt: incremental models, snapshots, macros, tests, documentation and CI with state-based deferred builds. 
  • Strong SQL. Databricks and Delta experience is preferred; Snowflake or BigQuery experience transfers. 
  • Salesforce fluency. Hands-on knowledge of the Salesforce data model, including accounts, opportunities, opportunity line items, contracts, assets or entitlements, quotes and subscriptions, and field history. 
  • SaaS revenue metrics. Able to define and defend ARR and MRR, bookings, renewals, expansion, churn and downsell, net and gross revenue retention, and how double counting happens. 
  • Metric ownership. Documented business definitions, resolved conflicting numbers across teams, and secured stakeholder approval before publishing metrics. 
  • Data quality discipline. Experience with model contracts, reconciliation, testing strategies and freshness or anomaly monitoring for production analytics models. 
  • Engineering discipline. Git, code review, pull requests, CI and promotion through environments, and a habit of validating AI-generated code before it ships. 
  • Clear communication. Able to explain modeling decisions and tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders and turn ambiguous questions into agreed requirements. 

 

Nice to have 

  • Unity Catalog governance. Governed tags, attribute-based access control (ABAC) column masks, and lineage. 
  • CI/CD for Databricks. Declarative Automation Bundles and Git-based deployment workflows. 
  • Semantic layers. dbt Semantic Layer (MetricFlow), Cube, Looker (LookML), or Databricks metric views. 
  • Agent-facing data tools. MCP servers, verified queries, and agent evaluation datasets. 
  • Feature engineering. Model-ready features for churn or propensity models. 
  • BI and dashboards. Power BI or Databricks AI/BI dashboards. 

 

Application Process

If you thrive in a fast paced environment and you are eager to make a significant impact in the field of accessibility, we would love to hear from you! Interested in immediate consideration?  Please submit your resume to be considered for this role.
The anticipated application window is 40 days from the date job is posted. However, factors such as candidate flow and business necessity may require us to shorten or extend the application window. This position is a current open vacancy. Candidates who are selected for an interview will be notified of the hiring decision within 45 days following their final interview.
Level Access is committed to workforce diversity and is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are dedicated to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process. 
Level Access uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support and enhance our recruitment and hiring processes. These tools may assist with activities such as résumé screening, skills assessments, interview scheduling, and communication These tools are designed to assist our recruiters and do not make final hiring decisions. All AI-assisted processes are subject to human review and candidate information is handled in accordance with our Privacy Policy and applicable regulations. 
To learn more about how we collect and use personal data, please review our Privacy Statement (https://www.levelaccess.com/privacy-statement) and our Trust Center (https://trust.levelaccess.com).

 

Compensation and Benefits

This is a full time position. The annual base salary hiring range for this position is $92,000 - $100,000 for employees located in the United States and CA$86,000 - CA$130,000 for employees located in Canada. The salary range reflects expected base pay for this role at the time of posting. The compensation package offered will be determined by factors such as demonstrated experience, skills, and internal equity. Expected base pay hiring ranges for candidates outside of the United States and Canada will be reviewed during the interview process, if selected. This position is eligible for incentive compensation in the form of a company bonus  plan.
Level Access is committed to supporting our global team with comprehensive and inclusive benefits. For employees in the United States and Canada, our offerings include medical, dental, and vision insurance, life and disability coverage (STD/LTD), and a retirement match. We also prioritize well-being and growth through flexible paid time off, paid parental leave, a remote work stipend, and professional development reimbursement. For employees in other locations, benefits are tailored to local regulations and employment status to ensure competitive support worldwide.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Analytics Engineer based in the United States.

The Lead Analytics Engineer will architect and strengthen the shared data and analytics foundations that support decision-making across multiple business areas and international markets. This fully remote role combines hands-on technical architecture with strategic collaboration across Data Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, and business leadership. You will own the business-context and semantic layers that establish trusted, consistent definitions of key metrics and datasets. By creating reusable data models, clear standards, and scalable self-service capabilities, you will help teams work faster and reduce duplicated analytical effort. You will also influence the organization's data roadmap, improve warehouse performance, and help stakeholders make better use of AI-enabled analytics tools. Success in this position means making analytics more reliable, accessible, and consistent across the entire organization.

Accountabilities

  • Design and maintain shared data models and semantic layers so analytical teams can work from trusted, reusable datasets.
  • Establish authoritative definitions for core business metrics and govern how those definitions are maintained and updated.
  • Define and enforce standards for dataset structures, naming conventions, documentation, testing, and reporting tiers.
  • Develop the self-service analytics layer, enabling business stakeholders to answer questions independently through business intelligence tools.
  • Partner with Data Engineering on shared roadmaps, data contracts, and data warehouse performance and cost optimization.
  • Take ownership of data and BI issues from root-cause investigation through resolution, escalating blockers when necessary.
  • Coach Data Science and Analytics teams on dimensional modeling, semantic layer adoption, and self-service analytics practices.
  • Promote the use of AI tools to make analytics more accessible and effective for non-technical stakeholders.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience building analytics infrastructure, data platforms, or large-scale data engineering solutions.
  • Expert-level knowledge of data modeling, including dimensional modeling, star schemas, fact tables, and dimension tables.
  • Advanced SQL skills and experience working with cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake.
  • Expert-level hands-on experience with dbt and data pipeline orchestration tools such as Airflow or equivalent platforms.
  • Strong experience with semantic layers and BI tools such as Cube, Semantic Views, Preset, Looker, or comparable solutions.
  • Demonstrated success building reusable datasets, establishing technical standards, and driving adoption across multiple teams.
  • Experience enabling AI tools and analytics capabilities for non-technical business users.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and influence decisions without direct authority.
  • Strong systems-thinking mindset, prioritizing organization-wide outcomes over individual team objectives.
  • Additional assets:
    • Experience with experimentation infrastructure and test-result analysis.
    • Open-source contributions or published content related to analytics architecture.
    • Experience coaching analytics engineers and data analysts.
  • Curiosity and sound judgment in adopting AI tools and applying them thoughtfully to improve work quality and efficiency.
Benefits

  • Annual base salary range of $134,865–$231,198 USD, with starting pay determined by location, education, experience, skills, and other qualifications.
  • Medical, dental, and retirement benefits for eligible employees.
  • Generous leave policies.
  • Fully remote work arrangement, with no regular in-office requirement.
  • Opportunities to connect with colleagues through intentional company and team gatherings.
  • Professional growth and development opportunities within a collaborative, international environment.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
