Description

Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add-on subscriptions such as Apple TV+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience.

As a Prime Video technologist, you'll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You'll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You'll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We'll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you!

What You'll Do

Join Prime Video's Partner Experience & Supply Chain team as a Senior Business Intelligence Engineer and become the technical leader who defines how we turn partner and supply chain data into business intelligence at scale. You will be the recognized data authority for the organization, owning the long-term view of our BI architecture and how it fits together across systems, and setting the standard for how insights are produced, trusted, and acted upon.

You'll operate in complex and often ambiguous problem spaces, working with limited guidance alongside product managers, engineers, and operations leaders. You will not just build dashboards, you will shape the analytics strategy for the org, decide where to invest, and lead large initiatives that require the coordinated work of multiple data professionals.

The Problems You'll Solve

Our supply chain generates massive amounts of data, but data alone doesn't drive change, insights do. You'll take on the intrinsically hard, undefined problems: Where are the systemic bottlenecks slowing content delivery, and what is the root cause across the pipeline rather than the symptom? Which partner workflows need to be re-architected? How do we predict and prevent supply chain issues before they impact customers?

You will own the data lineage end to end, developing deep understanding of and influence over the technical systems that generate the data, how metrics are aggregated, and how the resulting business intelligence is consumed, interpreted, and acted upon by the business. When problems are pervasive or persistent, you drive them to root cause, and your fixes may unblock related teams across the organization.

What Makes This Role Different

You'll be a strategic partner and a key influencer in team strategy, shaping how Prime Video manages relationships with content partners and optimizes the entire supply chain. You will anticipate, and where appropriate influence, stakeholders' future requirements rather than react to them. You will show good judgment making trade-offs between team investment (prioritization, data retention policy, infrastructure cost) and business need, and you will only advocate for new BI solutions when they are genuinely necessary.

Your work directly influences how quickly and efficiently we bring content to millions of viewers worldwide, and you will ensure the team is stronger because of your presence but does not require your presence to succeed.

Key job responsibilities

Lead the design, implementation, and delivery of BI solutions in complex and/or ambiguous problem areas, taking the long-term view of how each solution fits the team's architecture and lifecycle, and proactively fixing architecture deficiencies

Own and influence data lineage across the organization, from how data is generated through how metrics are aggregated to how business intelligence is consumed and acted upon

Lead large, multi-person BI projects: decompose them into parallel workstreams for yourself and other data professionals, and reassemble the work into a cohesive, successful launch

Drive BI engineering best practices and set standards for the org (operational excellence, code reviews, syntax and naming conventions, metric definitions, alarms); ensure solutions are accurate, timely, accessible, and actionable

Build inventive, robust, scalable, and extensible data pipelines, data models, and dashboards from multi-dimensional datasets that others can easily maintain and build upon

Resolve the root cause of pervasive or persistent problems, influencing decisions across teams and building consensus to find and drive the best path forward

Understand and articulate the capabilities and limitations of the systems you work with (e.g., cluster size, concurrent users, data classification) to both technical and non-technical audiences, clarifying what is possible today versus what requires technology investment

Build fast prototypes using Amazon AI tools (Kiro, Claude CLI, QuickSuite) and translate them into production-grade data products, selecting optimal tools by balancing speed, efficiency, and scalability

Present insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders verbally and in writing, and influence their decisions and future requirements

About The Team

We are part of the central Product and Data Team within the Partner Experience & Supply Chain organization at Prime Video. Our structure and scope is a hybrid model where we collaborate closely with our tech teams to build data products that solve problems affecting PV customers and our internal stakeholders.

We optimize the supply chain and deliver the highest standard of video streaming content to our customers. Our team is the trusted analytical powerhouse that drives unified data solutions, making Prime Video the preferred entertainment destination for customers worldwide.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field
  • 8+ years of as a Data Analyst, Data Engineer, Business Intelligence Analyst, or a related occupation experience
  • 5+ years of SQL experience
  • 4+ years of performing statistical analysis experience
  • 4+ years of developing automated reporting experience
  • Experience in scripting for automation (e.g. Python) and advanced SQL skills.
  • Prior experience with AWS services across data storage, querying, transformation, and visualization (QuickSight, Redshift, Athena, S3, Glue, Lambda)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate between data and business needs
  • Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership
  • 1+ years of processing large, multi-dimensional datasets from multiple sources experience
  • Experience with theory and practice of information retrieval, data science, machine learning and data mining
  • Experience with theory and practice of design of experiments and statistical analysis of results
  • Experience programming to extract, transform and clean large (multi-TB) data sets

descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Want to build the data foundation powering AI and self-serve analytics at scale? As part of Samsara's Marketing Data and Analytics (MDA) Engineering team, you will shape the technical roadmap alongside our BI and Data Science peers. You will architect core Databricks pipelines, Gold Layer tables, and semantic models, turning ambitious, ambiguous business challenges into high-value data products, autonomous agents, and cross-functional automation.

This role is open to candidates residing in the US.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best. 

In this role, you will:

  • Partner on defining the strategy and multi-quarter roadmap for MDA's data and AI foundation.
  • Architect and own Samsara's marketing data infrastructure: ETL/ELT pipelines, Databricks Gold Layer tables, and the core data models that power segmentation, targeting, automation, and analytics.
  • Design the semantic layers, data dictionaries, and structured documentation that enable self-serve BI and conversational analytics, partnering with the BI team to ensure core sales and marketing KPIs are built on trusted, well-modeled data.
  • Translate ambiguous business questions from Marketing, Sales, and R&D into clear requirements and scalable solutions, working autonomously without dedicated PM support and influencing decisions with data and sound reasoning.
  • Lead complex, cross-team initiatives end to end: stand up new data pipelines and integrations quickly, manage risk across interdependent teams, and own the reliability and data quality of what ships.
  • Serve as the senior technical lead for the team's hardest problems: raise the bar for engineering quality and code review, remove bottlenecks that slow multiple teams, and mentor engineers and analysts. 
  • Drive the strategic use of AI to solve ambiguous, high-impact problems: build AI-enabled data products and agents, with the integrations, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation practices that keep them reliable and trustworthy.
  • Identify and automate manual workflows with AI across Marketing and GTM teams, taking ideas from concept to prototype to production and influencing org roadmaps.
  • Ship high-quality Python and SQL, increasingly by directing agentic coding tools, while holding a high bar for reviewing and verifying AI-generated work before it reaches production.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

 

The Role

The Advanced Insights and Modeling (AIM) team is a high-impact, business-savvy group of builders: machine learning engineers, data scientists, data engineers, and business strategists who combine technical skills with deep product and financial expertise. We hold high standards, move fast, and own our models end to end. AIM runs on curiosity, bold thinking, and collaboration, and we keep the culture decidedly non-corporate. Teams across Block come to us when they need insight, speed, and real business impact.

AIM sits within Block’s Foundational organization and is sponsored directly by the CFO, but our mandate runs well beyond Finance. We own most of the measurement and predictive modeling at Block: forecasting across Cash App, Square, and Afterpay, customer lifetime value, marketing incrementality and spend optimization, sales pipeline and prospect value, and actives and network-effect measurement. Finance, Marketing, Sales, Product, and Risk all plan against numbers we produce. We also own the data foundations those models run on, and corporate functions including Finance, Accounting, Treasury, SFS, and Procurement increasingly come to us when they want to rethink how their work gets done with AI.

Automation across the enterprise. AIM leads Block’s Foundational Automation program, a CFO-sponsored effort to rebuild how Finance, Accounting, Treasury, SFS, and Procurement operate. Rather than layering AI on top of existing workflows, we rebuild the underlying data and process layer so that agents can take on the work itself: monitoring pipelines, reconciling positions, triaging exceptions, and escalating only the decisions that need a person. In Treasury, you will define and build the data systems and controls that make this automation reliable.

The Treasury opportunity. Block moves money through hundreds of bank accounts across multiple legal entities, and Treasury’s view of that position today is stitched together from bank portals, a liquidity tool, portfolio accounting, and the general ledger, with the gaps closed by hand. No single system tells Treasury, in near real time, where every dollar sits and whether the books agree. You will build that system from the ground up.

Your mandate. You will own the technical direction and hands-on development of Treasury’s data foundation. Treasury manages Block’s own cash, liquidity, and investments across its businesses and legal entities. You will work directly with Treasury and Accounting to understand how they operate, identify what needs to change, and turn those needs into a technical roadmap.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will make architecture and build-versus-buy recommendations, decide what to tackle first, and personally build and operate the core data systems. We’re looking for someone who can take an open-ended business problem through to a working solution, bringing clear recommendations when decisions need broader agreement.

Treasury is the first function to get this treatment. The architecture, controls, and operating model you establish will become the template for Accounting, Procurement, and the rest of Foundational.

Your initial priorities. You will shape the roadmap around three connected needs:

  • A trusted liquidity position. Bring bank, custodian, portfolio accounting, and general ledger data into a reliable entity-level view in Snowflake. Define the architecture, reconciliation approach, and data quality controls, then build the pipelines and data models.
  • A foundation for forecasting. Partner with AIM’s ML engineers to establish the datasets, features, and data contracts for predicting cash inflows and outflows. Own the underlying data systems through production.
  • A clear direction for Treasury systems. Lead the technical recommendation for Block’s 2027 Treasury Management System decision: what to build, what to buy, and how the pieces should fit together. Define the integration and migration approach for the chosen direction.

You will determine the sequencing and trade-offs with Treasury and AIM.

Success means Treasury uses and trusts the systems you build, forecasting has reliable inputs, and manual reconciliation and investigation require less effort. Your initial focus is Treasury. Over time, the role can expand within across AIM’s broader portfolio, including forecasting infrastructure, customer-level data products, and GTM measurement.

You Will

  • Own Treasury’s data architecture and technical roadmap. Work directly with Treasury and Accounting to establish requirements, resolve competing needs, and prioritize what to build, buy, defer, or retire.
  • Personally design, build, and operate the Treasury liquidity datamart in Snowflake, including source integrations, data models, reconciliation logic, and data contracts.
  • Partner with AIM’s ML engineers on liquidity forecasting, building and maintaining the reliable datasets and pipelines those models depend on.
  • Lead the technical recommendation for Treasury’s TMS build-versus-buy decision, including vendor evaluation, target architecture, and the integration and migration approach.
  • Own production reliability and controls, including data quality, lineage, access, recovery, and on-call. Build automation, including AI agents where appropriate, to reduce manual monitoring and investigation while preserving necessary human review.
  • Own delivery through adoption. Establish success measures with Treasury and improve the systems based on their reliability, use in daily decisions, and reduction in manual work.

You Have

  • 10+ years of experience in data engineering, or a combination of software and data engineering, with substantial recent experience personally building and operating production data systems.
  • Deep expertise in SQL, Python, and dbt, and experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse.
  • Strong data architecture and modeling skills, including schema design, dimensional modeling, and integrating multiple source systems. Experience designing reconciliation, data quality, lineage, and access controls.
  • Experience operating business-critical pipelines, including orchestration with tools such as Airflow or Prefect, dependency management, monitoring, incident response, and recovery.
  • A track record of independently turning ambiguous business problems into production systems, setting technical direction, making architecture and build-versus-buy decisions, and personally implementing solutions through adoption.
  • Experience working directly with senior business partners, challenging assumptions, resolving competing requirements, and explaining technical recommendations in business terms.

Particularly valuable

  • Experience with financial, Treasury, or general ledger data, especially cash positions, transaction reconciliation, and multi-entity reporting.
  • Experience building datasets and data contracts for production ML models or forecasting systems.
  • Experience building workflow automation, including production AI agents with appropriate validation and human review.

Block is an equal opportunity employer evaluating all employees and job applicants without regard to identity or any legally protected class. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment in accordance with state and local laws and “fair chance” ordinances.

We believe in being fair, and are committed to an inclusive interview experience, including providing reasonable accommodations to disabled applicants throughout the recruitment process. We encourage applicants to share any needed accommodations with their recruiter, who will treat these requests as confidentially as possible. Want to learn more about what we’re doing to build a workplace that is fair and square? Check out our I+D page.

While there is no specific deadline to apply for this role, U.S. roles are typically open for an average of 55 days before being filled by a successful candidate. Please refer to the date listed at the top of this job page for when this role was first posted.

U.S. locations are categorized into one of four zones based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. The successful candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future.To find a location’s zone designation, please refer to this resource. If a location of interest is not listed, please speak with a recruiter for additional information.

Application Guidelines

Candidates may submit up to 9 active applications within a 60-day period. Reapplications to the same role are accepted 90 days after a previous application has been reviewed.

Use of AI in Our Hiring Process

We may use automated AI tools to evaluate job applications for efficiency and consistency. These tools comply with local regulations, including bias audits, and we handle all personal data in accordance with state and local privacy laws. 

Contact us here with hiring practice or data usage questions.

Every benefit we offer is designed with one goal: empowering you to do the best work of your career while building the life you want. Remote work, medical insurance, flexible time off, retirement savings plans, and modern family planning are just some of our offering. Check out our other benefits at Block.

Block, Inc. (NYSE: XYZ) builds technology to increase access to the global economy. Each of our brands unlocks different aspects of the economy for more people. Square makes commerce and financial services accessible to sellers. Cash App is the easy way to spend, send, and store money. Afterpay is transforming the way customers manage their spending over time. TIDAL is a music platform that empowers artists to thrive as entrepreneurs. Bitkey is a simple self-custody wallet built for bitcoin. Proto is a suite of bitcoin mining products and services. Together, we’re helping build a financial system that is open to everyone.

Description

Help Us Build the Data Centers That Power the Cloud.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We're the people who build the data centers and keep the cloud running. Every AWS data center, and every server, storage system, network, power, and cooling unit inside it, starts with our work, so customers can count on the innovations they rely on, every second of every day. We tackle some of the toughest problems in the industry, with thousands of variables shaping the supply chain, and we want talented people who are excited to solve them with us

You’ll join a diverse team of technical program managers, design engineers, construction managers, network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Data-driven decision-making is at the core of Amazon's culture, and people who are exceptionally talented at analyzing large sets of data to build insights are critical. Your work will directly impact the decisions and strategy of the ML Capacity Delivery organization and our customers. You will gather customer needs and insights, mine large and diverse data sets from across AWS Infrastructure, build visualizations and tools for our business partners, and generate insights to help senior leaders make critical business decisions. The successful BIE will not only possess the expertise and passion for analyzing data, designing metrics to measure the performance of the business, and building reporting capabilities and tools, but will also interact directly with business leaders and teams that rely on the metrics and analyses they produce.

The ideal candidate must be a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, able to think big and be creative (while still paying careful attention to detail), and enjoy working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. If you are excited about data, are results-oriented, and want to join a growing analytics team within Amazon — this role is for you!

Key job responsibilities

Set the baseline. Partner with business customers and leadership to define, track, and report KPIs against annual, quarterly, and monthly goals.

Turn needs into solutions. Gather requirements and deliver complete reporting solutions.

Build at scale. Design, develop, and maintain automated, user-friendly reports and dashboards that support procurement planning and decision-making.

Move the data. Build and optimize ETL pipelines that pull data from diverse sources using SQL, Python, and AWS big data technologies.

Tell the story. Publish and maintain QuickSight dashboards, reports, and executive review documents that reveal trends, patterns, and outliers.

Spot what others miss. Uncover patterns in the data and connect them to business outcomes.

Measure what matters. Invent new ways to define and measure program effectiveness and organizational productivity.

Bridge business and tech. Act as the link between business and technical teams, delivering actionable insights and ad hoc analyses that fuel future improvements.

Protect data quality. Run regular audits to keep reporting complete and accurate, and automate manual reporting wherever you can.

Think ahead. Grow the team's analytical maturity through predictive and prescriptive analytics.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

  • 3+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
  • 1+ years of SQL, ETL or Oracle experience
  • 1+ years of processing large, multi-dimensional datasets from multiple sources experience
  • 1+ years of performing statistical analysis experience
  • 1+ years of developing automated reporting experience
  • 3+ years of in the job offered or a related occupation experience
  • 1+ years of using SQL, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load), or Oracle experience
  • Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field
  • Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
  • Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
  • Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
  • Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
  • Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets

descriptionHtml:
As a Data Engineer at Meta, you will shape the future of people-facing and business-facing products we build across our entire family of applications (Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, Reality Labs, Threads). Your technical skills and analytical mindset will be utilized designing and building some of the world's most extensive data sets, helping to craft experiences for billions of people and hundreds of millions of businesses worldwide.In this role, you will collaborate with software engineering, data science, and product management teams to design/build scalable data solutions across Meta to optimize growth, strategy, and user experience for our 3 billion plus users, as well as our internal employee community.You will be at the forefront of identifying and solving some of the most interesting data challenges at a scale few companies can match. By joining Meta, you will become part of a world-class data engineering community dedicated to skill development and career growth in data engineering and beyond.Data Engineering: You will guide teams by building optimal data artifacts (including datasets and visualizations) to address key questions. You will refine our systems, design logging solutions, and create scalable data models. Ensuring data security and quality, and with a strong focus on efficiency, you will suggest architecture and development approaches and data management standards to address complex analytical problems.Product leadership: You will use data to shape product development, identify new opportunities, and tackle upcoming challenges. You'll ensure our products add value for users and businesses, by prioritizing projects, and driving innovative solutions to respond to challenges or opportunities.Communication and influence: You won't simply present data, but tell data-driven stories. You will convince and influence your partners using clear insights and recommendations. You will build credibility through structure and clarity, and be a trusted strategic partner.

Data Engineer, Product Analytics Responsibilities:

  • Conceptualize and own the data architecture for multiple large-scale projects, while evaluating design and operational cost-benefit tradeoffs within systems
  • Create and contribute to frameworks that improve the efficacy of logging data, while working with data infrastructure to triage issues and resolve
  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and data scientists to understand data needs, representing key data insights in a meaningful way
  • Define and manage Service Level Agreements for all data sets in allocated areas of ownership
  • Determine and implement the security model based on privacy requirements, confirm safeguards are followed, address data quality issues, and evolve governance processes within allocated areas of ownership
  • Design, build, and launch collections of sophisticated data models and visualizations that support multiple use cases across different products or domains
  • Solve our most challenging data integration problems, utilizing optimal Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) patterns, frameworks, query techniques, sourcing from structured and unstructured data sources
  • Assist in owning existing processes running in production, optimizing complex code through advanced algorithmic concepts
  • Optimize pipelines, dashboards, frameworks, and systems to facilitate easier development of data artifacts
  • Influence product and cross-functional teams to identify data opportunities to drive impact
  • Mentor team members by giving/receiving actionable feedback

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 4+ years of experience where the primary responsibility involves working with data. This could include roles such as data analyst, data scientist, data engineer, or similar positions
  • 4+ years of experience with SQL, ETL, data modeling, and at least one programming language (e.g., Python, C++, C#, Scala, etc.)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's or Ph.D degree in a STEM field
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
  • Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

About Meta:

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.

Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations-ext@meta.com.

Description

The USRM Data Office turns data into a competitive advantage. As a Principal Data Solutions Analyst, you’ll design and develop solutions that power Distribution & Marketing—translating business needs into technical requirements, building prototypes, and partnering with data engineers to deliver scalable data products on Snowflake. You’ll use advanced SQL and Python skills to solve complex problems, balance competing priorities, and help stakeholders make faster, better business decisions.

About The Team

The Data Office within Insights & Solutions at Liberty Mutual partners across USRM to define data strategy, deliver data products, and govern data for quality, security, and compliance. Our performance-driven team is passionate about using data to create value for customers and drive business results. The Distribution & Marketing Data Products team partners with business, reporting, and analytics stakeholders to identify emerging data needs and turn them into reliable, reusable solutions.

Why this role?

  • Solve high-impact Distribution & Marketing challenges through hands-on data solutioning.
  • Collaborate with business and technical leaders to build our modern data landscape.
  • Help shape scalable, AI-ready data products that enable better business decisions.

This is a ranged posting. Grade level offered will be determined based on individual skills & experience.

For this role, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship now or in the future.

  • This role may have in-office requirements dependent upon candidate location.**

What You’ll Do

Under minimal direction, you will:

  • Translate ambiguous business needs into scalable data solutions. Partner with D&M stakeholders to clarify problems, analyze data, and define detailed requirements and acceptance criteria. Recommend approaches that balance business needs, technical feasibility, scalability, and end-user experience.
  • Prototype solutions to complex data challenges. Build, test, and maintain prototypes and proofs of concept, assessing their viability, performance, and scalability.
  • Develop reliable, maintainable data products. Refine data models, transformation logic, and documentation to support product-oriented solutions on Snowflake.
  • Manage competing priorities and stakeholder needs. Collaborate with product owners and delivery partners to align customer value, dependencies, and sequencing. Communicate trade-offs and set realistic expectations.
  • Build quality controls into delivery. Embed data quality, governance, security, and compliance into requirements, testing, and implementation.
  • Communicate clearly across audiences. Present findings, recommendations, progress, and risks in plain language to business partners, technical teams, and senior leaders.
  • Explore emerging technologies and AI-enabled approaches. Use practical experimentation to assess their potential and demonstrate business value.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship. Promote sound development practices and help junior associates strengthen their analytical and technical skills.

Ideal Candidate Will Have

  • Advanced SQL and Python skills in complex transformations, query optimization, reusable code, and automation.
  • Hands-on experience with data solutioning spanning modeling, warehousing, ELT/ETL, and cloud platforms - preferably Snowflake - with strong testing, version control, and documentation practices.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to translate ambiguous business needs into clear requirements, form hypotheses, develop and test prototypes, and recommend scalable solutions.
  • Effective prioritization and communication to manage complex solutions, navigate competing stakeholder needs, and explain technical concepts across business and engineering teams.
  • Knowledge of data quality, governance, privacy, and security practices, plus experience working with data engineers to move prototypes into production.
  • Independent execution and technical leadership, including cross-team influence and mentorship.
  • D&M domain experience, preferably in property and casualty insurance.
  • A bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field and at least 4 years of relevant work experience; typically, 6 years. A master’s degree and project management experience are preferred.

Qualifications

  • Strong written and oral communication skills required.

Join Deloitte's AI & Engineering team to help clients modernize technology platforms, accelerate innovation, and drive meaningful business outcomes. In this role, you will work alongside multidisciplinary professionals to design and deliver modern data solutions that support enterprise transformation. You will help build scalable platforms, analytics products, and data pipelines that enable mission-focused results and measurable client impact.

Work you'll do

As a Data Engineer II on the AI & Data team, you will be responsible for:

  • Collaborating with stakeholders to identify, access, and document data sources, definitions, and analytical needs
  • Preparing, integrating, and analyzing data from multiple sources to identify trends, issues, and opportunities

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our AI & Data offering provides a full spectrum of solutions for designing, developing, and operating cutting-edge Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. Our offerings help clients innovate, enhance and operate their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Active Secret clearance
  • 2+ Years experience using Databricks or Palantir for data engineering or analytics workflows
  • 2+ Years experience using Qlik to develop dashboards, reports, or data visualizations
  • 2+ Years experience using Microsoft Excel and at least one of the following tools: Python, R, or Structured Query Language (SQL)
  • Experience gathering stakeholder requirements and delivering analytical products that address documented business questions
  • Ability to travel 20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Experience using Databricks machine learning or artificial intelligence capabilities
  • Coursework or professional experience applying statistical methods and programming to integrate data from multiple sources and develop predictive or prescriptive models
  • Experience supporting data and analytics work subject to documented security, access, or reporting requirements

For individuals assigned and/or hired to work in Virginia, Deloitte is required by law to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. This compensation range is specific to Virginia and takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $97,700 to $162,800.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

descriptionHtml:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Job Description

As a Data Engineer, you will be a member of the Data Science & Analytics team building the foundation to scale analytics across our organization. You will collaborate with key stakeholders in Engineering, Product, and other areas to build scalable solutions to transform data into key metrics reporting and insights. You will be responsible for ensuring teams have access to reliable, accurate metrics for consumer products from idea to implementation. You will also lead your own projects to enable self-serve insights to help teams make data-driven decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Understand and whenever possible proactively identify the data needs of stakeholder teams in terms of key data models and reporting, and translate that into technical requirements
  • Define, build and manage key data pipelines in dbt that transform raw logs into canonical datasets
  • Establish high data integrity standards and SLAs to ensure timely, accurate delivery of data
  • Develop insightful and reliable dashboards to track performance of core metrics that will deliver insights to the whole company
  • Build foundational data products, dashboards and tools to enable self-serve analytics to scale across the company
  • Closely partner with stakeholders to define and materialize metrics and analysis for new and evolving consumer products in a fast paced environment
  • Influence the future roadmap of Product teams from a data systems perspective
  • Become an expert in our organization’s data models and the company's data architecture

You Might Be a Good Fit If You Have

  • 7+ years of experience as an Data Engineer or similar Data Science & Analytics roles, preferably partnering with Product leads to build and report on key company-wide metrics.
  • A passion for the company's mission of building helpful, honest, and harmless AI.
  • Expertise in building multi-step ETL jobs through tooling like dbt; proficiency with workflow management platforms like Airflow and version control management tools through GitHub.
  • Expertise in SQL and Python to transform data into accurate, clean data models
  • Experience building data reporting and dashboarding in visualization tools like Hex to serve multiple cross-functional teams.
  • A bias for action and urgency, not letting perfect be the enemy of the effective.
  • A “full-stack mindset”, not hesitating to do what it takes to solve a problem end-to-end, even if it requires going outside the original job description.
  • Experience building a Data Engineering (or similar) function at start-ups.
  • A strong disposition to thrive in ambiguity, taking initiative to create clarity and forward progress.
  • Experience scaling own productivity and that of others by leveraging AI without sacrificing the quality of deliverables.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$320,000—$405,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

descriptionHtml:
About The Team

Grindr is an AI-native platform powering how millions of gay people connect globally. With 15M+ monthly users, 130B+ annual messages, and a team of fewer than 200, we move fast, stay lean, and tackle technical problems at a scale few companies ever see.

The Data Engineering team turns raw product data into the trusted datasets that power decisions across Grindr, from dashboards and experimentation to machine learning models and features in the app itself.

And we’re pushing that further than most. Every company wants an AI-powered data analyst; we’ve already built one. Data Daddy is our production AI analyst, used daily in Slack by employees and senior leadership to answer real business questions, with visibility all the way up to our CEO. It’s only as good as the data behind it, and that’s where this team comes in.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Engineer, Analytics to own data for our newest product features: building the data models, metrics, and semantic layers that data scientists, ML engineers, and Data Daddy all rely on. You’ll partner closely with stakeholders across the business and help shape how data is used across the organization.

At Grindr, we operate in Grindr Mode. Moderately hardcore day to day, truly hardcore when it counts. It’s about doing great work without burning out. Outcomes over outputs. Smart, driven people who raise your bar, with room to live full lives.

This is a hybrid role based in our Chicago, SF, or Palo Alto office and will require you to be in person Tuesdays and Thursdays.

About The Job

  • Own Our Newest Features: Take end-to-end ownership of critical business datasets, from understanding stakeholder requirements and designing data models to building pipelines, validating metrics, and ensuring data quality.
  • Build AI-Ready Analytics: Design and develop reliable, well-structured data models that power analytics, reporting, and AI-driven tools like Data Daddy, enabling employees to ask complex business questions using natural language.
  • Develop the Semantic Layer: Create and maintain reusable metrics, dimensional models, and semantic definitions that make data consistent, discoverable, and accessible to both human analysts and AI agents.
  • Partner Across Teams: Work closely with Data Science, ML Engineering, Product, and Analytics to translate business questions into scalable data solutions that support decision-making, experimentation, and machine learning.
  • Leverage Modern Engineering Tools: Use AI-assisted development tools and modern data engineering practices to accelerate development and raise the bar on how we model, test, and document data.

Role Requirements

  • Analytics Engineering Fundamentals: Strong SQL skills and experience designing dimensional data models, defining business metrics, and building datasets that support complex analytical questions.
  • Data Engineering Experience: Experience turning raw, high-volume event data into reliable production datasets, including applying business logic, building and maintaining transformations, and validating data quality in a modern cloud warehouse with orchestration tools like Airflow.

POSITION SUMMARY:

Reporting to the Senior Manager of AI & Business Intelligence, the Sr Engineer - BI will play a critical role in establishing and scaling a Business Intelligence Center of Excellence (CoE).

This role is responsible for designing, developing, and delivering enterprise BI solutions while defining the standards, data models, and practices that enable scalable, governed analytics across the organization.

This individual will be highly hands-on in the near term (80–90% development), delivering critical dashboards, data models, and reporting solutions. Over time, the role will evolve toward a broader leadership focus (approximately 70/30), driving standardization, governance, and alignment across BI and analytics teams.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical execution with a systems mindset—building solutions that are not only effective in the moment, but reusable, scalable, and aligned to long-term enterprise data strategy.

This position is onsite in Springfield, Missouri.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to gather requirements and define, standardize, and document enterprise KPIs and business metrics.
  • Design and develop scalable, governed BI solutions, including Power BI dashboards, semantic models, and enterprise reporting assets.
  • Build BI solutions in a way that establishes reusable patterns, standardized logic, and scalable data models for broader organizational use.
  • Own and evolve semantic models and reusable data structures, ensuring consistency across reporting and analytics.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering and Analytics teams to build and optimize robust ETL/ELT pipelines and data models (e.g., Snowflake, dbt).
  • Drive improvements in data quality, consistency, and governance across BI workflows.
  • Enforce BI development standards, naming conventions, and best practices.
  • Optimize BI platform performance, including query efficiency, model design, and cost management.
  • Influence and guide partner analytics teams toward standardized, maintainable, and scalable solutions.
  • Act as a key liaison between business stakeholders, data engineering, and analytics teams to ensure alignment and scalability.
  • Support business users through training, documentation, and enablement of self-service analytics.
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, and long-term maintainability of BI assets.
  • Operate effectively in ambiguous or evolving data environments, driving incremental improvement and structure.
  • ALL OTHER DUTIES AS ASSIGNED

EXPERIENCE/QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Minimum Degree Required: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 4+ years of experience in BI development, analytics, or data engineering roles.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and enterprise data modeling (required).
  • Advanced proficiency in Power BI and DAX (required).
  • Experience building semantic layers, reusable data models, and scalable reporting frameworks.
  • Experience with modern data platforms such as Snowflake or Databricks (preferred).
  • Experience with dbt or similar transformation tools (preferred).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and version-controlled analytics workflows (e.g., GitLab, Azure DevOps).
  • Experience working across multiple business domains and stakeholder groups.
  • Retail, distribution, or supply chain experience is a plus.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITY:

  • Strong expertise in data modeling, data warehousing, and BI architecture.
  • Proven ability to define and standardize business metrics across teams.
  • Deep understanding of data pipelines, data quality, and governance principles.
  • Ability to influence without direct authority across decentralized teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate between business and technical audiences.
  • Ability to balance hands-on technical execution with strategic thinking.
  • Highly organized with the ability to adapt to changing priorities.
  • Experience operating in low-maturity or evolving data environments.
  • Continuous learner focused on improving systems, processes, and team capabilities.

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS:

  • N/A

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Regularly sits and works on a computer.

Occasionally stands and walks.

Seldom/never lifts up to 50 lbs.

INDEPENDENT JUDGEMENT:

Performs duties within scope of general company policies, procedures, and objectives. Analyzes problems and performs needs assessments. Uses judgment in adapting broad guidelines to achieve desired result. Regular exercise of independent judgment within accepted practices. Makes recommendations that affect policies, procedures, and practices.

Full Time Benefits Summary:

Enjoy discounts on retail merchandise, our restaurants, world-class resorts and conservation attractions!

  • Dental
  • Vision
  • Health Savings Account
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • Voluntary benefits
  • 401k Retirement Savings
  • Paid holidays
  • Paid vacation
  • Paid sick time
  • Bass Pro Cares Fund
  • And more!

OnTrac is hiring an Analytics Engineer!

Are you eager to join a dynamic and expanding company where you can both learn and make a meaningful impact? If you possess a strong sense of empathy, enjoy assisting others, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and excel at problem-solving, we encourage you to apply today to connect with a recruiter!

Founded in 1986, OnTrac has evolved into the leading provider of same-day and next-day delivery services in the U.S. for premier e-commerce and product-supply businesses, including five of the largest retailers in the U.S.

Location: Remote - This position may be performed remotely in states where the company is authorized to employ individuals.

Compensation: The expected starting base pay range for this position is $104,800 - $131,000, with full potential base salary range over a successful candidate’s tenure in the position of $104,800 - $157,200. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, internal equity, and other job-related factors.

This position may also be eligible for bonus, commission, or other incentive compensation in accordance with the terms of the applicable plan of up to a 15% Bonus Target.

Employment Logistics

The Analytics Engineer designs, develops, and maintains data analytics solutions and business intelligence dashboards that provide actionable insights for strategic decision-making. This role partners with business units to understand requirements, analyze complex datasets, and deliver high-quality reporting and visualization tools. The Analytics Engineer also collaborates with IT and Analytics teams to improve data integrity, optimize pipelines, and promote scalable, secure data practices.

Unpacking The Benefits

Employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package which may include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Life and short- and long-term disability coverage
  • 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match
  • Flex vacation in states other than CA, CO, IL, MA, MT, and NE, with accruals up to 96 hours for first year of employment with tenure-based increases up to 160 hours
  • Two (2) floating holidays per year
  • Paid sick leave*
  • Six (6) paid company holidays
  • Two (2) weeks paid pregnancy disability leave, four (4) weeks paid parental bonding leave
  • Additional wellness and employee assistance programs

Benefits eligibility and offerings are subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plans and company policies.

The Must-Haves

  • 8+ years of relevant experience with a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
  • Extensive understanding of data analytics, business intelligence, and industry terminology
  • Knowledge of standard office software and technologies
  • Knowledge of key data tools and deployment processes
  • It is the responsibility of every position to understand and adhere to the security guidelines outlined in OnTrac’s Acceptable Use policy and to conduct their activities accordingly.

Your Mission In Motion

A summary of key responsibilities for the role is outlined below. Additional duties may be assigned as needed to support business objectives.

  • Data source integrity & accuracy: Create, update, and maintain the data sources used for reporting, analysis, and modeling, ensuring their integrity and accuracy.
  • Metadata, pipelines & ETL documentation: Create and maintain metadata and technical documentation for data sources, pipelines, ETL processes, and related data assets.
  • Business requirements & technical specifications: Partner with stakeholders and data analysts to gather business requirements and translate them into clear technical specifications.
  • Pipeline & ETL optimization: Collaborate with IT engineers to optimize data pipelines and ETL processes for efficient data flow and transformation.
  • Process improvement & automation: Identify opportunities to improve, automate, and standardize data and analytics processes.
  • Data governance, security & performance: Promote best practices for data hygiene, resource allocation, and security while monitoring system performance and implementing enhancements as needed.

Paving Your Way To Your Success

  • You communicate clearly and professionally, both verbally and in writing.
  • You collaborate effectively in a team environment to deliver reliable data and analytics solutions.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment, prioritizing tasks effectively while maintaining accuracy.
  • You define appropriate methods and procedures for new assignments, using sound judgment to select, adapt, and evaluate advanced techniques.
  • You deliver innovative and effective solutions to challenging data and business issues

Posting Timeline

This job posting is anticipated to remain open for at least 15 days from the date of posting

Disclosures

  • Washington state employees are eligible for up to 56 hours of paid sick leave annually.

The salary range above represents the national range for this position. The salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at OnTrac, and the actual base salary offered may vary depending on several factors including, but not limited to: Geographic location, candidate experience and qualifications, job-related skills and competencies, market alignment, and financial considerations.

Compensation decisions are made based on the specific circumstances of each hire to ensure fair and competitive pay.

About Us

Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.

About The Team

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

Topps Digital, part of Fanatics Collectibles, powers digital collecting experiences across major sports and entertainment brands, including MLB, NFL, NBA, Global Football, WWE, UFC, Disney, Marvel, and Star Wars. It features digital collectible apps across sports and entertainment, bringing Topps' decades of trading card heritage into a mobile, digital-first format for collectors.

Role Summary

As a Senior Analytics Engineer at Topps Digital, part of Fanatics, you'll be the bridge between raw data and business decisions, owning everything from BI dashboards to AI-powered insights. We're looking for someone self-motivated and intellectually curious, who doesn't just answer the question asked, but challenges assumptions, asks why, and brings new, innovative thinking to the table. This isn't just an individual contributor role, you'll act as a thought leader, partnering directly with functional leads across the business to shape how we understand performance and make decisions.

What You'll Do

Analytical Work & Insights

  • Lead complex, cross-functional analytical initiatives end-to-end, from an ambiguous business problem through scoping, analysis, and a decision-ready recommendation.
  • Conduct analyses that validate business opportunities and support key decisions, including scenario analysis and impact sizing.
  • Apply statistical rigor and structured problem-solving to business questions, going beyond surface-level reporting to explain why something is happening and what to do about it.
  • Present findings to stakeholders and senior leadership, and defend your methodology under scrutiny.
  • Diagnose root causes in the data, not just symptoms, and translate findings into concrete, actionable recommendations.

Dashboarding, Reporting, & Automation

  • Build and maintain dashboards, automated reporting, and AI-driven insight tools within the Databricks ecosystem.
  • Optimize and automate operational workflows across the business, reducing reliance on recurring manual data pulls and repetitive, manual decisioning.
  • Define KPI definitions and methodology, then build the underlying pipelines and visualizations.
  • Standardize reporting and unify process across cross-functional teams.
  • Build and maintain a source of truth for internal business questions to help drive decisions.

AI Enablement

  • Build and maintain a knowledge repository to support the business's AI chat agent.
  • Design and build the logic that power the chat agent's ability to answer business questions accurately.
  • Build the evaluation frameworks and guardrails that determine when the chat agent can operate independently and when it should defer to human review.

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in analytics engineering, business intelligence, or a related field.
  • Advanced SQL skills, with the ability to independently write, QA, and optimize complex queries against large, imperfect datasets.
  • Experiencing building and maintaining dashboards in Tableau, Power BI, QuickSight, Looker, or similar BI tools.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud data infrastructure, including AWS services and the Databricks platform (e.g., Delta Lake, Databricks SQL, and workflow orchestration).
  • Demonstrated experience owning complex, cross-functional projects end-to-end, from ambiguous ask to stakeholder-ready recommendations.
  • Experience integrating AI tools into analytics workflows.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Experience with project management tools such as Asana or Jira, and familiarity with agile frameworks.
  • Command of statistical methods, such as experimental design/hypothesis testing, regression analysis, causal inference, time-series forecasting, multivariate analysis, segmentation/clustering, and Bayesian methods, applied through structured problem-solving frameworks for business analysis.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with demonstrated experience presenting to leadership and senior stakeholders, translating complex problems clearly, and proposing alternative approaches when the data warrants it.
  • An insistence on the highest standards of data quality and accuracy, catching issues before they surface in leadership reporting.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Python, R, or relevant statistical programming languages.
  • Background in e-commerce, sports, entertainment, and/or mobile gaming industries.
  • A genuine interest in Fanatics, collectibles, mobile apps and gaming, and sports.

Launched in 2006, Amazon Web Services (AWS) began exposing key infrastructure services to businesses in the form of web services -- now widely known as cloud computing. The ultimate benefit of cloud computing, and AWS, is the ability to leverage a new business model and turn capital infrastructure expenses into variable costs. Businesses no longer need to plan and procure servers and other IT resources weeks or months in advance. Using AWS, businesses can take advantage of Amazon's expertise and economies of scale to access resources when their business needs them, delivering results faster and at a lower cost.

Today, Amazon Web Services provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world. With data center locations in the U.S., Europe, Singapore, and Japan, customers across all industries are taking advantage of our low cost, elastic, open and flexible, secure platform.
